lines.japanese:
私立―――学院
　昭和＊＊年設立。
lines.english: ———Private Academy Established in Showa **.

lines.japanese:
◎教育
　目標を実現する力を要綱とし、質が高く高密度の教育を提供、国際社会で通用
する基礎力の育成を目標としている。進学科と英語科があり、ともに二年次まで
に学院の履修過程を終了させる。
　近代的な施設と高い進学率を誇る名門進学校。
lines.english: ◎ Education With the power to realize one's goals as its guiding principle, the academy offers an intensive, high-quality education aimed at building the foundation students need to succeed internationally. It has college-preparatory and English departments, both of which complete the academy's curriculum by the end of the second year. A prestigious preparatory school boasting modern facilities and an excellent university-placement rate.

lines.japanese:
◎校風
　伝統的に軟式テニス部が強い他、全般的に文化部が充実している。
　語学力習得のためイギリス姉妹校への冬季語学研修（一年）、
交換訪問（二年）など実地教育が盛ん。
　校内には日本語が禁止された英語サロンなどがあり、語学教育への熱心さがう
かがえる。
lines.english: ◎ School Culture The academy has traditionally excelled at soft tennis and boasts a strong range of cultural clubs. It emphasizes practical language learning, with a first-year winter language program at a sister school in Britain and a second-year exchange visit. The campus even features an English salon where Japanese is forbidden, further evidence of the academy's commitment to language education.

lines.japanese:
◎制服
　制服はブレザータイプ。
　ブラウス・タイ・ボックススカートを合わせる。
　
　男女とも夏服・冬服の他に中間服が２タイプあり、生徒の任意となる。
　スカート・タイなどと同色の縁取りが施された白のブレザーは、肩にパフスリ
ーブを採用しており特徴的なシルエット。
　
　全国女子校原色制服図鑑・初回限定版
（初回限定特典／清心女子学院旧夏服レプリカ／￥１２８００）より抜粋
lines.english: ◎ Uniform The school uniform consists of a blazer, blouse, tie, and box-pleated skirt.  Both boys and girls may choose from two midseason options in addition to the summer and winter uniforms. The distinctive white blazer is edged in the same color as the skirt and tie, and its puff sleeves give it an unmistakable silhouette.  Excerpted from National Full-Color Illustrated Guide to Girls' School Uniforms: First-Print Limited Edition (First-print bonus: replica of Seishin Girls' Academy's former summer uniform / ¥12,800)

lines.japanese: 今日は笛子が、そこにいた―――
lines.english: Today, Fueko was there—
“…You're late.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese:
入るなりクレームがついた。
　笛子は腕と脚を組んで、ソファでふんぞりかえっ
ていた。
lines.english: The complaint came the moment he entered. Fueko was sprawled imperiously across the sofa, arms and legs crossed.

lines.japanese: 「遅かったですか？」
lines.english: “Was I late?”

lines.japanese: 「三十分孤独だったわ」
lines.english: “I've been alone for thirty minutes.”
“That's not long.”

lines.japanese:
「今日はみんな集まるみたいなこと朝言ってたじゃ
　ない」
lines.english: “Didn't you say this morning that everyone was coming today?”

lines.japanese: 「あー」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、ごめん」
lines.english: “Well, sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「ぞ、ぞんざいね……まあいいわ」
lines.english: “T-that's a pretty casual apology… Oh, never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「ところでその荷物は何？」
lines.english: “Anyway, what's all that?”

lines.japanese: 「レトルトライス。３６食分」
lines.english: “Ready-to-eat rice. Thirty-six servings.”

lines.japanese: ダンボール箱には３６食分のパックライス。
lines.english: The cardboard box held thirty-six packs of rice.

lines.japanese:
「あんた……とうとうそんなものにお小遣いを
　使うように……」
lines.english: “You… You've finally started spending your allowance on things like this…”

lines.japanese: 「電子レンジか熱湯でそのまま加熱可」
lines.english: “You can microwave it in the pack or heat it in boiling water.”

lines.japanese: 「もう住む気まんまんね」
lines.english: “You really are planning to move in, aren't you?”

lines.japanese:
「安いんだよ。賞味期限が近くてさ。
　一食６０円くらいだよ」
lines.english: “They were cheap. The best-by date is almost up. About sixty yen a serving.”

lines.japanese:
「今度はレトルトカレーをまたどこかで調達してき
　て……と」
lines.english: “Next I'll need to find some packets of curry somewhere…”

lines.japanese: 「どこで買ってきたのよそんなもの？」
lines.english: “Where did you even buy all that?”

lines.japanese: 「ワンコインショップでたまに箱売りしてる」
lines.english: “The single-price shop sells them by the case now and then.”

lines.japanese: 「怪しすぎる……」
lines.english: “That sounds incredibly shady…”

lines.japanese: 「食べる？」
lines.english: “Want one?”

lines.japanese: 「食べぬ」
lines.english: “I shall not.”

lines.japanese: わしわしと首を振る。
lines.english: She shook her head vigorously.

lines.japanese:
「間食は危険なのだと言うこと、ゆめゆめ忘れるで
　ない」
lines.english: “Never, ever forget that snacking is fraught with peril.”

lines.japanese:
老女のように言った。
　眼光が妙に鋭い。
　深い事情があるのやもしれぬ、と忍は感じいった。
lines.english: She sounded like an old woman. Her eyes were strangely fierce. Perhaps there was some weighty story behind it. Shinobu found himself impressed.

lines.japanese: 「それよりぼんやり突っ立ってないで座ったら？」
lines.english: “Instead of standing there in a daze, why don't you sit down?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん」
lines.english: “Oh. Sure.”

lines.japanese:
「ここの集まりにおける公序良俗の話でも
　しましょう」
lines.english: “Let's have a little talk about public order and good morals at these gatherings.”

lines.japanese: いやだなあ、と思った。
lines.english: Oh, no, he thought.

lines.japanese: 「コレ置いてくる」
lines.english: “I'm going to put this away.”
“Mm.”

lines.japanese:
工場に来て最初にやることといえば、たいていは
一杯のお茶。
lines.english: The first order of business at the factory was usually a cup of tea.

lines.japanese:
舌が焼けるようなコーヒーをすすりながら、笛子
の側をちらちらとうかがう。
lines.english: Sipping coffee hot enough to scald his tongue, Shinobu kept stealing glances at Fueko.

lines.japanese: （怒ると怖いだけだけど）
lines.english: (She's scary when she's mad, though.)

lines.japanese: （黙ってると美人だなぁ）
lines.english: (But when she's quiet, she really is beautiful.)

lines.japanese: 失礼なことを忍は想像していた。
lines.english: Shinobu was entertaining some very rude thoughts.
“…What?”
“Nothing…”

lines.japanese:
目をそらす。
　心にひやりとしたものが走り、慌ててしまった。
lines.english: He looked away. A chill ran through his heart, leaving him flustered.

lines.japanese:
こういう部分が、昔に比べて弱腰になったと感じ
られる。
lines.english: Moments like this made him feel more timid than he used to be.

lines.japanese:
以前は相手の感情など、理解することもできなか
った。
lines.english: Once, he had not even been capable of understanding another person's feelings.

lines.japanese:
反面、心が冷えることもなかったわけだが。
　これは強くなったのか、弱くなったのか？
　優劣の差などないのではないか。
lines.english: Then again, his heart had never gone cold back then. Had he grown stronger, or weaker? Perhaps neither was better than the other.

lines.japanese:
自分はまったく成長などしていないのではないか。
　いろいろなことを考えさせられる。
lines.english: Perhaps he had not grown at all. The thought gave him plenty to ponder.
“…Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「え、はい、なんでしょう？」
lines.english: “Oh—yes? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「最近、よく目をそらすのよね……」
lines.english: “You look away from me a lot these days…”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな？　気のせいじゃない」
lines.english: “Do I? Maybe you're imagining it.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: ストレートに問いかけてきた。
lines.english: She asked him point-blank.

lines.japanese: 「ん、それはきっと、あれだ」
lines.english: “Well, I'm sure it's… you know.”

lines.japanese: 「なによ」
lines.english: “Know what?”

lines.japanese:
「自意識の成長というか、芽生えというか、
　０の発見というか」
lines.english: “The growth of self-consciousness—or its awakening—or the discovery of zero.”

lines.japanese: 「なにそのインド人」
lines.english: “What are you, an Indian mathematician?”

lines.japanese: 「自分でもよくわからないんだ」
lines.english: “I'm not sure myself.”

lines.japanese: 舌が火傷しそうなコーヒーをすする。
lines.english: He took another sip of the coffee hot enough to burn his tongue.

lines.japanese: 「最近、異性を意識するようになってきた……」
lines.english: “Lately, I've started noticing the opposite sex…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あんた……それって……」
lines.english: “Y-you… You mean…”

lines.japanese: 「なぜだろう」
lines.english: “I wonder why.”

lines.japanese: 「訊かないでよそんな生々しいこと」
lines.english: “Don't ask me something that graphic.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさだけは平気なんだけどな」
lines.english: “Azusa is the one exception. I'm fine around her.”

lines.japanese:
「……本人の前で言わないようにね。
　あの子気にして死ぬわ」
lines.english: “…Don't say that in front of her. She'll worry herself to death.”
“Die?!”

lines.japanese: 「だいたい、きついって。言い方が」
lines.english: “The way you put it is brutal.”

lines.japanese: 「いやってことじゃないよ？」
lines.english: “I don't mean I dislike her.”

lines.japanese:
「その……うーんと……今まですっ飛ばしていた分、
　反動が来たような」
lines.english: “It's just… well… Maybe I'm feeling the backlash for everything I skipped over before.”

lines.japanese: 「反動って何よ？」
lines.english: “What kind of backlash?”

lines.japanese:
「若い日に失ったものを、僕は取り戻しかけている
　のかも知れない」
lines.english: “Perhaps I'm finally beginning to recover what I lost in my youth.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、自分に酔ってるトコ悪いんだけどさ……」
lines.english: “Sorry to interrupt while you're busy admiring yourself, but…”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「このチームを作ったのあんたでしょ？」
lines.english: “You're the one who put this group together, remember?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「ナンパしまくりだったじゃない？」
lines.english: “And you went around hitting on girl after girl, remember?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
「失うもなにも、ピュアな感情が少しでもあったな
　ら、そんなことはしないでしょう」
lines.english: “Lose what? If you'd ever had even the slightest trace of innocence, you wouldn't have done any of that.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうですね」
lines.english: “…I suppose not.”

lines.japanese:
「もう意識とかそういう段階じゃないのよ。
　しっかりしてよね、リーダーさん」
lines.english: “You're well past the stage of merely noticing girls. Get a grip, Mr. Leader.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……」
lines.english: “Sorry…”

lines.japanese:
「忍がいなかったらこのグループ、バラバラなんだ
　から」
lines.english: “Without you, this group would fall to pieces.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それは困る」
lines.english: “Th-that would be bad.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: まじまじと見つめられる。
lines.english: She stared hard at him.

lines.japanese:
「忍なりにいろいろと悩んではいるのは本当みたい
　ね」
lines.english: “It looks like you really do worry about all sorts of things, in your own way.”

lines.japanese: 「当たりまえです」
lines.english: “Of course I do.”

lines.japanese:
「前は、ずけずけ人の心に踏みこんできたじゃない。
　あの調子でいけばいいのよ」
lines.english: “You used to barge straight into people's hearts without a second thought. Just keep doing that.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことしたっけ？」
lines.english: “Did I?”

lines.japanese:
「他の子たちもそうやって集めたんでしょう？
　斎とか葉子とか、そうとう強引だったみたいじゃ
　ない。聞いてるんだから」
lines.english: “That's how you brought everyone else together, isn't it? From what I've heard, you were awfully pushy with Itsuki and Youko, for example.”

lines.japanese:
「……まあ、あの頃はねー。
　何も知らないがゆえの無神経さというか」
lines.english: “…Well, that was back then. Maybe ignorance simply made me insensitive.”

lines.japanese:
「ねえ、そういえば私って、忍ともう何年になるん
　だっけ？」
lines.english: “Hey, come to think of it, how many years has it been since you and I met?”

lines.japanese: 「つきあい」
lines.english: “How long we've known each other.”

lines.japanese: 「えーと……」
lines.english: “Let's see…”

lines.japanese: 「たくさん」
lines.english: “A lot.”

lines.japanese: 「お子ちゃまがいるわ」
lines.english: “What are you, five?”

lines.japanese: 「忘れちゃった」
lines.english: “I forgot.”

lines.japanese:
一瞬むくれかけた笛子だが、すぐにぽっかりと口
をあけて固まった。
lines.english: Fueko started to pout, but then her mouth fell open and she froze.
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: 居心地悪そうに頭をかいた。
lines.english: She scratched her head awkwardly.

lines.japanese:
「……ごめん。じゃないか。
　ありがとう、ってことになるのかしらね」
lines.english: “…Sorry. No, that's not it. I suppose I ought to say thank you.”
“Wh-what?”

lines.japanese:
「私の場合、そんな長くはなかったわね。
　というか一人だけつきあいが短いわけで」
lines.english: “In my case, it hasn't been that long. I'm the only one who's known you for less time.”

lines.japanese:
「気を遣わせるような質問しちゃったか……
　うー、こういうの苦手ー」
lines.english: “I went and asked you a question you had to tiptoe around… Ugh, I'm so bad at this.”

lines.japanese:
頭を抱える。
　今度は忍が慌てる番だった。
lines.english: She buried her head in her hands. Now it was Shinobu's turn to panic.

lines.japanese: 「違うよ。本当に忘れたからだって」
lines.english: “No, really. I honestly forgot.”

lines.japanese:
「笛子が一番最後なのは確かだけど、そんなこと気
　にする必要ないってば」
lines.english: “You were definitely the last to join us, but that's nothing you need to worry about.”

lines.japanese: 「……うん、あんがと」
lines.english: “…Yeah. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしちゃったの？　なんかヘンだよ」
lines.english: “What's wrong? You're acting weird.”

lines.japanese: 「僕がヘンな話したから伝染しちゃった？」
lines.english: “Was my weird little speech contagious?”

lines.japanese: 「別にそういうわけでは……ないんだけど」
lines.english: “It's not exactly… that.”

lines.japanese:
靴を脱いで、ソファの上で膝を抱える。膝頭に額
をつけた。
lines.english: She slipped off her shoes, drew her knees up on the sofa, and pressed her forehead to them.

lines.japanese: 「私、うまくできてる？」
lines.english: “Am I doing it right?”

lines.japanese: 「……うまくって」
lines.english: “Doing what right?”

lines.japanese: 「皆のオトモダチ、うまくやれてる？」
lines.english: “Being everyone's friend. Am I doing that right?”

lines.japanese: その意味するところを察し、忍のトーンが下がる。
lines.english: His voice dropped as he understood what she meant.

lines.japanese: 「笛子」
lines.english: “Fueko.”

lines.japanese:
「……トモダチにうまくも下手もない。
　そんな定義、知らないよ」
lines.english: “…You can't be good or bad at being friends. At least, I've never heard it defined that way.”

lines.japanese:
「私がちゃんと人間関係やれてるのかなって、気に
　なったのよ」
lines.english: “I started wondering whether I was doing relationships right.”

lines.japanese:
「一度気になったら、もうなかなか頭を離れなくて
　……ずっと考えてたの」
lines.english: “Once I started wondering, I couldn't get it out of my head… I've been thinking about it ever since.”

lines.japanese: 「笛子は笛子だよ。よくやってくれてるよ」
lines.english: “You’re Fueko. You’re doing just fine.”

lines.japanese:
「……うん、一応、足りないところを補うようには
　してるけど」
lines.english: “…I do try to make up for whatever's missing.”

lines.japanese:
笛子の率直な言葉は、忍を黙らせる。
　心の平穏が訪れる前に口を開けば、こぼれる浮つ
いた声。
lines.english: Fueko’s frankness silenced Shinobu. If he spoke before his heart settled, his voice would come out all fluttery.

lines.japanese: 「い、いてくれるだけでいいんだって」
lines.english: “J-just having you here is enough.”

lines.japanese:
「でもポジションっていうのがあるじゃない。あず
　さはあんな感じ、沙也加はこんな感じ。みんなう
　まく棲み分けてる。じゃあ私はどうなのかなって」
lines.english: “But everyone has a role. Azusa has hers, Sayaka has hers. Everyone's carved out a little niche. So where does that leave me?”

lines.japanese: 「笛子は笛子らしいと思うけどね」
lines.english: “I think you're you, through and through.”

lines.japanese:
しばし考え込む。
　その丸まった背中にかぶせるよう、正論を重ねて
いく。
lines.english: She sat thinking for a while. As she hunched there, Shinobu kept piling on one reasonable argument after another.

lines.japanese:
「無理することはないよ。無理するための集まりで
　もないし」
lines.english: “You don’t have to force yourself. That’s not what we get together for.”

lines.japanese:
「波長だって合ってる。決定的な対立なんて、起こ
　る気配もないし」
lines.english: “You're on the same wavelength as everyone else. There isn't even a sign of any decisive conflict.”

lines.japanese: 「……私がちょっとうるさいくらいね」
lines.english: “…I'm just a little too loud, that's all.”

lines.japanese: 自嘲。
lines.english: Self-mockery.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあそれが笛のポジションってことで」
lines.english: “Then being loud can be your role, Fue.”

lines.japanese: 「……優しいのね」
lines.english: “…That's kind of you.”

lines.japanese: 濡れた瞳に射抜かれて、忍はどきりとした。
lines.english: Her glistening eyes caught Shinobu off guard, and his heart skipped a beat.

lines.japanese:
「昔は機械みたいに有無を言わせない感じだったけ
　ど、最近の忍はすごく繊細に見える」
lines.english: “You used to be like a machine, never giving anyone a chance to object, but lately you seem so sensitive.”
“…Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「いいことだとは、思うわよ？」
lines.english: “I do think that's a good thing, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな？」
lines.english: “You do?”

lines.japanese: 「伊月、今日三時集合。復唱」
lines.english: “Izuki. Three o'clock today. Repeat.”

lines.japanese: 事務的な言い方だった。
lines.english: Her delivery was brisk and businesslike.

lines.japanese: 「はいぃ？」
lines.english: “Whaaat?”

lines.japanese: 「昔の忍の真似」
lines.english: “That's my old-Shinobu impression.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなだったっけ？」
lines.english: “W-was I really like that?”

lines.japanese: 「どこの軍隊かと思ったわよ」
lines.english: “I thought I'd joined the army.”

lines.japanese:
思い返す。
　確かにそんな時代もあった。
lines.english: He thought back. Yes, he really had gone through a phase like that.

lines.japanese:
けれど自分で抱いていた印象は、他者のそれとは
ずいぶんと違うもので、根暗ではなく機械的と思わ
れていたことは意外だった。
lines.english: But the person he imagined himself to be was quite different. He had thought of himself as gloomy, not mechanical, so this came as a surprise.

lines.japanese: 「でも復唱は嘘だよね？」
lines.english: “But the part about repeating the order was made up, right?”

lines.japanese:
「当たり前じゃない、解説させないでよ冗談でしょ。
　察しなさいよ」
lines.english: “Obviously. Don't make me explain a joke. You're supposed to figure it out.”

lines.japanese: 「……痛いよ」
lines.english: “…Ouch.”

lines.japanese: 「あの頃はね、正直ちょっと楽だった」
lines.english: “Honestly, things were a little easier back then.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「忍に言われるまま従っていれば良かったから」
lines.english: “Because all I had to do was follow your orders.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ」
lines.english: “Wow.”

lines.japanese:
「……慣れてなかったから。
　ああいう対等の関係って」
lines.english: “…I wasn't used to it. Being in an equal relationship like that.”

lines.japanese: 「すっかり慣れて、とけこんだじゃない」
lines.english: “But you're completely at home here now.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうね」
lines.english: “…I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、どこか引っかかるの」
lines.english: “But something about it still bothers me.”
“Fueko…”

lines.japanese:
「何が引っかかっているのかよくわからないの。た
　ぶん、このグループの一人としてうまくできてい
　るかどうか、自信がないんだと思うんだけど」
lines.english: “I don't really know what's bothering me. Maybe I just don't trust myself to fit in as one member of this group.”

lines.japanese:
ふと顔を上げた笛子は、忍の慈愛に満ちた表情に
たじろいだ。
lines.english: Fueko looked up, then recoiled at the boundless compassion on Shinobu's face.
“Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: 「いい兆候だと思うよ、それ」
lines.english: “I think that's a good sign.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう？」
lines.english: “Y-you do?”

lines.japanese:
「ま、悩んでる笛子には悪いと思うけど……
　要するにそれって、自意識の目覚めってやつじゃ
　ない？」
lines.english: “I feel bad saying it when you're worried, but… isn't this just what people call the awakening of self-consciousness?”

lines.japanese:
「……って言うには、ちょっと年食い過ぎてると思
　うんだけど……」
lines.english: “…I think I'm a little too old for that…”

lines.japanese: 「僕と一緒だ」
lines.english: “Just like me.”

lines.japanese: 「眩しい笑顔ねー……」
lines.english: “That smile of yours is blinding…”

lines.japanese:
「いろいろな価値観に触れ、人間的に成長していく
　わけですよ」
lines.english: “We encounter different values and grow as people.”

lines.japanese: 「まるで教養小説だわ」
lines.english: “It's like a Bildungsroman.”

lines.japanese:
「笛子が納得できる自分になれるなら、僕は嬉しい
　よ！」
lines.english: “If you become someone you can be happy with, then I'll be happy too!”

lines.japanese:
空気が重くなる。
　いや、忍のいる側は奇妙に華やぎ、笛子のいる側
だけがどんよりと曇っていた。
lines.english: The air grew heavy. Or rather, it grew strangely bright on Shinobu's side and overcast only on Fueko's.

lines.japanese: 「……またあんたもいけしゃあしゃあと甘言を……」
lines.english: “…There you go again, shamelessly laying on the sweet talk…”

lines.japanese:
「そーゆー態度であちこちいい人トークバラまいて
　ると、後にいろいろな問題を起こすと―――」
lines.english: “If you go around handing out that Mr. Nice Guy routine, you're going to cause yourself all kinds of trouble later—”

lines.japanese: 突きつけた指を、すとんと落とした。
lines.english: Her accusing finger dropped.

lines.japanese: 「……いいわよ、もう。励ましてくれてあんがと」
lines.english: “…All right, forget it. Thanks for trying to cheer me up.”

lines.japanese: 「投げやりがちだね」
lines.english: “You're a little give-uppy, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「そんな言葉ない」
lines.english: “That isn't a word.”

lines.japanese: すっくと立ち上がった。
lines.english: She shot to her feet.

lines.japanese:
「まあとにかく、ここくらいではしゃんとしてない
　とね」
lines.english: “Anyway, I need to at least keep myself together while I'm here.”

lines.japanese: ひっかかるものは感じたのだ。
lines.english: Something about that bothered him.

lines.japanese: “ここ”くらいでは―――
lines.english: At least while she was ‘here’—

lines.japanese:
では“ここ”ではない場所とはどこか。
　工場ではない場所。
lines.english: Then where was the place that wasn't ‘here’? Somewhere other than the factory.

lines.japanese:
世間一般ではそれは笛子の行動範囲全てだろうが、
忍は規定範囲を大胆に狭めた。
lines.english: Ordinarily, that would mean everywhere in Fueko's life beyond the factory, but Shinobu boldly narrowed the scope.

lines.japanese: 「最近、家の方はどうなの？」
lines.english: “How are things at home lately?”

lines.japanese: きょとんとされる。
lines.english: She gave him a blank look.
“What, home?”

lines.japanese: 「ご実家に問題でも、と思っちゃったわけだけど」
lines.english: “I thought maybe something was wrong with your family.”

lines.japanese: 「家にはおかしいところはないってば」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, there's nothing wrong at home.”

lines.japanese: 「四人家族元気いっぱい」
lines.english: “A family of four, all full of life.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そう……」
lines.english: “Oh. Right…”
“So in other words—”

lines.japanese: 言いかけるのを、片手で遮る。
lines.english: She cut him off with one hand.

lines.japanese: 「あー、いいからいいから。その話は」
lines.english: “No, never mind. Let's drop that.”

lines.japanese: 「湿った話はここまでにしましょう」
lines.english: “Let's stop with the gloomy talk.”

lines.japanese: 湿った話だということがわかってしまった。
lines.english: So there was something gloomy to talk about after all.

lines.japanese:
「とりあえずみんなから嫌われてないなら、それで
　いいのよ」
lines.english: “For now, if nobody hates me, that's good enough.”

lines.japanese: 「むしろ好きだけど……」
lines.english: “Actually, I like you…”

lines.japanese:
「そーゆーことを
　誰にでも言、う、な、と！」
lines.english: “Don't. Say. Things. Like. That. To every girl!”

lines.japanese: 耳をひねられる。
lines.english: She twisted his ear.

lines.japanese: 「いたいいたいよ笛子いたい」
lines.english: “Ow, ow, Fueko, that hurts!”

lines.japanese: 「いっつか刺されるんだから、女関係で」
lines.english: “One day, some woman is going to stab you over this.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、本気でいたいなそれは、それは！」
lines.english: “Yikes, that'd really hurt! It really would!”

lines.japanese:
「そんな情けない死に方しても葬式出てあげないか
　ら！」
lines.english: “If that's how you die, I'm not even coming to your funeral!”

lines.japanese: 「たたたた……」
lines.english: “Ow-ow-ow…”

lines.japanese:
「ま、浮気性についての沙汰はこれでおしまい。
　存在意義の話もね。
　気にしてる方がバカみたいだし」
lines.english: “All right, that concludes judgment on your flirtatious ways. And on my purpose in life. I feel stupid for worrying about it now.”

lines.japanese: 「う、浮気性ってなんだよう……」
lines.english: “A f-flirt? What did I do…”

lines.japanese: 「忍＝浮気性。理解できた？　ご反論は？」
lines.english: “Shinobu equals flirt. Understood? Any objections?”

lines.japanese:
「……納得いかない。
　そんなの章二みたいだよ。最低の人間だ」
lines.english: “…I don't accept that. You're making me sound like Shouji. He's the worst.”

lines.japanese: むすっとしたままの忍。
lines.english: Shinobu remained in a sulk.

lines.japanese: 「あんたもたいがい言うわねぇ……」
lines.english: “You really don't pull your punches either…”

lines.japanese:
「じゃ訊くけど、あずさと沙也加と葉子の中で、
　一番好きなのは誰？」
lines.english: “Then let me ask: of Azusa, Sayaka, and Youko, who do you like best?”

lines.japanese:
十秒ほど長考していた。
　そしてマネキンの笑顔。
lines.english: He thought about it for roughly ten seconds. Then he gave her a mannequin’s smile.

lines.japanese: 「みんな好きかな！」
lines.english: “I think I like everyone!”

lines.japanese: 「……このガキっ、ジゴロガキっ」
lines.english: “…You little brat! You pint-sized gigolo!”

lines.japanese: 「いたいいたい笛子いたいっ！」
lines.english: “Ow, ow, Fueko, that hurts!”

lines.japanese:
「いつまでそんなこと言っていられるか、私が見守っ
　てあげるから覚悟なさいな」
lines.english: “I'll be watching to see how long you can keep saying that, so prepare yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「いつまでも」
lines.english: “Forever.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことあるわけないでしょ。まったく」
lines.english: “That's impossible. Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「……いつかバラバラになるんだから」
lines.english: “…Someday we'll all go our separate ways.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなの想定してない」
lines.english: “That's not in my plans.”

lines.japanese:
「って、じゃあ私たちは一生ここで集まってなんか
　してるわけ？」
lines.english: “What, so we're going to spend our whole lives gathering here and doing… whatever it is we do?”

lines.japanese: 「できたら」
lines.english: “If we can.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ場所はここでなくてもいいけど……」
lines.english: “It doesn't have to be here, of course…”

lines.japanese: 「大人になったら自分で場所用意してもいいし」
lines.english: “Once I'm an adult, I can find us a place myself.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そこまで言えればたいしたものねー」
lines.english: “Wow. That's quite a promise.”

lines.japanese: 肩をすくめる。
lines.english: She shrugged.

lines.japanese: 「駄目？」
lines.english: “Is that bad?”

lines.japanese: 「……駄目じゃないけど。現実的にどうかなと」
lines.english: “…Not bad. I just don't know how realistic it is.”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろと難しいと思うわよ？」
lines.english: “It wouldn't be easy, for all kinds of reasons.”

lines.japanese: 「だろうけど……でも……僕は続けたいよ」
lines.english: “Probably… But… I want us to keep this going.”

lines.japanese: 「そのときには笛子にだっていて欲しいし」
lines.english: “And when the time comes, I want you there too.”

lines.japanese: 「げ、社会人になっても？」
lines.english: “Ugh—even once we have jobs?”

lines.japanese: 「げって何、げって！」
lines.english: “What's ‘ugh’ supposed to mean?!”

lines.japanese:
「……たとえ６０歳になってもこの会合は続けます
　よ？」
lines.english: “…Even when we're sixty, I plan to keep these meetings going.”

lines.japanese: ちょっと泣きそうな顔で言う。
lines.english: He looked ready to cry as he said it.

lines.japanese: 「泣きそうになるな……」
lines.english: “Don't cry about it…”

lines.japanese: 「続けますよ」
lines.english: “I'm going to keep them going.”

lines.japanese: 「……あー、わかったわかった。わかったから」
lines.english: “…Fine, fine, I get it. I get it.”

lines.japanese: 「こういうのは一生なんだよ！」
lines.english: “This is for life!”

lines.japanese: 忍は拗ねている。
lines.english: Shinobu was sulking.

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、そうね……ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Yes, yes, you're right… I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese:
「だから、今まで一緒にいた時間が長い短いなんて、
　関係ないんだ」
lines.english: “So it doesn't matter whether we've spent years together or only a little while.”

lines.japanese: 「関係ない」
lines.english: “It doesn't matter.”

lines.japanese:
むくれた忍は、必死に否定する子供のようで。
　優しい表情を浮かべ、笛子は忍の髪に触れた。
　顔を覆った忍はあまりにも小さい。
lines.english: Sulking, Shinobu looked like a child desperately insisting it wasn't true. Fueko touched his hair with a tender smile. Behind the hands covering his face, Shinobu seemed terribly small.

lines.japanese:
立場の逆転を滑稽に思いながらも、いつものよう
に無碍に反発することはできなかった。
lines.english: The reversal of their roles seemed absurd, yet he could not brush her off as he normally would.

lines.japanese: 「そういえばさー」
lines.english: “Oh, that reminds me.”
“Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「四人家族っていうと……」
lines.english: “When you say a family of four…”

lines.japanese: 「両親と私と妹」
lines.english: “My parents, my little sister, and me.”

lines.japanese: 「親は今、海外に行ってるけど」
lines.english: “My parents are overseas at the moment, though.”

lines.japanese: 「へー。旅行？」
lines.english: “Oh? On vacation?”

lines.japanese: 「仕事」
lines.english: “Work.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、じゃあ？」
lines.english: “Wait. Then…?”

lines.japanese: 「そう。姉妹二人暮らし」
lines.english: “Right. It's just the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「へぇーほぉー」
lines.english: “Oh-ho.”

lines.japanese: 「そっちも似たようなものじゃない」
lines.english: “Your situation isn't that different.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、姉と」
lines.english: “True. It’s me and my older sister.”

lines.japanese: 「だけどこっちは社会人だし」
lines.english: “But she's a working adult.”

lines.japanese:
「うちの方はね、親戚が週一で様子見に来る。
　週末だけね」
lines.english: “In our case, a relative comes to check on us once a week. Only on weekends.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、ほとんど形骸化した様子見で、あまり感心
　できたことじゃないんだろうけど」
lines.english: “Though by now the check-ins are mostly an empty formality. It's probably nothing to be proud of.”

lines.japanese: 「うち、親はアバウトだから……」
lines.english: “My parents are pretty lax about things…”

lines.japanese: 「お金は？」
lines.english: “What about money?”

lines.japanese:
「生活費用の口座に振り込まれるのよ。公共料金と
　かも自動引き落としの口座が別にあって、そっち
　から自動で」
lines.english: “They deposit our living expenses into one account. There's another account for the utilities and everything, and those payments come out automatically.”

lines.japanese: 「しっかりするわけだ」
lines.english: “That explains why you're so capable.”

lines.japanese: 「……誉めたって何も出ませんからね」
lines.english: “…Flattery won't get you anything.”

lines.japanese: 微警戒。
lines.english: A flicker of suspicion.

lines.japanese: 「ははは」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「で、妹子さんは？」
lines.english: “And how is Miss Imoko?”

lines.japanese: 「おののいもこ、は男よ」
lines.english: “Ono no Imoko was a man.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか」
lines.english: “Impossible.”

lines.japanese: 忍は信じなかった。
lines.english: Shinobu did not believe her.

lines.japanese:
「まあいいわ……っと、一応元気でやってるみたい。
　うろちょろして鬱陶しいったら。
　でも私と同じ学校は目指してるみたいね」
lines.english: “Oh, never mind… Anyway, she seems to be doing fine. She's always underfoot; it's incredibly annoying. But apparently she wants to go to the same school as me.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
「今のうちから勉強しないと受からないぞーって
　脅すと泣くのよね」
lines.english: “She cries when I tell her she'll never get in unless she starts studying now.”

lines.japanese: 「いじめだ……」
lines.english: “That's bullying…”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そーそー、この間あの子ったら―――」
lines.english: “Oh, right, right! The other day, she—”

lines.japanese: 話しはじめる笛子を、見守った。
lines.english: He watched her begin her story.

lines.japanese: 「でね―――って、どうしたの？　変な顔して」
lines.english: “And then—Wait, what's wrong? You're making a strange face.”

lines.japanese: 「え、変な顔、してた？」
lines.english: “Was I? Did I look strange?”

lines.japanese: 「してたわね。物憂いというか」
lines.english: “You were. You looked melancholy.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……姉妹仲がいいんだなって想像してた」
lines.english: “No… I was just imagining how close you two must be.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね、良いわよ。向こうもまだ小さいしね」
lines.english: “We are. She's still little, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese:
「ずいぶんと歳が離れてるせいもあるけど、逆らわ
　ないし、それに……遊んであげると本当に嬉しそ
　うだし」
lines.english: “Maybe it's partly because we're so far apart in age, but she never talks back, and… she's genuinely delighted whenever I play with her.”

lines.japanese: と語る口元がゆるむ。
lines.english: A smile crept over her lips as she spoke.

lines.japanese: 「お姉ちゃんが好きなんだ」
lines.english: “She loves her big sister.”

lines.japanese: 「……まあね」
lines.english: “…I suppose she does.”

lines.japanese: 自分が誉められたかのように、笛子は頬を染めた。
lines.english: Fueko blushed as though he had complimented her.

lines.japanese: 「さてと」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 立ち上がる。
lines.english: He stood.

lines.japanese: 「飲み物どーする？」
lines.english: “What do you want to drink?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、お願い。珈琲にしようかな」
lines.english: “Oh, yes, please. I think I'll have coffee.”

lines.japanese: 「了解。ブラック無糖ノンシュガーね」
lines.english: “Got it. Black, unsweetened, sugar-free.”

lines.japanese: 「だからそれ三重にかぶってるって」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, all three of those mean the same thing.”

lines.japanese: 「心理的に楽でしょ？」
lines.english: “But it feels safer that way, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「……かじるわよ」
lines.english: “…I'll bite you.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、黒無糖」
lines.english: “Here. Black, no sugar.”

lines.japanese: 「あんがと」
lines.english: “Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「……おいしい。いつも思うけど、本当においしい」
lines.english: “…Delicious. Every time I have it, I think the same thing: this really is delicious.”

lines.japanese:
「駅前のフランベルジュのブルマンに比べると、全然
　なんだよね」
lines.english: “It's nothing next to the Blue Mountain at Flamberge by the station.”

lines.japanese:
「プロに張り合ってるの？　そりゃ上達するわね……
　あ、おいし……たまらない」
lines.english: “You're competing with professionals? No wonder you've improved… Oh, that's good… I can't get enough.”

lines.japanese:
「やっぱりちゃんとした機材と腕がないとどうにも
　ならない味もあるんだけどね」
lines.english: “Some flavors just aren't possible without proper equipment and the skill to use it, though.”

lines.japanese: 「どっかに落ちていたらいいわね」
lines.english: “If only you could find both lying around somewhere.”

lines.japanese:
「めちゃくちゃ高いんだよね……ああいうマシーン
　は……」
lines.english: “Those machines cost a fortune… They really do…”

lines.japanese: 「これ挽きたての味？」
lines.english: “Is this what freshly ground coffee tastes like?”

lines.japanese: 「そう。買ってきたばかり豆」
lines.english: “Yes. I just bought the beans.”

lines.japanese:
「パック保存してても、あっという間に味落ちるか
　ら、すぐ飲みきろうね」
lines.english: “Even sealed up, the beans lose their flavor in no time, so let's finish them quickly.”

lines.japanese:
「うーん……珈琲はあまり好きじゃないけど、忍の
　はおいしいわ」
lines.english: “Hmm… I don't usually care much for coffee, but yours is delicious.”

lines.japanese: 「無糖だしね」
lines.english: “And sugar-free.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、無糖だから脂肪が―――」
lines.english: “Exactly. And because there's no sugar, the fat—”

lines.japanese: 「……そのことはよろしい」
lines.english: “…That will be quite enough of that.”
“…Yes.”

lines.japanese: 二人はがぶがぶ飲んだ。
lines.english: The two of them gulped it down.

lines.japanese: 「いつでも嫁に行っていいわ。許可します」
lines.english: “You’re ready to be a bride anytime. You have my permission.”

lines.japanese: 「コーヒーだけでどうなるんだ……つうか嫁って」
lines.english: “How does making coffee qualify me for marriage…? And why am I the bride?”

lines.japanese: 「忍はなんか養われそう」
lines.english: “I can somehow picture someone supporting you.”

lines.japanese: 「心外だ！」
lines.english: “How insulting!”

lines.japanese: 「そもそも誰のトコに？」
lines.english: “Whose family am I supposed to marry into, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “Let's see.”

lines.japanese:
んむーと考える。
　一生を左右する決断にふさわしい顔ではなかった。
lines.english: She pondered with a thoughtful little hum. It was hardly the face of someone making a decision that would shape a life.

lines.japanese:
いちご味とメロン味のどっちを選ぶかという類の、
面持ちだった。
lines.english: She looked more like someone choosing between strawberry and melon flavors.

lines.japanese: 「うちの妹のとこ？」
lines.english: “My little sister?”

lines.japanese: 「疑問符で来られてもなぁ」
lines.english: “The question mark isn't reassuring.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたら義弟ね。便利そう」
lines.english: “Then you'd be my brother-in-law. That sounds useful.”

lines.japanese: 「……ほろ苦い人生」
lines.english: “…A bittersweet life.”

lines.japanese:
ほろ苦すぎたので、ちょっと仕返ししてやろうと
思った。
lines.english: It was far too bitter, so he decided to take a little revenge.

lines.japanese:
「……どうせなら笛子の方と結婚って話にならない
　の？」
lines.english: “…If I'm marrying into the family anyway, why can't I marry you instead?”

lines.japanese:
豪快にむせた。
　白い制服と珈琲の組み合わせは、惨憺たるものが
ある。
lines.english: She choked spectacularly. White uniforms and coffee were a disastrous combination.

lines.japanese: 「あーあーあーあー」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, no.”

lines.japanese: 「……な、な、なんてこと言うのよ！」
lines.english: “…Wh-wh-what are you saying?!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ？」
lines.english: “Beats me.”

lines.japanese: 「とぼけないでよ！」
lines.english: “Don't play dumb!”

lines.japanese: 「あ……制服が……染みに……」
lines.english: “Oh… My uniform… It's going to leave a stain…”

lines.japanese: 「……いやぁ」
lines.english: “…Whew.”

lines.japanese: 「ご苦労様……」
lines.english: “You poor thing…”

lines.japanese: 「死ぬかと思った」
lines.english: “I thought I was going to die.”

lines.japanese:
「ストレスで死にかけるのって、おなかの底がよじ
　られるみたいな痛みがあるね」
lines.english: “I learned something: when stress nearly kills you, it feels like something is twisting the very bottom of your stomach.”

lines.japanese: 「味わいたくないわね……」
lines.english: “I'd rather not find out…”

lines.japanese: 「まずい」
lines.english: “Tastes awful.”

lines.japanese:
空になったレトルトライスの容器にスプーンを放
り込んで、そんなことを言う。
lines.english: He dropped his spoon into the empty instant-rice tray and delivered his verdict.

lines.japanese: 「本当にこの男だけは」
lines.english: “This man. Honestly.”

lines.japanese:
「缶詰が駄目だな。ライスはそこそこだ。
　レトルトライスなんてパサついて、カレーでも
　なけりゃ食えたものじゃないと思っていたが」
lines.english: “The canned stuff's the problem. The rice is all right. I always thought instant rice was too dry to eat unless you had curry with it, but…”

lines.japanese: 「レトルトのライスではそこが一番だね」
lines.english: “That's the best instant rice there is.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。だがやはり、カレーだ。忍よ」
lines.english: “Yeah. But curry is still the answer, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「いかにも」
lines.english: “Indubitably.”

lines.japanese: 「カレーいいな」
lines.english: “Curry sounds good.”

lines.japanese:
「オレは辛いのが好みだ。
　２０倍のやつがあったら頼むぜ」
lines.english: “I like it hot. If you find the twenty-times-hot kind, get me some.”
“…Gack.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ用に甘いのも買ってくるよ」
lines.english: “I'll get a mild one for you, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「やた！」
lines.english: “Yay!”

lines.japanese:
「来るのが遅かったので、もう夜になっちゃいまし
　たね」
lines.english: “We got here so late, it's dark already.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさの門限まであと３０分」
lines.english: “Thirty minutes until Azusa's curfew.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そろそろかー」
lines.english: “Oh. Guess it's almost time to go.”

lines.japanese: 「僕も帰るよ。章二は？」
lines.english: “I'll go home too. What about you, Shouji?”

lines.japanese: 「オレはバイトまで休んでいる」
lines.english: “I’m resting here until my shift starts.”

lines.japanese: 「また深夜シフト？」
lines.english: “Another night shift?”

lines.japanese: 「金がいいんだ。客も少ない」
lines.english: “The money's good. Fewer customers, too.”

lines.japanese: 「……学校で禁止されてるでしょうに」
lines.english: “…You know the school doesn't allow that.”

lines.japanese: 「昼は学校で寝る。夜は働く。完璧なシフトだ」
lines.english: “I sleep at school by day and work by night. A perfect schedule.”

lines.japanese: 「死になさい」
lines.english: “Drop dead.”

lines.japanese: 「ホントだよ」
lines.english: “Seriously.”

lines.japanese:
「……まあ試験対策も終わっているのでしょうし、
　いいんじゃない」
lines.english: “…Well, I'm sure he's finished preparing for the test, so I suppose it's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「そういやもうじきだなぁ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. That's soon, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「……しょせんは小テストだ」
lines.english: “…It's just a quiz.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、判定大きいんだって」
lines.english: “I heard this one carries a lot of weight.”

lines.japanese: 「なにぃ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「先生方も言ってましたね。
　今度の小テストはほとんど後期試験並だって」
lines.english: “I heard the teachers talking about it too. This quiz is practically an end-of-term exam.”

lines.japanese: 「聞いていないぞ」
lines.english: “Nobody told me.”

lines.japanese: 「生徒に言わないでしょ、そんなこと」
lines.english: “Of course they wouldn't tell the students.”

lines.japanese:
「……ああ、もしかしてアレ？　前のテストの時に、
　受験率が悪かったとかいう？」
lines.english: “…Oh, is this because so few people took the last test?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、きっとそれね」
lines.english: “Yes, that must be it.”

lines.japanese:
「悪戯があったんだよね。
　学校に殺人予告みたいな手紙が投函されてて」
lines.english: “There was a prank. Someone sent the school a letter that sounded like a death threat.”

lines.japanese: 「……で、愉快犯だったんでしょ？」
lines.english: “…And it was just some thrill-seeking prankster?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね。ただ手紙には切断した指が入っていた
　みたいで、試験は中断。生徒は自宅。
　緊急休校三日間」
lines.english: “Right. But apparently there was a severed finger inside, so they stopped the exam, sent everyone home, and closed the school for three days.”

lines.japanese: 「……うんざりするわね」
lines.english: “…That's sickening.”

lines.japanese: 「その指は結局、本人のものだったがな」
lines.english: “The finger turned out to be his own.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうなの？」
lines.english: “…It did?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。典型的なヤク中毒でな」
lines.english: “Yeah. A textbook junkie.”

lines.japanese:
「意外だろうがああいうのは皆、家に隠れるか節度
　を守ってやっているものだ。だからこういうジャ
　ンキー然としたやつはむしろ珍しい」
lines.english: “You might be surprised, but addicts all either hole up at home or exercise some restraint. That’s why someone who actually looks and acts like a full-on junkie is rare.”

lines.japanese: 「本当に意外ね。誉めたくはないけど」
lines.english: “That really is surprising. Not that they deserve praise.”

lines.japanese: 「どーして節度を？」
lines.english: “Why would they be restrained?”

lines.japanese: 「社会生活があるだろうが」
lines.english: “They still have to live in society.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
「よくイメージされるジャンキーの方が噂の一人歩
　きなんだ」
lines.english: “The junkie everyone pictures is mostly a stereotype that's taken on a life of its own.”

lines.japanese:
「だな。また覚醒系でも決めてうろついてりゃあ、
　瞳孔の異状でけっこうわかったりするが」
lines.english: “Pretty much. Though if somebody's wandering around hopped up on stimulants, you can often tell from their pupils.”

lines.japanese: 「実際、そいつはわかりやすかった」
lines.english: “That guy was easy to spot.”

lines.japanese:
「ついこの間、摘発があってな。その関係でネット
　売買に自主規制がかかってて、お目当てのブツが
　入手難になっていたんだろ」
lines.english: “There'd been a bust not long before. Online dealers had tightened up their own rules after that, so he must have been having trouble getting what he wanted.”

lines.japanese:
「街で下手な買い方をして、指のないヤク中ってこ
　とで、すぐに有名になった」
lines.english: “He botched a street buy, and soon everybody knew him as the junkie with the missing finger.”

lines.japanese: 「……詳しいこと」
lines.english: “…You know an awful lot about this.”

lines.japanese:
「連絡が来たんだ。
　別に好きこのんで関わったわけじゃない」
lines.english: “Word reached me. It’s not like I went looking for this.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、オレの学校のことでもあったしな。
　多少情報を回したら、翌日には警察に確保されて
　やがった」
lines.english: “It was my school, after all. I passed on a little information, and the cops had him by the next day.”

lines.japanese:
「繁華街の全ての悪の元締め―――哀れな犠牲者を
　捧げることによって、司法の手を逃れるのであっ
　た」
lines.english: “And so the kingpin behind every vice in the entertainment district evaded the hand of justice, offering up a pitiful victim in his stead.”
“…Hey.”

lines.japanese: 「きょう迫するために自分の指を……うー！」
lines.english: “His own finger, just to threaten someone… Ugh!”

lines.japanese: 我慢できないといった感じで、両手をすりあわせる。
lines.english: She rubbed her hands together as if she couldn't bear the thought.

lines.japanese: 「なんかもぎゅもぎゅするー！！」
lines.english: “It makes me feel all squirmy-mushy!”

lines.japanese: 「もぎゅもぎゅ……？」
lines.english: “Squirmy-mushy…?”

lines.japanese: 「……ヤツを今風に、超愉快犯とでも区別するか」
lines.english: “…Maybe we should update the terminology and call him a super-prankster.”

lines.japanese: 「どういう区別よ」
lines.english: “What kind of distinction is that?”

lines.japanese:
「そんな人間にならないためにも、小テストとやら
　はしっかりね」
lines.english: “And so you don't turn into someone like that, you'd better take this quiz of yours seriously.”

lines.japanese: あずさの肩を叩く。
lines.english: She patted Azusa's shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「うん、頑張る」
lines.english: “Okay. I'll do my best.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ関係ないじゃん」
lines.english: “Azusa has nothing to do with it.”

lines.japanese: 「……あ、そうか」
lines.english: “…Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 「僕と沙也加と葉子と斎と章二」
lines.english: “Me, Sayaka, Youko, Itsuki, and Shouji.”

lines.japanese:
「仲間外れみたいだなー。
　テストだから、別にいいんだけど」
lines.english: “Now I feel left out. But since it's a test, I don't really mind.”

lines.japanese: 「いいこと思いついたわ」
lines.english: “I've just had a wonderful idea.”

lines.japanese: すっくと立ち上がる。
lines.english: She sprang to her feet.

lines.japanese: 「却下」
lines.english: “Rejected.”

lines.japanese: 「注目！」
lines.english: “Attention!”

lines.japanese: 晴れ晴れと告げた。
lines.english: She announced it with a sunny smile.

lines.japanese: 「勉強会をしましょう」
lines.english: “Let's have a study session.”

lines.japanese: 場の空気はどんよりと濁った。
lines.english: The mood in the room turned instantly leaden.

lines.japanese: 自宅には千鳥がいた。
lines.english: Chidori was home.

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなさい」
lines.english: “Welcome home.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……ただいま、です」
lines.english: “Ah… I'm home.”

lines.japanese:
向こうも今帰宅したばかりなのか、部屋着に着替
えてもいない。
lines.english: Perhaps she had only just come home herself. She hadn't even changed into anything more comfortable.

lines.japanese:
もっとも千鳥はプライバシー意識が強く、普段で
も滅多に部屋着でうろついたりはしない。
lines.english: Then again, Chidori was intensely private and seldom wore casual clothes around the house anyway.

lines.japanese:
彼女がリラックスするのは自室だけ。
　しかし同居ともなれば、無防備な格好を目撃する
こともあり、たまにどきりとさせられる。
lines.english: The only place she truly relaxed was her own room. Still, living under one roof meant he occasionally caught her in an unguarded state, and now and then the sight made his heart jump.

lines.japanese:
服薬の時間だった。
　千鳥がいる前で、忍はピルケースから薬を出して
口に放り込む。
lines.english: It was time for his medicine. Under Chidori's eye, Shinobu took it from his pill case and popped it into his mouth.

lines.japanese:
姉の視線が、注がれている。
　用事があるのだろうか。
　千鳥は意識から発声に至るまで少々間がある。
lines.english: His sister’s eyes were on him. Did she want something? Chidori took a little time to move from thought to speech.

lines.japanese:
忍は微妙に目線を外したままその場に佇んだ。
　やがて、
lines.english: Shinobu remained where he was, his gaze turned just slightly aside. At last—

lines.japanese: 「……学校は、どうですか」
lines.english: “…How is school?”

lines.japanese: 「学校は」
lines.english: “School…”

lines.japanese:
にわかにためらいが生じる。
　どう話すか。
　どう語るか。
lines.english: He suddenly hesitated. How should he talk about it? How should he put it?

lines.japanese:
表情は？
　態度は？
　声量は？
lines.english: What expression? What attitude? How loud?

lines.japanese: ……内容は？
lines.english: …And what should he say?

lines.japanese: 「別に……普通です」
lines.english: “Nothing… unusual. It's normal.”

lines.japanese:
口にしてから、今のは少し不自然かもしれないと
考えた。
lines.english: The moment the words were out, he wondered if they'd sounded a little unnatural.

lines.japanese: 慌てて接ぎ木してもかえって怪しまれる。
lines.english: Tacking anything on in a panic would only make her more suspicious.

lines.japanese: 「今日も放課後、皆で集まりました」
lines.english: “I met up with everyone after school again today.”

lines.japanese: 「……樋口章二が―――」
lines.english: “…Shouji Higuchi—”

lines.japanese: 細かな部分は置いて、かいつまんで様子を説明した。
lines.english: Leaving out the details, he gave her a brief account of what had happened.

lines.japanese: こういう会話も、時には重要だからだ。
lines.english: It was important to have conversations like this from time to time.

lines.japanese: 「―――というところです」
lines.english: “—and that was about it.”

lines.japanese:
千鳥は無言で聞いていた。
　別段興味を引かれたそぶりもなければ、疎んずる
でもない。
lines.english: Chidori listened without a word. She seemed neither especially interested nor put off.

lines.japanese:
無機的に耳を傾ける印象は、録音機器の冷たさを
想像させた。
lines.english: There was something mechanical about the way she listened; it suggested the coldness of a recording device.

lines.japanese: 「そうですか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 全てを聞き終わった千鳥が、テンポ遅れで頷く。
lines.english: Only after he had finished did Chidori nod, a beat late.

lines.japanese: 静寂。
lines.english: Silence.

lines.japanese:
続く反応がなければ、会話が終わったものと見て
いい。
lines.english: If she said nothing else, he could safely assume the conversation was over.
“Dinner—”

lines.japanese: 「伊月さんは」
lines.english: “Miss Izuki…”

lines.japanese: 声が重なった。
lines.english: Their voices overlapped.
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「お元気？」
lines.english: “Is she well?”

lines.japanese: 「は、い」
lines.english: “Y-yes.”

lines.japanese:
返事が途切れる。
　その刹那で戸惑いを呑み込み、
lines.english: His answer faltered. In that instant, he swallowed his confusion and continued.

lines.japanese:
「七人の中じゃ、元気な方に入ると思います……
　それが？」
lines.english: “Of the seven of us, I'd say she's one of the livelier ones… Why do you ask?”

lines.japanese: 「いいえ、特にどうということではないんですが」
lines.english: “No. It's nothing in particular.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ彼女は、あなたたちの中で異質だと思います
　から」
lines.english: “Only that she strikes me as anomalous among you.”

lines.japanese: 「……異質って」
lines.english: “…Anomalous how?”

lines.japanese: 「あなたもそう思っているでしょう？」
lines.english: “You think so too, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そんなことは……」
lines.english: “No, I wouldn't say…”

lines.japanese:
「以前のあなただったら、今の質問に否定はなかっ
　たと思います」
lines.english: “If I had asked you that before, I do not think you would have denied it.”

lines.japanese: 「今は……その……そうは思えないので」
lines.english: “Now… well… I don't think of her that way.”

lines.japanese: 「……わかりました」
lines.english: “…I understand.”

lines.japanese:
「それに僕らは、言うなればみんなどこか変ですよ。
　うちの一人を取り上げてどうのこうのと言っても」
lines.english: “Besides, all of us are strange in one way or another. There isn't much point in singling out one of us.”

lines.japanese:
「そうでしたね。そうでなくては、わざわざあなた
　が絡む意味もないわけですが」
lines.english: “Yes, I suppose so. Otherwise, there would be no reason for you to go out of your way to involve yourself.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ関係を維持する上で必要な気遣いというもの
　はあるでしょう？」
lines.english: “Still, maintaining any relationship requires a certain measure of consideration, does it not?”

lines.japanese:
「気遣うあまり、周囲や自分のことを見失わないよ
　うになさい」
lines.english: “Do not become so consumed with looking after them that you lose sight of yourself or the people around you.”

lines.japanese: 「私はそういうことを言いたかっただけです」
lines.english: “That is all I meant to say.”

lines.japanese:
「……そのあたりは……
　ちゃんとやるつもりです……」
lines.english: “…I intend to… be careful about that…”

lines.japanese: 「わかっていますよ、忍」
lines.english: “I know, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたは真面目ですからね」
lines.english: “You are conscientious, after all.”

lines.japanese:
釘を刺されている。
　明確に理解できた。
　没頭しすぎるな。
lines.english: A warning. He understood that much perfectly. Do not become too absorbed.

lines.japanese:
千鳥はそう言っている。
　なぜか？
lines.english: That was what Chidori meant. Why?

lines.japanese: 「でも忘れないでくださいね」
lines.english: “But please do not forget.”

lines.japanese:
千鳥は滅多にこういう言い方をしない。
　しかし全てを忘れてくれたわけでもない。
　時折、思い出させるのだ。
lines.english: Chidori almost never put it that way. But it wasn't as though she had forgotten everything. Every so often, she reminded him.

lines.japanese: 「あなたは私のものですから」
lines.english: “You belong to me.”

lines.japanese:
「どんなにつらくても、いつかは世俗のことをかな
　ぐり捨てて私の元に戻ってこなければならない」
lines.english: “No matter how painful it may be, one day you must cast off the affairs of this world and return to me.”

lines.japanese:
「そのためにこうしてあなたを引き取ったんですか
　ら」
lines.english: “That is why I took you in.”

lines.japanese: 「息抜きは、ほどほどに」
lines.english: “Keep your diversions within reasonable limits.”

lines.japanese: 「……わかっています」
lines.english: “…I understand.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたに与えた自由意志は、義務の上に成り立つ
　ものです」
lines.english: “The free will I gave you rests upon your duty.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
千鳥は満足げに頷く。
　しかし忍は―――
lines.english: Chidori nodded, satisfied. But Shinobu—

lines.japanese: 「……納得のいかないことでも？」
lines.english: “…Is there some part of that you cannot accept?”
“N-no…”

lines.japanese:
見透かされていることとわかっても、忍にはどう
ともできない。
lines.english: Even knowing she had seen straight through him, Shinobu could do nothing.

lines.japanese:
千鳥との危うい擬似的家族関係。
　その危うさとともに、今という時間の価値を再認
識させられる。
lines.english: This precarious, makeshift family he shared with Chidori. That precariousness made him recognize anew the value of the present.

lines.japanese:
忘れてはならない。
　全ては千鳥の手の上の出来事なのだ、と。
　それでも―――
lines.english: He must never forget. Everything was unfolding in the palm of Chidori's hand. And yet—

lines.japanese: 彼女に対し、少しは感謝するべきなのかも知れない。
lines.english: Perhaps he ought to be at least a little grateful to her.

lines.japanese:
今だけとはいえ、自由らしきものを与えてくれた
ことには。
lines.english: For giving him something resembling freedom, if only for now.

lines.japanese: 「話はここまでにしましょう」
lines.english: “Let us leave the matter there.”

lines.japanese:
「でも忍、私は思いますが、あなたにとって伊月笛子
　さんは―――」
lines.english: “But Shinobu, I believe that, to you, Fueko Izuki is—”

lines.japanese:
千鳥の声が揺らぎをともなう。
　三半規管が揺さぶられる。
　眩暈。
lines.english: Chidori's voice wavered. His inner ear lurched. Vertigo.

lines.japanese: あなたにとって伊月笛子さんは―――
lines.english: To you, Fueko Izuki is—

lines.japanese: 何だったのだろう。
lines.english: What had she been to him?

lines.japanese: 決まってる。
lines.english: The answer was obvious.

lines.japanese: 大切な存在―――
lines.english: Someone precious—

lines.japanese: （そうだ、大切な……）
lines.english: (Yes. Someone precious…)

lines.japanese:
（疑う余地もないくらい、
　大切な……存在じゃないか）
lines.english: (She’s precious—beyond any possible doubt.)

lines.japanese:
（誰がなんといったって、それだけは確かな
　ことで……）
lines.english: (No matter what anyone says, that much is certain…)

lines.japanese:
（……確かに僕は、この人に引き取られて、
　今を生きてる……）
lines.english: (…It's true that she took me in, and that I'm alive now…)

lines.japanese:
（いつか……この自由もなくしてしまう時が、
　来るんだろうか？）
lines.english: (Will there come a day… when I lose this freedom too?)
“………Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 突然、声を認識した。
lines.english: Her voice suddenly broke into his awareness.
“…Oh. Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「ぼんやりとしていたみたいですね。平気ですか？」

　いわね」
lines.english: “True. No one we don't want around is going to find us here.”

lines.japanese: 「遊び場所もあるよね、このあたりって！」
lines.english: “And there are lots of places to play around here!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、暇だったら遊べばいい」
lines.english: “Sure. We can play if we get bored.”

lines.japanese:
章二の発言をきっかけにして、考え方が少しまと
まっていく。
lines.english: Shouji's remark gave them a starting point, and the idea began to take shape.

lines.japanese: 「話せばいい。みんなで火でも囲んで」
lines.english: “We can talk. Sit around a fire together.”

lines.japanese:
「ここは可燃物もないし、子供だけでもたき火くら
　いはできそうね」
lines.english: “There's nothing flammable in here. Even kids like us should be able to handle a small fire.”

lines.japanese: 「ねーちゃん、森は？」
lines.english: “What about the forest, sis?”

lines.japanese: 「生きている森はそう簡単には燃えないわ。平気よ」
lines.english: “Live trees don't burn that easily. We'll be fine.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 「……それと、ねーちゃんはやめて」
lines.english: “...And stop calling me ‘sis.’”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ！　オレもそう呼んでいいか」
lines.english: “Hahahaha! Can I call you that too?”

lines.japanese: 「おーこわいこわい。睨むな睨むな。本性バレっぞ」
lines.english: “Ooh, scary. Don't glare at me. People'll see the real you.”

lines.japanese: 唇を噛み含み、沙也加は目を背けた。
lines.english: Sayaka bit her lip and looked away.

lines.japanese: 「ね、家ではどう呼ばれてるの？」
lines.english: “So what do they call you at home?”

lines.japanese: 「……え、それはお嬢さんとか、沙也加さんとか」
lines.english: “...At home? ‘Young lady,’ or ‘Miss Sayaka.’”

lines.japanese: 「サヤカサンだって。べろ」
lines.english: “Miss Sayaka, she says. Bleh.”

lines.japanese: 舌を噛むゼスチャー。
lines.english: She pretended to bite her tongue.

lines.japanese: 「それにお嬢さン～？」
lines.english: “And ‘young laaady’?”

lines.japanese: 「ご令嬢であらせられる」
lines.english: “The young lady is of the most distinguished birth.”

lines.japanese: 「金持ちか」
lines.english: “So she's rich.”

lines.japanese: 「有名だぞ。この中じゃたぶん二番だな」
lines.english: “Her family's famous. Probably number two out of all of us.”

lines.japanese: 「一番じゃないの？」
lines.english: “Not number one?”

lines.japanese:
「……本堂は昔は医者に政治家の家系だけれど、
　今は後継者の男子もいなくて、一家も散り散りに
　なっているから。今は資産を食いつぶすだけよ」
lines.english: “...The Hondous were once a line of doctors and politicians, but now we have no male heir, and the family is scattered all over. These days, all we do is eat through what’s left of the fortune.”

lines.japanese:
「難しいけど、もう一番じゃなくなっちゃったんだ
　ね」
lines.english: “I don't get the details, but you're not number one anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃナンバーワンはどこ？」
lines.english: “So who's number one?”

lines.japanese: 「こいつんち」
lines.english: “Her family.”

lines.japanese: 葉子の頭を掴む。
lines.english: He grabbed Youko by the head.

lines.japanese: 「うお……マジですか？」
lines.english: “Whoa... Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「マジだ」
lines.english: “Seriously.”

lines.japanese: 「質問があります」
lines.english: “I have a question.”

lines.japanese: 「どうぞ」
lines.english: “Go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「お金あるんですか？」
lines.english: “Do you have money?”

lines.japanese: 「大人には」
lines.english: “The grown-ups do.”

lines.japanese: 「正確には、門倉家だ」
lines.english: “Strictly speaking, the Kadokura family does.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、あいつらは別格だな」
lines.english: “Yeah, they're in a league of their own.”

lines.japanese:
「その門倉の若いやつが俺らよりちっと上にいたは
　ずだけどな。確かに、暴れるんならちょっと無視
　できないかもな」
lines.english: “There should be a young Kadokura a little older than us. If we're going to run wild, we probably can't afford to ignore him.”

lines.japanese: 「歳が近すぎると、目もつけられやすい」
lines.english: “We're close enough in age that he'd be more likely to take notice of us.”

lines.japanese: 「目をつけられるって？」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘take notice’?”

lines.japanese:
「おう、門倉の家ってヤクザっぽいからな。
　息子はみんな番長だ」
lines.english: “The Kadokuras are kind of like gangsters. All their sons are school gang bosses.”

lines.japanese: 「……葉子ちゃんもヤクザ？」
lines.english: “...Youko, are you a gangster too?”

lines.japanese: 「いいえ、ヤクザじゃないですよ」
lines.english: “No, I am not a gangster.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘じゃん」
lines.english: “Liar.”

lines.japanese: 「金持ってるってことだ」
lines.english: “It just means they're loaded.”

lines.japanese: 「……で、明日からここに集まればいいの？」
lines.english: “...So, do we start meeting here tomorrow?”

lines.japanese:
いい加減だらだらとした会話にうんざりしたのか、
沙也加がまとめにかかる。
lines.english: Apparently tired of the rambling conversation, Sayaka tried to wrap it up.

lines.japanese:
「ああ。強制はしない。
　来れる時に来てくれればいい」
lines.english: “Yes. You don't have to. Just come when you can.”

lines.japanese: 「わかったわ」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 「だとよ。他のもそれでいいか？」
lines.english: “You heard him. Everybody else good with that?”

lines.japanese: 全員がそれぞれに頷く。
lines.english: Each of them nodded in their own way.

lines.japanese: 「新入りの。それでいいか？」
lines.english: “What about you, new girl? That work for you?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ全員新人みたいなもんだけどな」
lines.english: “I guess we're all new, really.”

lines.japanese: 「違いない」
lines.english: “True enough.”

lines.japanese:
「あたしと忍くんは違うぞ。
　コサンだぞ。初期メンだぞ」
lines.english: “Me and Shinobu aren't. We're old hands. Founding members.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえ小数点以下だから一人分とはみなされねー
　よ。コサンは貴宮だけだ」
lines.english: “You're somewhere to the right of the decimal point, so you don't count as one whole person. Atemiya's the only old hand here.”

lines.japanese: 「表に出ろおまえ」
lines.english: “You. Outside. Now.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、わたしはどうすればいいの？」
lines.english: “Then what should I do?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだな……おまえのために素晴らしいあだ名を
　つけてやるぜ。んー、天然ボケだから……
　ボケ美でどうだ？」
lines.english: “Hmm... I'll give you a fantastic nickname. You're a natural airhead, so... How about Ditzabelle?”

lines.japanese:
「ボケ美か……
　ナマイキなことにセンスだけはあるな」
lines.english: “Ditzabelle, huh... For a cocky jerk, he does have a knack for this.”

lines.japanese: 「……何を言ってるの、あなた？」
lines.english: “...What on earth are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「でいいの？」
lines.english: “Would that be all right?”

lines.japanese: 背後に問いかける。
lines.english: He asked the girl behind him.

lines.japanese: 「……いい……わけない」
lines.english: “...No... it wouldn't.”

lines.japanese: 「だって」
lines.english: “She says it wouldn't.”

lines.japanese: 「だって空気読めてないんだぜ、そいつ」
lines.english: “But she can't read the room.”

lines.japanese: 「慣れてないんだよ、まだ」
lines.english: “She's just not used to us yet.”

lines.japanese: 「……そろそろ帰らないと、門限だわ」
lines.english: “...I should get going. I have a curfew.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、じゃあ解散しよう」
lines.english: “Mm. Then let's call it a day.”

lines.japanese: 「あたしもだ。忍くんは？　一緒にかえろ？」
lines.english: “Me too. What about you, Shinobu? Walk home with me?”

lines.japanese: 「もうちょっと残ってく。笛子に話があるから」
lines.english: “I'm staying a little longer. I need to talk to Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「がーん……」
lines.english: “Nooo...”

lines.japanese: 「俺も帰るか」
lines.english: “Guess I'll head home too.”
“...Youko.”

lines.japanese: 「あい、それでは」
lines.english: “Aye. See you.”

lines.japanese:
皆が工場を出て行く。
　不揃いの仲間たちを見送って、忍と笛子だけが残る。
lines.english: Everyone filed out of the factory. Shinobu watched his mismatched companions go, until only he and Fueko remained.
“...Now, then.”

lines.japanese:
それでも笛子は忍の背後にいた。
　振り向こうとして、背中にすがられた。
lines.english: Fueko was still behind him. When he tried to turn, she clung to his back.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「……あたたかいの」
lines.english: “...You're warm.”

lines.japanese: 「そう……ならこのまま話そう」
lines.english: “I see... Then we'll talk like this.”

lines.japanese: 「……伊月笛子」
lines.english: “...Fueko Izuki.”

lines.japanese: 「僕のことは知ってる？」
lines.english: “Do you know who I am?”

lines.japanese:
反応が鈍い。
　忍は我慢強く待った。
lines.english: She was slow to respond. Shinobu waited patiently.

lines.japanese: 「知っているわ、貴宮忍くんでしょ？」
lines.english: “I do. You're Shinobu Atemiya, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「忍でいいよ、笛子」
lines.english: “Just call me Shinobu, Fueko.”
“...Mm... Then... Shinobu...”

lines.japanese: 「急な話だけど、今日のことは理解できた？」
lines.english: “This is sudden, but do you understand what today was about?”

lines.japanese: 「笛子？」
lines.english: “Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 「僕の質問、わかる？」
lines.english: “Do you understand my question?”

lines.japanese: 「ええと……なんだっけ？」
lines.english: “Um... What was it again?”

lines.japanese: 「簡単に言うよ」
lines.english: “I'll put it simply.”

lines.japanese: 「僕の友達になってくれないか？」
lines.english: “Would you be my friend?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、いいわよ」
lines.english: “Mm. All right.”

lines.japanese: 「あっさり……決めていいの？」
lines.english: “That easily...? Are you sure?”

lines.japanese:
笛子の態度は知れず奇妙な疎隔を挟み、二人の会
話はようとして進まない。
lines.english: There was something strangely remote in Fueko's manner, and their conversation simply refused to move forward.

lines.japanese: 忍は辛抱強かった。
lines.english: Shinobu was patient.

lines.japanese: 「生きることは、つらくない？」
lines.english: “Isn't it hard to be alive?”

lines.japanese: 「どう？」
lines.english: “What do you think?”

lines.japanese: 「…………うん、つらい」
「ここに来たい？」
lines.english: “Do you want to come here?”

lines.japanese: 「来て、どうしたらいいの？」
lines.english: “And what do I do when I come?”

lines.japanese: 「……友達になる」
lines.english: “...We become friends.”

lines.japanese: 「友達に」
lines.english: “Become friends.”

lines.japanese: 「……寂しくない？」
lines.english: “...Aren't you lonely?”

lines.japanese: 「……寂しい」
「あの、妹がいるの」
lines.english: “Um, I have a little sister.”

lines.japanese:
「お母さん、わたしのこと相手してくれなくなった
　の」
lines.english: “My mother doesn't pay attention to me anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、寂しいね」
lines.english: “I see. That sounds lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、だから寂しいの」
lines.english: “Yes. That's why I'm lonely.”

lines.japanese:
「友達がいれば、寂しさが少しだけまぎれるかも知
　れないよ」
lines.english: “If you have friends, you might not feel quite so lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「本当？」
lines.english: “Really?”

lines.japanese: 「たぶんね」
lines.english: “Probably.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、いいわ。友達になる」
lines.english: “Then... all right. I'll be your friend.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、時間があるときはここに集まる」
lines.english: “Then come here whenever you have time.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、わかった」
lines.english: “Mm. I understand.”

lines.japanese: 「でも忍……友達って、どうするの？」
lines.english: “But, Shinobu... what do you do with friends?”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだね。笛子には学校に友達はいないの？」
lines.english: “...Let's see. Don't you have any friends at school?”

lines.japanese:
「いない……あ、でも少しだけいる。高城さんって
　言って、明るい子。でも他にたくさん友達のいる
　子。だから私だけの友達じゃない」
lines.english: “No… Oh, but I do have a friend, sort of. Her name is Takashiro, and she’s cheerful. But she has lots of other friends. So she isn’t my friend alone.”
“I see...”

lines.japanese:
「でも僕らは、たぶん笛子だけの友達になれると思
　うよ」
lines.english: “But I think we could probably be friends who were yours alone.”

lines.japanese: 「……それは、すごいことよ？」
lines.english: “...That would be incredible, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「だろうね」
lines.english: “I suppose it would.”

lines.japanese:
「……でもみんなと、どう仲良くしたら
　いいのか……」
lines.english: “...But I don't know how to get along with everyone...”

lines.japanese: 「わからない？」
lines.english: “You don't?”

lines.japanese: 「なんとなくしか、わからない」
lines.english: “I only sort of know.”

lines.japanese: 「高城さんとはどうやって友達に？」
lines.english: “How did you become friends with Takashiro?”

lines.japanese: 「笛子？」
lines.english: “Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 「……憶えてない」
lines.english: “...I don't remember.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり、笛子は欠けてるね」
lines.english: “I knew it. You're missing something too, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「かけてる……わたしが？」
lines.english: “I'm... missing something?”

lines.japanese: 「だから気になったんだ」
lines.english: “That's why you caught my attention.”

lines.japanese: 「僕らはみんな欠けてる。気付かなかった？」
lines.english: “We're all missing something. Hadn't you noticed?”

lines.japanese: 「同じ、においがする」
lines.english: “You all have the same smell.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ。だから集まった」
lines.english: “Right. That's why we gathered.”

lines.japanese: 「輪っかになって、生きるんだ」
lines.english: “We'll form a circle and live.”

lines.japanese: 「よろしく頼むよ？」
lines.english: “So I'm counting on you, all right?”

lines.japanese: 「頑張るわ……」
lines.english: “I'll do my best...”

lines.japanese: 「しっかりね。お姉さんなんだから」
lines.english: “Be strong. You're the big sister.”

lines.japanese: 「……妹さん、嫌い？」
lines.english: “...Do you hate your sister?”

lines.japanese: 背後の気配が険しさを増した。
lines.english: The presence behind him turned tense.

lines.japanese: 「……そう。それは大変だ」
lines.english: “...I see. That must be hard.”

lines.japanese: 「だって！」
lines.english: “But!”

lines.japanese:
「……だって、わたしには心を開いてくれない
　から……」
lines.english: “...But she won't open her heart to me...”

lines.japanese: 「子供なんだから、仕方ないさ」
lines.english: “She's still a child. It can't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「でも……お母さんにはなついてる……」
lines.english: “But... she's attached to Mother...”

lines.japanese:
「それも仕方ないことだ。お母さんは、命を吸わせ
　てるんだから」
lines.english: “She can't help that either. Your mother lets her draw life from her.”

lines.japanese: 「でも……でも……」
lines.english: “But... but...”

lines.japanese:
「時間がかかるんだよ。お姉さんに対して、気持ち
　を開くのは」
lines.english: “It'll take time for her to open up to her big sister.”

lines.japanese:
「だからいつか、大きくなったら、きっと仲良くな
　れるさ。物心つく頃にはね」
lines.english: “Someday, when she grows up, I'm sure you'll be close. Once she's old enough to understand.”

lines.japanese: 「……うん、うん」
「そのときまで、ここにおいで」
lines.english: “Until then, come here.”

lines.japanese: 「友達、伊月笛子」
lines.english: “My friend, Fueko Izuki.”

lines.japanese: 後ろに手を回し、少女の指を取って、握りこむ。
lines.english: He reached behind him, took the girl's fingers, and held them tight.

lines.japanese:
笛子も握り返してきた。
　誓うように。
lines.english: Fueko squeezed his hand in return. Like a vow.

lines.japanese: 「うん、来るね……わたし、来る……」
lines.english: “Mm, I'll come... I will...”

lines.japanese: 「わたしにしかできないことをする」
lines.english: “I'll do something only I can do.”

lines.japanese: 「……笛子は何ができるの？」
lines.english: “...What can you do?”

lines.japanese: 「わたし……」

「わたし、勉強が得意だから……みんなに勉強を教
　える」
lines.english: “I’m good at studying… so I’ll help everyone with their schoolwork.”

lines.japanese: 「それはいい。先生みたいだ」
lines.english: “That's good. Like a teacher.”
“A teacher...”

lines.japanese:
「ついでに、僕らが間違えたことをした時、怒って
　くれるといい」
lines.english: “And maybe you can scold us whenever we do something wrong.”
“...Scold you...”

lines.japanese: 「さっき言ったようにだよ。けんかはよくないって」
lines.english: “Like you did earlier. Tell us we shouldn't fight.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それならできるわ」
lines.english: “Oh. I can do that.”

lines.japanese: 「わたし、それならできる」
lines.english: “I can do that.”

lines.japanese: 少し、表情が華やぐ。
lines.english: Her expression brightened a little.

lines.japanese: 「よし、君が七人目」
lines.english: “Good. You're the seventh.”

lines.japanese: 「七人の、輪」
lines.english: “A circle of seven.”

lines.japanese:
「僕らはみんなで手を繋ぐ。
　輪っかになって、その丸い領土そのものになって、
　生きていく」
lines.english: “We'll all join hands. We'll become a circle—become that round territory itself—and live.”

lines.japanese: 「……うん、生きていく」
lines.english: “...Mm. We'll live.”

lines.japanese: これが、忍と笛子の盟約となった。
lines.english: That was the covenant between Shinobu and Fueko.

lines.japanese: （うん、憶えてる。まだ、憶えていられた）
lines.english: (Yes. I remember. I still haven't forgotten.)

lines.japanese:
（忘れたらいけない……大切な記憶だ。
　大事にしないといけないんだ）
lines.english: (I can't let myself forget... It's a precious memory. I have to hold on to it.)

lines.japanese: 駅構内、反対側に抜ける混雑地帯にさしかかる。
lines.english: He reached the crowded passage through to the other side of the station.

lines.japanese: 慌てて距離が開かないよう、体を雑踏に押し込む。
lines.english: He hastily pushed into the crowd to keep the distance between them from growing.

lines.japanese: （声かけるの、無理っぽいなぁ……）
lines.english: (Looks like I won't be able to call out to her...)

lines.japanese:
妹は、姉である笛子の手を握り、前に前に進もう
としている。
lines.english: Fueko's sister had her by the hand and kept pulling ahead.

lines.japanese:
笛子は笑って、だけど二人が弾け飛んでしまわな
いよう身を後ろに傾けて、勢いを殺している。
lines.english: Fueko laughed, leaning back to rein in their momentum and keep them from flying apart.

lines.japanese: 犬の散歩のよう。
lines.english: Like walking a dog.

lines.japanese:
（……なるほど。
　メガネがないから、妹センサー頼りってわけね）
lines.english: (...I see. Without her glasses, she's relying on her sister-sensor.)

lines.japanese: 妹は姉を導いていると、言えないこともない。
lines.english: You could almost say the younger sister was guiding the older one.

lines.japanese:
楽しげに話している。
　妹を見つめる笛子の目が、優しい。
lines.english: They talked happily together. Fueko's eyes were gentle as she watched her sister.

lines.japanese:
（メガネをなくした笛子は、どんな世界を見ている
　のかな）
lines.english: (I wonder what sort of world Fueko sees without her glasses.)

lines.japanese: 姉妹の間を邪魔することはできない。
lines.english: He couldn't intrude on the sisters.

lines.japanese:
（二人にとって、
　あれは大切な時間である気がするし）
lines.english: (I get the feeling this time means a great deal to both of them.)

lines.japanese:
駅前で、帰りに待ち合わせたのだろうか。
　それぞれの学校が、終わる時間も違うはずである。
lines.english: Perhaps they had arranged to meet at the station on their way home. Their schools must let out at different times.

lines.japanese:

そうだ。

「あずささんが

lines.japanese: 「ええ、方針も決まったわよ」

lines.japanese: 「さっさと終わらせるぞ」

lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.english: “All right, Azusa. You're subbing out.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー？」

lines.english: “Looks like it doesn't matter who plays. At this rate, you're going to lose. Shinobu is deliberately holding back because he doesn't want to get ‘too involved.’”

「章二は一人で熱くなっていて葉子は楽しければ

lines.english: “Shouji's the only one taking this seriously, and Youko doesn't care as long as she's having fun.”

lines.japanese:
「そして沙也加はそんな皆の様子を、一人冷たく見下

lines.japanese: 「人を黒幕みたいに言わないで頂戴」

lines.japanese:

「あ、うん、惜しくはないけど……

lines.english: “I guess not... But you're only a few moves from losing, right?”

lines.japanese: 「普通にやればね」
lines.english: “If I play normally.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、じゃタッチ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Okay, tag.”

lines.japanese: 「おい、そういうのはアリなのか？」

lines.japanese: 「私はいいですよ」

lines.japanese: 「……忍がねえ、しっかりしてればねぇ？」
lines.english: “...If only Shinobu were a little more dependable, hm?”

lines.japanese: 「なんのことですかな？」

lines.japanese: 老人と化した忍だった。

lines.japanese: 「揉んでやってください」

lines.japanese: 「こちらこそ」
lines.english: “Likewise.”

lines.japanese: 「揉みつ揉まれつですね」

lines.japanese:
どことなく貞操の危機めいたものを感じて、腕を

lines.japanese: 「だといいわね」

「畜生ぉぉぉぉ

lines.english: “Do I look like one?”

lines.japanese: 「ここから見ると」
lines.english: “From where I'm standing.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
「努力して身につけたものは天才とは言わない、

lines.japanese: 「あ……そうだよね、ごめん……」

「いいって。天才は生まれで決まっちゃうのが、

lines.english: “It's fine. Genius is something you're born with, and I don't think that would suit me.”

lines.english: “I think the terms have changed rather dramatically.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ……いや、でもね」
lines.english: “Well... no, listen.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっと」

どころか、次第に膨張していくかのようで、忍は

笛子とデートをする。

それから……デートについて慎重かつ活発に討議

貢献度の違いなどが取りざたされ、勝負が一度リ

lines.japanese:
「おかしいなぁ……他に置くところなんてないのに。
　だいたいそんなヘンなところで外さないし……」
lines.english: “This is so strange... There's nowhere else I could have put them. And I wouldn't have taken them off in some weird place...”

安普請ではないはずだが、開いた窓際で話してい

lines.english: The house should have been solidly built, but perhaps she was speaking near an open window; her voice carried outside.

lines.japanese:
それ以外、人の声は聞こえない。

跳ねる。
lines.english: No other voices could be heard. Beyond the garden, dim in the gathering dusk, the shadow of a little girl bounded about.

lines.english: It was a large garden.

lines.japanese:
だがちょっとした庭園風で、人のくつろげる空間
はない。
lines.english: But it was laid out almost like a formal garden, with nowhere for a person to sit and relax.

lines.japanese: 観賞用の庭だ。
lines.english: A garden meant only to be admired.

lines.japanese:
そこを、少女の影が横切る。
　庭の内側。
lines.english: The girl's shadow crossed it. Still within the garden's bounds.

lines.japanese: 外に出る気配はないようだ。
lines.english: She showed no sign of going outside.

lines.japanese: 「だめ、ないわこりゃ……」
lines.english: “No good. They're just not here...”

lines.japanese: 室内からは落胆の声。
lines.english: A dejected voice from inside.

lines.japanese: 「お風呂入ろ……」
lines.english: “Guess I'll take a bath...”

lines.japanese:
いつの間にか、小さな影は二階のベランダに移動
していた。
lines.english: Somehow, the little shadow had moved to the second-floor balcony.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　痛っ！　きゃあ！」
lines.english: “H-huh? Ow! Ahh!”

lines.japanese:
反響を帯びた悲鳴と、転倒する音。

lines.japanese: 「お、お尻……くぅっ……！」
lines.english: “M-my butt... oww...”

lines.japanese: 何かを尻の下敷きにしてしまった。
lines.english: She had sat on something.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　これ眼鏡？」
lines.english: “H-huh? Are these my glasses?”

lines.japanese: 「こんなところにあったんだ……あ、」
lines.english: “So that's where they were... Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「…………歪んでる」
かけてみる。
lines.english: She tried them on.

lines.japanese: 「……なんとか、使えるかしら……」
lines.english: “...Maybe I can still use them...”

lines.japanese: 幸いレンズは割れていない。
lines.english: Fortunately, the lenses were intact.

lines.japanese:
フレームは歪んでいて、一部レンズのふちが外れ
ていた。
lines.english: The frame was warped, and one lens had popped partly free of its rim.

lines.japanese: 「えい」
lines.english: “Hup.”

lines.japanese:
力任せに。
　パキン、と乾いた音。
　レンズが落ちた。
lines.english: She tried forcing it. Snap—a dry crack. The lens dropped out.
“Urgh...”

lines.japanese: 渋面になった。
lines.english: She grimaced.

lines.japanese:
時計を見て、電話をかける。
　営業時間ぎりぎりのタイミングで繋がった。
lines.english: She checked the time and made a call. She got through just before closing.

lines.japanese:
行きつけの店というほどでもないが、よく世話に
なった眼鏡屋チェーンだ。
lines.english: It wasn't quite her regular optician, but it was a chain that had served her well several times before.

lines.japanese: この手の店は、意外とリピーターを大切にする。
lines.english: Shops like that could be surprisingly attentive to returning customers.

lines.japanese:
一度利用して以降、毎年手書きのコメントを添え
て年賀状が送られてきた。
lines.english: Ever since her first visit, they had sent her a New Year's card each year with a handwritten note.

lines.japanese:
一種の営業活動なのだろうが、好感はあった。
　電話口の向こう、若い店員の声には邪険さはない。
lines.english: It was a kind of marketing, no doubt, but she appreciated it. The young clerk on the other end of the line sounded anything but put out.

lines.japanese:
「はい、伊月です。以前お世話になった……ええ、
　その伊月です。あの、眼鏡が壊れてしまって……
　はい、あのフレームがいいんですけど……」
lines.english: “Yes, this is Izuki. I bought a pair from you before… Yes, that Izuki. Well, my glasses broke… Yes, I’d like the same frame…”

lines.japanese:
「ええ、レンズはそのままで。はい……はい。でき
　たらすぐに……ええと、特に割れてはいないみた
　いです……はい……ええ、すぐに欲しいです」
lines.english: “Yes, with the same lenses. Right... right. As soon as possible, if you could... Um, they don't seem to be cracked or anything... Yes... Yes, I need them as soon as possible.”

lines.japanese: 「何日くらいかかりそうですか？」
lines.english: “About how many days would that take?”

lines.japanese: 「……そうですか、そんなに……」
lines.english: “...I see. That long...”

lines.japanese:
「いえ、結構です。コンタクトがありますので、し
　ばらくはそちらで。はい、ええ、それでお願いし
　ます」
lines.english: “No, that's all right. I have contacts, so I'll use those for now. Yes, mm-hm. Please go ahead with that.”

lines.japanese: 電話を切る。
lines.english: She hung up.
“...Well, then...”

lines.japanese: 一応のこととして、笛子はコンタクトを持っている。
lines.english: Fueko kept contact lenses on hand just in case.

lines.japanese:
しかし笛子は、眼球に直接触れるソレが好きでは
ない。
lines.english: But Fueko disliked putting them directly on her eyeballs.

lines.japanese:
何より、人に素顔を見せるのが少し怖い。
　どういうわけか、怖い。
lines.english: More than that, she was a little afraid to show people her bare face. For some reason, she was afraid.

lines.japanese:
深く考えたいとも思わないが、おまえは笛子じゃ
ないと言われそうな気がして、不安になるのだ。
lines.english: She didn't want to think too deeply about it, but the feeling that someone might tell her “You're not Fueko” filled her with unease.

lines.japanese:
眼鏡がないと世界が霞む。
　世界が揺らげば自分も霞む。
lines.english: Without her glasses, the world blurred. And when the world wavered, she too blurred.

lines.japanese:
認識の上で、内面と外の世界が、密接な相関関係
にあるように感じられる。
lines.english: To Fueko, her inner self and the world outside seemed closely interdependent.

lines.japanese:
これはある意味、事実だ。
　人の認識を育む糧が、外界からの刺激であるためだ。
lines.english: In a sense, this was true. After all, perception is nourished by stimuli from the outside world.

lines.japanese:
だから外が変化すれば、内も揺らぐというのは正
しい。
lines.english: So it was true that when the outer world changed, the self within could waver with it.

lines.japanese:
度合いが過ぎれば、笛子と同様の呻吟に悩むこと
にもなるだろう。
lines.english: Taken too far, anyone might find themselves suffering the same anguish as Fueko.

lines.japanese: 曖昧なままにしておけば楽なこともあるはずだった。
lines.english: Some things ought to have been easier left indistinct.

lines.japanese:
だが反射するかのように己が内側まで曖昧になっ
てしまいそうで、受け入れがたい。
lines.english: But she couldn't accept that; it felt as though the blur would be reflected inside her.

lines.japanese:
自分を見失わないように、笛子は外界をクリンナッ
プしておく必要があった。
lines.english: To keep from losing sight of herself, Fueko needed to keep the outside world cleaned up and in order.

lines.japanese: フレームをなんとか元に戻し、レンズをはめ込む。
lines.english: She managed to bend the frame back into shape and tried to fit the lens into it.

lines.japanese:
一度はずれてしまったものは、なかなか元通りに
はおさまらなかった。
lines.english: Once something had come loose, it was never easy to make it sit quite the way it had before.

lines.japanese:
しばらく試行錯誤を繰り返したが、うまくいかな
かった。
lines.english: She tried one thing after another for a while, but nothing worked.

lines.japanese: 眼鏡は頼もしい。
lines.english: Glasses were reliable.

lines.japanese:
コンタクトは頼りない。
　たとえ鼻の部分を支えるフックが壊れたため、頻
繁にたくし上げる姿を、周囲に揶揄されようとも。
lines.english: Contacts were not. Glasses remained dependable even with a broken nose pad, though it meant constantly pushing them up and enduring everyone's teasing.

lines.japanese:
……もっとも、それはずいぶん昔の出来事。
　今の環境で笛子を笑う者はいない。
lines.english: ...That, though, had been a very long time ago. No one around her now laughed at Fueko.

lines.japanese:
忍の作った世界は、温かく、悪意がない。
　不思議なほど。
　不自然なほど。
lines.english: The world Shinobu had made was warm and free of malice. Uncannily so. Unnaturally so.

lines.japanese:
笛子は何も考えられなくなった。
　少女の姿はいつの間にか消えている。
lines.english: Fueko's mind went blank. At some point, the girl had disappeared.

lines.japanese: 「……伊月笛子さん、彼女は」
lines.english: “...Fueko Izuki. She is...”

lines.japanese:
千鳥は書類を手にしている。
　乾いた紙の音だけが、静寂を埋める唯一の雑音だ
った。
lines.english: Chidori held a document in her hands. The dry rustle of paper was the only noise that disturbed the silence.

lines.japanese:
いつからこうしているのか、どれだけの時間対話
を続けているのか、わからない。
lines.english: He did not know how long they had been there, or how long the conversation had gone on.

lines.japanese: 記憶が濁っている気がした。
lines.english: His memory felt clouded.

lines.japanese: 「本当は」
lines.english: “In truth...”

lines.japanese: 「潤滑油のようなものじゃないんですか？」
lines.english: “Is she not something like a lubricant?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese:
「驚かれるとは意外です。あなたはそういうことに
　は自覚的だと思いましたが」
lines.english: “I did not expect that to surprise you. I thought you were self-aware about this sort of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「潤滑油……笛子がですか？　どういう意味で？」
lines.english: “Fueko? A lubricant? In what sense?”

lines.japanese: 「彼女は便利な人格をしていますね」
lines.english: “She has a very convenient sort of personality.”

lines.japanese:
情感に乏しいのはいつも通りだが、今日ばかりは
微々たる憤りを抱く。
lines.english: As always, his emotions were muted, but today even he felt the faintest flicker of anger.

lines.japanese: しかし言葉にしてしまったらおしまいだ。
lines.english: But if he put it into words, that would be the end of it.

lines.japanese:
態度にも。
　忍にとって友は大事なもの。
　かけがえのないもの。
lines.english: The same was true if he let it show. To Shinobu, friends were precious. Irreplaceable.

lines.japanese:
疑う余地もないもの。
　確固たるもの。
　愛しているもの。
lines.english: Beyond all doubt. Unshakable. Beloved.

lines.japanese: できることなら、全員を―――
lines.english: If he could, every last one of them—

lines.japanese:
ざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざ
ざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざ
