ざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざ
ざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざざ
ざざざ
lines.english: Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh hhhhhh

lines.japanese: 「……なんです、この音？」
lines.english: “...What is that sound?”

lines.japanese:
「水の音でしょう。試験的に流し込んでいます。建
　物の中にいると、ノイズのように聞こえますね」
lines.english: “Water, I suppose. They are pumping it in as a test. From inside the building it sounds almost like static.”
“Water?”

lines.japanese: 「水槽を作っているんですよ」
lines.english: “They are building a water tank.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうですか。関係ありませんよね？」
lines.english: “...I see. That has nothing to do with this, does it?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、関係ありません。だってこれは―――」
lines.english: “No, it does not. Because this is—”

lines.japanese: かくて雑音は排除される。
lines.english: And thus the noise was eliminated.

lines.japanese: 「五分休憩」
lines.english: “Five-minute break.”

lines.japanese: どこかで何かが停止した。
lines.english: Somewhere, something stopped.

lines.japanese: 「だってこれはあなたの夢なんですから」
lines.english: “Because this is your dream.”

lines.japanese: 無音。
lines.english: Silence.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 忍は感知しえない。
lines.english: Shinobu could not perceive it.

lines.japanese: 「私との生活はどうですか？」
lines.english: “How has life with me been?”

lines.japanese: 「千鳥……さん？　いったい……」
lines.english: “Chidori...? What in the world...”

lines.japanese:
机の上を手が這ってきた。
　忍の両手は、同じ机の上で組まれている。
lines.english: A hand crawled across the tabletop. Shinobu's hands lay clasped upon that same table.

lines.japanese:
千鳥のヒルを思わせる指が絡む。冷たい。冷たい
指紋。
lines.english: Chidori's leechlike fingers coiled around his. Cold. The cold whorls of her fingerprints.

lines.japanese: 「不満はありますか？」
lines.english: “Do you have any complaints?”

lines.japanese: 「特には……」
lines.english: “Nothing in particular...”

lines.japanese: 「どうしました？」
lines.english: “Is something wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「どうも……感覚が鈍くて」
lines.english: “Somehow... my senses feel dull.”

lines.japanese: 「夢ですから」
lines.english: “Because this is a dream.”

lines.japanese: 「変な部屋ですね、ここ」
lines.english: “This is a strange room.”

lines.japanese: 「歪んでいるのでしょう」
lines.english: “It must be distorted.”

lines.japanese: 「私はあなたの意志を正す心の機構です」
lines.english: “I am the mechanism in your mind that corrects your will.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか」
lines.english: “That can't be.”

lines.japanese:
「整理しておくといいですよ。本当の自分を。自分
　の気持ちを。正直に、どうか正直に。本来のあな
　たに正直に」
lines.english: “You would do well to put things in order. Your true self. Your true feelings. Be honest—please, be honest. Be honest with who you truly are.”

lines.japanese:
「人は簡単に自らを欺くんですから。自分を見失う
　んですから。特にあなたは、前後不覚になった際、
　かなり恣意的な判断を下すことがあります」
lines.english: “People deceive themselves so easily. They lose sight of who they are. You in particular tend to make highly arbitrary decisions when you lose your bearings.”

lines.japanese: 「それはあなたを不利にしますよ？」
lines.english: “That puts you at a disadvantage, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、」
lines.english: “Um—”

lines.japanese: 「休憩終わり」
lines.english: “Break over.”

lines.japanese: どこかで何かが動きだした。
lines.english: Somewhere, something started moving again.

lines.japanese:
「ああいった手合いは組織に一人は必要なものです。
　あなたもそれは知っていた」
lines.english: “Someone of that sort is indispensable to any organization. You knew that as well.”

lines.japanese:
「もし笛子さんが、自意識が薄く主体性のない人格
　であったなら、果たしてあなたは今のような関係
　を築けたかどうか」
lines.english: “If Fueko had been a person with little sense of self and no agency of her own, one wonders whether you could ever have built the relationship you now share.”

lines.japanese:
「……うまくやったと思いますよ。笛子は笛子です
　し、僕のやっていることにしても……」
lines.english: “...I think I would have made it work. Fueko is Fueko, and as for what I'm doing...”

lines.japanese: 「でも今よりは苦労したのでは？」
lines.english: “But it would have been more difficult than it is now, would it not?”

lines.japanese: 「その質問の仕方は……」
lines.english: “The way you're asking that...”

lines.japanese: 「端的に質問しましょう」
lines.english: “Then I will put the question plainly.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたのプロジェクトは伊月笛子を必要として
　いる」
lines.english: “Your project needs Fueko Izuki.”

lines.japanese: 「……ええ、まあ」
lines.english: “...Yes, I suppose it does.”

lines.japanese:
「彼女の能力面でももちろんのこと、人格面でも有
　用である」
lines.english: “She is useful not only for her abilities, but also for her personality.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうです」
lines.english: “...That's true.”

lines.japanese: 「次は、気負わずに回答してください」
lines.english: “Don't put too much pressure on yourself when you answer the next question.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたの友人の中で、誰か一人が消えるとします」
lines.english: “Suppose one of your friends were to disappear.”

lines.japanese: 「なんですって？」
lines.english: “What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 「落ち着いてください」
lines.english: “Calm down.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな話が？」
lines.english: “There’s talk of that?”

lines.japanese: 「落ち着いて、あなたらしくないですよ？」
lines.english: “Calm down. This is unlike you.”

lines.japanese: 「しかし彼女たちは僕の……っ」
lines.english: “But they're my—!”

lines.japanese: 「……すいません。続けてください」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry. Please continue.”

lines.japanese: 「一人、欠損するとしたら、誰でしょう？」
lines.english: “If one of them had to be lost, who would it be?”

lines.japanese: 「あなたを含めた男性陣と、紅緒あずさをのぞき」
lines.english: “Excluding the men, yourself included, and Azusa Benio.”

lines.japanese: 「その三人のうち、ですか」
lines.english: “One of those three, then?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。一番不要な者を選んでください」
lines.english: “Yes. Choose the least necessary.”

lines.japanese: 「…………選べません」
「本堂沙也加さん」
lines.english: “Sayaka Hondou.”

lines.japanese: 「彼女は大切です」
lines.english: “She matters to me.”

lines.japanese: 「塚本葉子さん」
lines.english: “Youko Tsukamoto.”

lines.japanese: 「彼女も大切です」
lines.english: “She matters to me too.”

lines.japanese: 「では残ったのは？」
lines.english: “Then who remains?”

lines.japanese: 「笛子ですが、しかし……」
lines.english: “Fueko, but...”

lines.japanese: 「一番不要なのは彼女でしょう」
lines.english: “She is the least necessary, is she not?”

lines.japanese: 「違い……っ」
lines.english: “That's not—!”

lines.japanese:
「潤滑油として彼女が有用であるから、だから、失っ
　ても良いという安易な判断を下すことは難しい！」
lines.english: “Because she is useful as a lubricant, it is difficult for you to make the facile judgment that she may safely be lost!”

lines.japanese: 声高に、そして次には穏やかに。
lines.english: Her voice rose—and then, with the next breath, softened.

lines.japanese: 「……ということですね？」
lines.english: “...That is what you mean, yes?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese:
千鳥の瞳が、念を押すように深い。
　気圧され、頷いた。
lines.english: Chidori's gaze grew intent, pressing him for confirmation. Under its pressure, he nodded.

lines.japanese: 「言葉で回答してください」
lines.english: “Answer aloud, please.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、そうです」
lines.english: “Yes. That's what I mean.”

lines.japanese:
「そうであるなら、彼女たちを格付けすることの困
　難さというものが、私たちにも見えてきます」
lines.english: “In that case, we too can begin to see how difficult it is to rank them.”

lines.japanese: 「……ありがとう、ございます」
lines.english: “...Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
「これはカウンセリングのようなものです。
　あなたが正常に機能していると示すための」
lines.english: “Think of this as a form of counseling. It is meant to demonstrate that you are functioning normally.”

lines.japanese:

lines.english: “Good. That's a relief.”

　は怒る？」
lines.english: “If I told you it isn't good to carry everything alone, would you be angry?”

lines.japanese: 「……怒らないわ」
「でも、できたらとっくにしてるよね」
lines.english: “But if you could, you'd have told someone long ago.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「なら問いつめてあげない」
lines.english: “Then I won't interrogate you.”

lines.japanese: 「……ありがと」
lines.english: “...Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「イヤミだったんだけどな」
lines.english: “I was being sarcastic.”

lines.japanese: 頭をかく。
lines.english: He scratched his head.

lines.japanese: 「似合わないわよ」
lines.english: “It doesn't suit you.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ちょっと待ってて」
lines.english: “Oh, wait here a moment.”

lines.japanese: 「うん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese:
炊事場に向かう。
　ちょうど沸き始めた湯で、笛子好みの紅茶を淹れた。
lines.english: He went to the kitchenette. With the water just coming to a boil, he brewed the tea Fueko liked.

lines.japanese:
二人分。
　それを持って戻る。
lines.english: Two cups. He carried them back.

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Here.”

lines.japanese:
「……あ、ありがと……
　お茶淹れてたのね、気が付かなかった」
lines.english: “...Oh, thank you... I didn't notice you making tea.”

lines.japanese: 「沈静作用があるんだっけ？」
lines.english: “It's supposed to have a calming effect, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、ちょっとね。気休め」
lines.english: “A little, yes. More reassurance than remedy.”

lines.japanese:
「体があったまれば血流も活発になって、
　それで……」
lines.english: “Once the body warms, the blood flows more freely, and then...”

lines.japanese:
「それで全て解決したら、こんな楽なこともないん
　だけれど、ね」
lines.english: “If that solved everything, life would be very easy indeed.”

lines.japanese: 重量のある吐息。
lines.english: A heavy sigh.

lines.japanese: 「重症だね、また」
lines.english: “Serious trouble again, huh.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「……夕日見てると、悲しくならない？」
lines.english: “...Doesn't looking at the sunset make you sad?”

lines.japanese: つられて視線を移せば、建物の外は濃い夕映え。
lines.english: Following her gaze, he found the world outside the building steeped in the deep glow of evening.
“...It does.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうなの？」
lines.english: “I-it does?”

lines.japanese: 「自分が訊いたんじゃないか」
lines.english: “You're the one who asked.”

lines.japanese: 「同意を得られるとは思ってなかったわ……」
lines.english: “I didn't expect you to agree...”

lines.japanese: 「ひどいなぁ」
lines.english: “That's cruel.”

lines.japanese: 二人はタイミングを合わせて笑った。
lines.english: They laughed in unison.

lines.japanese: 「みんな多かれ少なかれ、悩みを抱えているんだよ」
lines.english: “Everyone has their troubles, some more than others.”

lines.japanese:
「もともと君たちは……
　みんな似た匂いがしていたしね」
lines.english: “From the very beginning, all of you... had something of the same scent about you.”

lines.japanese:
「だからみんな、それぞれの事情があって……
　僕も例外ではなくて」
lines.english: “So everyone has their own circumstances... and I am no exception.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな状況を疎むことはできるし簡単だけど、
　逆を言えば、そうでなければ僕らは出会わなか
　ったとも言えるわけで」
lines.english: “It is easy enough to resent the circumstances we find ourselves in, but looked at another way, we might never have met at all without them.”

lines.japanese:
「良い面と悪い面がごっちゃで、区分なんてできな
　いでしょ？」
lines.english: “The good and the bad are all tangled together. You can't divide one from the other, can you?”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだけど」
lines.english: “...That's true, but...”

lines.japanese: 「でも目につくのは悪い部分ばかりだ」
lines.english: “And yet the bad is all we ever seem to notice.”

lines.japanese: 「……人間って、弱いね」
lines.english: “...Human beings are weak.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃねぇ……」
lines.english: “Well, yes...”

lines.japanese:
「群れてなかったら、繁栄することもできなかった
　でしょうね」
lines.english: “We could never have prospered if we hadn't gathered in groups.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ人は群れたのかな」
lines.english: “Why did people gather together, I wonder?”

lines.japanese: 「寂しかった、からかな」
lines.english: “Perhaps... because they were lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「原始人が？」
lines.english: “Primitive people?”

lines.japanese: 「……たぶん。あるいは」
lines.english: “...Perhaps. Or else...”

lines.japanese:
「想像もできないけど、でも……一人で古代の寒さ
　と暗さと空腹の中に置かれたら、尊厳なんてあっ
　たものじゃないんだろうな」
lines.english: “I can't even imagine it. But... if you were left alone amid the cold, darkness, and hunger of the ancient world, there would be no question of preserving your dignity.”

lines.japanese:
「守るものがないと……あるいはそれは家族だった
　り倫理だったりして、そういうものがないと……
　心の強さを発揮する場所がないんだから」
lines.english: “If you have nothing to protect... whether it's family, morality, or something else... then the strength of your heart has nowhere to go.”

lines.japanese:
「人間には、他人が必要なんだ。
　その善し悪しを別として」
lines.english: “Human beings need other people. Whether that's a good thing or a bad one.”

lines.japanese: 「……名言かもね、それ」
lines.english: “…That might be worth quoting.”

lines.japanese: 「でも他人がいることで、悩むこともあるわよね」
lines.english: “But having other people around creates its own troubles.”

lines.japanese: 「仕方ないことだよ」
lines.english: “That can't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「荒野は……」
lines.english: “The wilderness...”

lines.japanese: 「荒野？」
lines.english: “The wilderness?”

lines.japanese:
「誰一人いない荒野に、僕らは耐えられないん
　だから」
lines.english: “Because none of us could endure a wilderness without a single other person in it.”

lines.japanese: 「狂ってしまうしかないわね」
lines.english: “We would have no choice but to go mad.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだねぇ」
lines.english: “...I suppose so.”

lines.japanese:
「ねえ、さっき良い面と悪い面って言ったけど……
　そのどちらもが切り捨てられないで、そのどちら
　もが互いに有害であった場合、どうする？」
lines.english: “You spoke of the good and the bad just now... But what if neither can be cast away, and each is harmful to the other? What would you do?”

lines.japanese: 「忍はどうする？」
lines.english: “What would you do, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「……難しいよ」
lines.english: “...That's difficult.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ見ているだけ？
　状況に流されるだけ？それとも行動？」
lines.english: “Would you just watch? Let events carry you along? Or would you act?”

lines.japanese:
「行動するといっても、それは方針を決めることで、
　つまりはどちらかを切り捨てるかは選ばないとい
　けない」
lines.english: “Even to act is to choose a course, and that means you must decide which side to cast away.”

lines.japanese:
「好きな方を選ぶということ。
　それは嫌いな方を選ぶということよ」
lines.english: “Choosing the one you love means choosing the one you hate.”

lines.japanese: 「……捨ててもいい方を選ぶという働きかけよ」
lines.english: “...It means choosing which one you're willing to abandon.”

lines.japanese:
「でも、どっちを切るべきかわからないから、動け
　ない」
lines.english: “But when you can't tell which one to cut away, you can't move.”

lines.japanese:
「それは孤独だもの。誰にも話せないという孤独。
　飢えと寒さ」
lines.english: “That is loneliness. The loneliness of being unable to speak to anyone. Hunger and cold.”

lines.japanese: 「……暗闇よ」
lines.english: “...Darkness.”

lines.japanese: 「だから私は、たぶんうずくまる」
lines.english: “And so I'd probably just curl up.”

lines.japanese: 「成り行きに任せてしまう。選べないから」
lines.english: “I'd let things run their course, because I couldn't choose.”
“...Fueko.”

lines.japanese:
言いしれない悲しみに襲われた。
　光が射せば闇が生まれると彼女は嘆いた。
　絆を求めればそうではない関係が罪と化す。
lines.english: An inexpressible sorrow came over him. Where light fell, darkness was born—so she lamented. Seek a bond, and any relationship outside it becomes a sin.

lines.japanese:
人生にはそんな局面だってあるかも知れない。
　忍は理解しようとした。
　ありとあらゆることを理解しようとした。
lines.english: Perhaps there really were times like that in life. Shinobu tried to understand. He tried to understand it all.

lines.japanese:
そして……絶望を見た。
　若い心が、乗り越えられると囁いた。
lines.english: And then... he saw despair. His young heart whispered that it could be overcome.

lines.japanese:
しかし老いた意識は、その不可能性を濁流の如く
知らしめた。
lines.english: But his aged consciousness bore down like a torrent, forcing him to recognize that it was impossible.

lines.japanese:
忍と笛子は同じ悩みを持っていた。
　ただ……規模が異なっただけで。
lines.english: Shinobu and Fueko carried the same anguish. Only... its scale was different.

lines.japanese: 「……ごめんね、変な話して」
lines.english: “...Sorry for talking about something so strange.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは変な話じゃない」
lines.english: “No. It isn't strange.”

lines.japanese: だから。
lines.english: And so—

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、笛子」
lines.english: “Listen, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 力強く忍は応えた。
lines.english: Shinobu answered firmly.

lines.japanese:
「はじまりは孤独で。まず孤独であることを知り、
　孤独であることのつらさ、不自然さを知る」
lines.english: “It begins in loneliness. First you learn that you are alone, and then you learn how painful, how unnatural that loneliness is.”

lines.japanese:
「……そのうち求めて、手に入れる。
　欲しかった関係だよ、それは」
lines.english: “...In time, you seek it out and find it. The relationship you wanted.”

lines.japanese:
「だけどそれは笛子の言うとおり、永遠のものでは
　ないかも知れない」
lines.english: “But as you say, that relationship may not last forever.”

lines.japanese:
「いつか何かと引き替えにしろと強いられるのかも
　知れない」
lines.english: “One day, we may be forced to trade it for something else.”

lines.japanese:
「……時間は待ってはくれない。だから僕らは大切
　であればあるほど、それを失った時のことを考え
　て生きていかなければならない」
lines.english: “...Time will not wait. The more precious something is to us, the more we must live with the thought of what will happen when we lose it.”

lines.japanese: 「だから……」
lines.english: “And so...”

lines.japanese:
「だから……もし僕らの輪が砕け散ってしまうとし
　ても、今までの楽しかったことを忘れないように
　しようよ」
lines.english: “And so... even if our circle shatters one day, let's make sure we never forget all the happiness that came before.”

lines.japanese:
「そこには最善の今があったんだって力強く思うん
　だ」
lines.english: “We have to believe with all our hearts that, there and then, we had the best possible now.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ時間の果てに置かれただけの、むごたらしい
　結末よりも、価値があると信じよう」
lines.english: “Let's believe it has more worth than some hideous ending merely waiting at the far end of time.”

lines.japanese:
「最後の瞬間によって、それまで歩んだ道筋を評価
　することをやめよう」
lines.english: “Let's stop allowing the final moment to pass judgment on every step that led to it.”

lines.japanese:
「結果論を捨てる。いずれ残酷な時間に立ち向かう
　には、それしかないんだから」
lines.english: “We have to stop judging everything by how it ends. It's the only way we can ever face the cruelty of time.”

lines.japanese:
「……ど、どうしたの？　人が変わったみたいに……
　それに、肩、いたい……」
lines.english: “...Wh-what's come over you? You're like a different person... And you're hurting my shoulder...”

lines.japanese: 「僕は希望を持てとは言わない」
lines.english: “I won't tell you to have hope.”

lines.japanese: 「明るい未来を信じて、賭けろなんて言えない」
lines.english: “I can’t tell you to believe in a bright future and take that gamble.”

lines.japanese: 「祈る神さまもいやしない」
lines.english: “There is no god for us to pray to.”

lines.japanese: 「僕たちは一人なんだ、笛子」
lines.english: “We're each alone, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「……そして、そして笛子はさ！」
lines.english: “...And—and you, Fueko!”

lines.japanese:
笛子は忍の瞳が明々と輝くのを呆然と覗いた。
　薄暗い大地で、非人間的な色彩を帯びた。
　きっと笛子はそれを哀しく感じた。
lines.english: Dumbstruck, Fueko stared into Shinobu's brightly blazing eyes. Against the darkening earth, they had taken on an inhuman hue. Fueko must have found it sad.

lines.japanese:
「どうしても駄目になったら、僕のところに来るん
　だ」
lines.english: “If it ever becomes truly unbearable, come to me.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして……？」
冷たい双眼が少女を射抜く。
lines.english: Two cold eyes pierced the girl.

lines.japanese: 「君を食べて、僕の一部にするためだよ」
lines.english: “So that I can eat you and make you part of me.”

lines.japanese: 冗談を言う顔ではなかった。
lines.english: His was not the face of someone making a joke.

lines.japanese:
恐怖と安堵に挟まれ、笛子は対応に迷った。
　拒絶と肯定のあわいを彷徨った。
　やがて、少女が導き出したものは―――
lines.english: Caught between fear and relief, Fueko did not know how to respond. She drifted through the space between rejection and acceptance. At last, the girl reached an answer—

lines.japanese: 「……ありがとう」
lines.english: “...Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「それって、きっとすごく楽なんでしょうね」
lines.english: “That must be such a relief.”

lines.japanese: 「限りなく死に近いから」
lines.english: “Because it comes infinitely close to death.”

lines.japanese:
「つまり、もう苦しむことがなくなるってことだか
　ら」
lines.english: “In other words, you would never have to suffer again.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そんな気がする」
lines.english: “Yes. It feels that way.”

lines.japanese:
「でも……この気持ちが慰められることがあるだな
　んて、思わなかった……」
lines.english: “But... I never imagined anything could bring comfort to this feeling...”

lines.japanese: 「そんな理屈も、私には遠かった……」
lines.english: “Even that way of thinking had been beyond my reach...”

lines.japanese: 「忍がみんなを集めた。私も集められた」
lines.english: “You brought everyone together. You brought me in too.”

lines.japanese:
「だから私、あなたにならいいと思える……
　たぶんみんなも……」
lines.english: “That's why I think I'd be all right with you... Maybe everyone would...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、みんながあなたを頼ったら？」
lines.english: “But what if everyone relied on you?”

lines.japanese: 「全員おいしくいただく」
lines.english: “I’d savor every last one of you.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、そうよね……でも、そんなことだって平気
　になってしまうんでしょうね」
lines.english: “Well, of course... But I suppose even that would eventually stop troubling you.”

lines.japanese: 「そういうことになるね」
lines.english: “I suppose it would.”

lines.japanese: 寂しげに忍は認める。
lines.english: Shinobu admitted it sadly.

lines.japanese: 「最後の手段だけどね」
lines.english: “Only as a last resort.”

lines.japanese:
「……最期に逃げこめる場所があるっていいものよ。
　人は尊厳を捨てたあとも生きていかないといけな
　いものだから」
lines.english: “...It is good to have somewhere you can flee at the very end. Because human beings must go on living even after they have surrendered their dignity.”

lines.japanese:
だとしても……仲間を“食べて”しまうことは、
忍の本意ではないはずだ。
lines.english: Even so... surely it was not Shinobu's true wish to ‘eat’ his companions.

lines.japanese:
笛子もそれを読み取った。
　そして一つの大きな疑問を、口に出した。
lines.english: Fueko understood that as well. Then she gave voice to a single, enormous question.

lines.japanese:
「でも……じゃあ最後に一人残ったとき、忍はどう
　するの？」
lines.english: “But... when you are the last one left, what will you do?”

lines.japanese: 「僕はね」
言い淀む。
lines.english: He faltered.

lines.japanese: 「誰もあなたのことを救えないの？」
lines.english: “Is there no one who can save you?”

lines.japanese: 「僕は……忘れないでいる」
lines.english: “I'll... make sure I never forget.”

lines.japanese:
「今という一日があったこととか、今みたいな瞬間
　があったことを」
lines.english: “That there was a day called now, and moments like this one.”

lines.japanese:
笛子は稲妻に打たれたように立ち尽くした。
　背中が意識しないうちに壁から離れていた。
lines.english: Fueko froze as though struck by lightning. Without her realizing it, her back had come away from the wall.

lines.japanese: 「……忍だけが、つらいままじゃない」
lines.english: “...Then you'd be the only one left in pain.”

lines.japanese: 「僕がはじめたことだから」
lines.english: “Because I started it.”
“Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと、いい？」
lines.english: “Can I...?”

lines.japanese: 「何を？」
lines.english: “Can you what?”

lines.japanese: 純真無垢な顔。
lines.english: A face of pure innocence.

lines.japanese: 「察してください」
lines.english: “Take the hint.”
“...What? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「目を閉じてって言ったの！」
lines.english: “I told you to close your eyes!”

lines.japanese: 「い、言ったっけそんなこと？」
lines.english: “D-did you say anything of the sort?”

lines.japanese: 「うがー！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: 「閉じますっ」
lines.english: “Closing them!”

lines.japanese: 「……で、何だって？」
lines.english: “...So, what was it?”

lines.japanese: 「もういいから、動くな」
lines.english: “Never mind. Just don't move.”

lines.japanese: 「ぅあぃ」
lines.english: “O-kay.”

lines.japanese: 観念した。
lines.english: He resigned himself.

lines.japanese: 「……あの、痛くしないで！」
lines.english: “...Um, please don't hurt me!”

lines.japanese: 「……痛いわけないでしょ」
lines.english: “...Of course it won't hurt.”

lines.japanese: 呆れた声が、妙に近い。
lines.english: Her exasperated voice was strangely close.

lines.japanese:
笛子が身を傾けたのか、風の流れを感じた。
　息遣いが接近し、密着した。
lines.english: He felt a current of air—perhaps Fueko had leaned toward him. Her breathing came closer, right up against him.

lines.japanese:
唇同士がかすり、かすかな味も残さず離れた。
　目を開く時、莫大な精神力を必要とした。
lines.english: Their lips brushed, then parted without leaving behind even the faintest taste. It took an immense act of will for him to open his eyes.

lines.japanese:
対応を極めかねる忍の脇、夕日以外の成分で朱に
染まる笛子が、唇を手で覆っていた。
lines.english: Beside Shinobu, who had no idea how to respond, Fueko covered her lips with one hand, her face dyed scarlet by something other than the sunset.

lines.japanese: 「こ、これもあなたの“今”だといいなと思う」
lines.english: “I-I hope this can be your ‘now,’ too.”

lines.japanese: じんわりと心が麻痺していった。
lines.english: His heart slowly went numb.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いいから、コメントは結構よっ」
lines.english: “No, that's all right. No comment necessary!”

lines.japanese: 「まあ……短絡かなって思ってて……」
lines.english: “Well... I did think it might be rather impulsive...”

lines.japanese: 「あ……ええと……」

会話が成立しない。
　落ち着き無く、忍は体の向きを右に左に変える。
lines.english: Conversation had become impossible. Restlessly, Shinobu turned first one way, then the other.

lines.japanese: そして小走りに工場から離れた。
lines.english: Then he jogged away from the factory.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと？」
lines.english: “Wait, what?”

lines.japanese: そして夕日に向かって、叫び声を上げた。
lines.english: Then, facing the sunset, he let out a shout.

lines.japanese:
深い睡眠に捕縛されていた。
　別段、夜更かししたわけでも睡眠不足でもない。
lines.english: He was held captive by a deep sleep. He had not stayed up late, nor was he short on rest.

lines.japanese:
だが休日であるこの日、張りつめがちだった忍の
気持ちも緩んでいた。
lines.english: But it was a day off, and Shinobu, who had been rather tense, had relaxed.

lines.japanese: 熟睡―――
lines.english: Fast asleep—

lines.japanese:
時刻はすでに八時を回り、七時半にセットした携
帯のアラームも、すでに止まっている。
lines.english: It was already past eight, and the alarm on his phone, set for seven thirty, had fallen silent.

lines.japanese:
千鳥はそんな忍の寝台の真横に立ち、艶のない視
線を斜めに落としていた。

lines.english: “Oh, those scary-looking people are hanging around... Let's keep our distance.”

lines.japanese: 「……別に絡まれる理由はないけど」
lines.english: “...They have no reason to bother us.”

lines.japanese:
「そういう理屈が通用しない人たちもいるから。
　この制服、ただでさえ目立つの」
lines.english: “Some people don't listen to reason. And this uniform already draws enough attention.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は別に怖くない」
lines.english: “I'm not afraid of them.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ、私が怖いということで……ね？
　余計なトラブルはいやなの」
lines.english: “Then let's say I am... All right? I don't want any unnecessary trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「……笛子が言うなら」
lines.english: “...If you say so.”

lines.japanese: 「そういえば、笛子のタイプって聞いたことないね」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, I've never heard what your type is.”

lines.japanese: 「ええと……」
lines.english: “Well...”

lines.japanese: 「参考までに教えてよ」
lines.english: “Go on. I'd like to know, for reference.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね……うーん……タイプ、タイプ」
lines.english: “Let's see... Hmm... My type, my type...”

lines.japanese: 「あなたみたいな男の子、はけっこう好きよ」
lines.english: “I like boys like you quite a bit.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとは照れてくれた？」
lines.english: “Did I make you blush at least a little?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……ん、なんだろう……この気持ちは……」
lines.english: “No... Hm. What is this feeling...?”

lines.japanese: 「少し、もやもやしたと思う」
lines.english: “I think I feel a little unsettled.”

lines.japanese: 「冷静ね……まあ光栄なことだと思っておくわね」
lines.english: “You're very calm about this... Well, I'll take it as a compliment.”

lines.japanese: 道行く少女の一人に、目をとめる。
lines.english: Fueko noticed one of the girls walking past.

lines.japanese: 「あら、高城さん……」
lines.english: “Oh, Takashiro...”

lines.japanese: 「知り合い？」
lines.english: “Someone you know?”

lines.japanese: 「委員会で一緒なの」
lines.english: “We're on a committee together.”

lines.japanese: 「声かける？」
lines.english: “Want to say hello?”

lines.japanese: 「ああいうお姉さんタイプが好み？」
lines.english: “Is the mature type your thing?”

lines.japanese: 「特には」
lines.english: “Not especially.”

lines.japanese: 「どっちかというと笛子の方が親しめる」
lines.english: “If anything, you're easier to talk to.”

lines.japanese:
「……あなたのそういうストレートなところ、
　凄いと思うわ……」
lines.english: “...I have to admire how directly you say these things...”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ、伊月さん！」
lines.english: “Hi, Izuki!”

lines.japanese: 「こんにちは」
lines.english: “Good afternoon.”

lines.japanese: 「相変わらずハイソね！」
lines.english: “Still so posh!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうかしら？」
lines.english: “A-am I?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたの話し口調、全然砕けてなくてうちのお祖
　母ちゃんみたいだもの！」
lines.english: “You never talk casually. You sound just like my grandma!”

lines.japanese: 「で、そちらの子は？　彼氏？」
lines.english: “And who's this? Your boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: 「ボーイフレンドなの」
lines.english: “He's my boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「ヒュ～♪　結構、攻めるタイプだったわけね！」
lines.english: “Whoo! So you're the type who makes the first move!”

lines.japanese: 「貴宮です」
lines.english: “Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「高城です。よろしく」
lines.english: “I'm Takashiro. Nice to meet you.”

lines.japanese:
「今日は友達の家に呼ばれて遊びに来たはいいけど、
　突然その子の彼氏から呼び出しがかかって急遽、
　予定をキャンセルされてぶらついてまーす！」
lines.english: “A friend invited me over today, but then her boyfriend suddenly called, so she canceled our plans at the last second, and now I'm killing time!”

lines.japanese: 「大変ですね。ご一緒しますか？」
lines.english: “That's unfortunate. Would you like to join us?”

lines.japanese: 「わお。どうしよう、誘われちゃったよ伊月さん？」
lines.english: “Wow, Izuki, what do I do? He just invited me along!”

lines.japanese: 「ええと、その、ごめんなさいダメ」
lines.english: “Um, well... I'm sorry, but no.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、冗談だって！」
lines.english: “Ahaha! I'm only kidding!”

lines.japanese:
「あれ、でもタイプは年上のニヒル系だって言って
　なかった？」
lines.english: “Wait, didn't you say you liked older men with that brooding look?”

lines.japanese: 「けほっ、こほっ」
lines.english: “Khh—khh.”

lines.japanese: 「年上？」
lines.english: “Older?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとオジサマ入ってる方がいいようなことを」
lines.english: “I remember you saying you liked a bit of a silver fox.”

lines.japanese: 「オジサマ？」
lines.english: “A silver fox?”

lines.japanese: 「それは、そのね……」
lines.english: “That was... Well...”

lines.japanese: 「か、彼はこれでもかなりクールでニヒルよ！」
lines.english: “H-he is actually quite cool and brooding!”
“Fueko...”

lines.japanese:
「呼び捨てかい……すげえ、予想以上に進んでいる
　のか？」
lines.english: “First names already... Wow. Are you two even farther along than I thought?”

lines.japanese: 「高城さん、あまり想像しすぎないでね……」
lines.english: “Takashiro, please don't let your imagination run away with you...”

lines.japanese:
「あとは年齢問題だけか。ま、全てが理想通りには
　行かないってことよね！」
lines.english: “So age is the only issue. Well, I suppose you can't have everything exactly the way you want it!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうね」
lines.english: “Y-yes, I suppose.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、あたしもう行くね。邪魔しちゃ悪いし。
　すごい肉まんのお店探さないと！」
lines.english: “Oh, I'd better go. I don't want to get in your way. I have to find that amazing pork-bun place!”

lines.japanese:
「その肉まんというのは、ビフテキまんのことです
　か？」
lines.english: “When you say pork bun, do you mean the beefsteak bun?”

lines.japanese:
「そ。前にネットで見て。せっかく来たんだから、
　せめて地元名物くらいは食べていこうと！
　ただどの店がそうなのかわからなくて……」
lines.english: “That's it. I saw it online before. Since I'm already here, I thought I should at least try a local specialty! I just don't know which shop sells it...”

lines.japanese: 「たくさんありますからね、ここ」
lines.english: “There are a lot of shops here.”

lines.japanese:
「真っ直ぐ行って、あの二枚目の垂れ幕の右側にあ
　る店がそうだと思いますよ。龍将ってお店です」
lines.english: “Go straight ahead. It should be the shop to the right of the second banner. It's called Ryusho.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、そうなんだ。ありがとねー。伊月さんがんば
　れー。貴宮君がんばれー。人類みんながんばれー！
　ぐばーい！」
lines.english: “Oh, really? Thanks! You got this, Izuki! You got this, Atemiya! Everybody on Earth, you got this! G'bye!”

lines.japanese: 「賑やかな人でしたね」
lines.english: “She was certainly energetic.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええ……学校でもあんな感じで……」
lines.english: “Y-yes... She's like that at school too...”

lines.japanese: 「人類みんなを励ましていきましたよ？」
lines.english: “She just left after cheering on the whole human race, didn't she?”

lines.japanese:
「そ、そうみたいね、たぶんその場の勢いだと思う
　けど……」
lines.english: “S-so it would seem. She was probably carried away by the moment, though...”

lines.japanese: 「……ニヒルなオジサマ？」
lines.english: “...A brooding silver fox?”

lines.japanese: 「そうね、嘘をつくのはいけないことね……」
lines.english: “You're right. I shouldn't have lied...”

lines.japanese: 「オジサマ、オジサマか」
lines.english: “A silver fox, huh. A silver fox...”

lines.japanese:
「……やっぱり粘着するのね。
　そんな気はしていたけど」
lines.english: “...I knew you'd latch onto that. I had a feeling.”

lines.japanese: 「本屋だ。オジサマ写真集でも見ていく？」
lines.english: “There's a bookstore. Want to look for a silver-fox photo book?”

lines.japanese: 「ありませんそんな写真集！」
lines.english: “No such photo book exists!”

lines.japanese: 「人間っていくつからオジサマになるんだと思う？」
lines.english: “How old does a man have to be before he counts as a silver fox?”

lines.japanese: 「私に訊かないでください」
lines.english: “Don't ask me.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、あのおじさんはどう？　タイプ？」
lines.english: “Then what about that guy? Your type?”

lines.japanese: 「……もう許して欲しいわ……」
lines.english: “...Please, have mercy...”

lines.japanese: 「そろそろお昼ね」
lines.english: “It's almost lunchtime.”

lines.japanese: 「少し早いけど、お店混む前に食べようか？」
lines.english: “It's a little early, but shall we eat before the lunch rush?”
“Mm.”

lines.japanese: 「どこで食べようか」
lines.english: “Where should we eat?”

lines.japanese: すっと忍が指さす。
lines.english: Shinobu pointed without hesitation.

lines.japanese: 「めし屋亭」
lines.english: “Grub House.”

lines.english: “...A diner, is it?”

lines.english: “The truth is, I don't have much money with me.”

lines.english: “So you're short on cash?”

lines.japanese: 「あといい店も知らないし」

lines.english: “You don't know one?”

lines.japanese: 「……まったく」

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうするわよ？」

lines.japanese: 「でも」

lines.japanese: 「伊月です」
lines.english: “This is Izuki.”

lines.japanese: 心なしか、声が硬くなっている。
lines.english: Her voice seemed to harden.

lines.japanese:
「……はい、ええ。今は外です……いえ、違います。

lines.english: “...Yes. Mm-hm. I'm out at the moment... No, that isn't it. This is personal.”

lines.japanese: 用件は短いものだったようだ。
lines.english: The call seemed to be brief.

lines.japanese: 「わかりました。では後ほど。はい」
lines.english: “Understood. Until later, then. Yes.”

lines.japanese:
電話を切る。
　忍に向き直った。
lines.english: She ended the call. Then she turned back to Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい。急用ができたみたい」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Something urgent has come up.”
“...Something urgent?”

lines.japanese: 「妹を迎えに行かないといけなくなっちゃった」
lines.english: “I have to go and pick up my little sister.”

lines.japanese: 「家族を優先するのは当たり前だと思うよ」
lines.english: “Of course your family comes first.”

lines.japanese:
「ごめんね。この埋め合わせはまた今度……
　もし良ければまた明日、というのはいかが？」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I'll make it up to you next time... If you don't mind, how about tomorrow?”

lines.japanese: 「僕は構わない」
lines.english: “Tomorrow is fine with me.”

lines.japanese:
枝葉にひととき乗った花弁のようなはかなさで、
笛子は微笑した。
lines.english: Fueko smiled, fleeting as a petal resting for a moment on a branch.

lines.japanese: 「訓練は仕切直しね。ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “We'll have to start the training over. I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「すぐ行かないといけないの？」
lines.english: “Do you have to leave right away?”

lines.japanese:
「まだもう少し……
　でも食事をするほどの余裕はないかな」
lines.english: “I have a little more time... But not enough for a meal.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、明日はお勉強を見てあげましょー」
lines.english: “I know! Tomorrow, I'll help you study.”

lines.japanese: ぴっと女教師然で指を立てる。
lines.english: She snapped one finger up like a schoolteacher.

lines.japanese: 「やっぱりごちそうさせて」
lines.english: “Let me treat you after all.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 自動販売機を指さす。
lines.english: He pointed at a vending machine.

lines.japanese: 「ジュースならいいと思う」
lines.english: “A drink should be all right.”

lines.japanese: 「……ごちそうになります」
lines.english: “...Then I'll take you up on it.”

lines.japanese:
はにかむ顔が、そのときだけ周囲の喧噪から剥離
した。
lines.english: For that one moment, her bashful smile seemed to slip free of the bustle around them.

lines.japanese: 「そういうアドリブは、少しドキドキするかも」
lines.english: “That kind of improvisation might make my heart race a little.”

lines.japanese:
「……残った時間と予算から、程度を下げただけだ

lines.english: “...I only scaled things down to fit the time and money we had left.”

lines.japanese: 「結果的にはそうでも、ね」
lines.english: “That may be how it happened, but still.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなものかな……わからないな」
lines.english: “Is that how it works...? I don't understand.”

lines.japanese:
このとき笛子は、胸中に生じた好意をほとんど無
造作に、忍へと放り投げた。
lines.english: In that moment, Fueko tossed Shinobu the affection rising inside her with almost careless ease.

lines.japanese:
笛子には珍しい未加工の本音。
　つぶやきに近いそれを、忍の耳は確かにとらえた。
lines.english: A rare, unfiltered glimpse of Fueko's true feelings. It was barely above a murmur, but Shinobu heard it clearly.

lines.japanese: 「……今、なんて言った？」
lines.english: “...What did you just say?”

lines.japanese: 「え……えぇと、その」
lines.english: “Oh... um, well...”

lines.japanese: 「笛子」
lines.english: “Fueko.”

lines.japanese:
唇をきゅっと結び、そして少し頬を染め、こう繰
り返した。
lines.english: She pressed her lips together, her cheeks coloring slightly, then repeated herself.

lines.japanese:
「生まれ変わったら……恋のやり直しをしようかな
　って、言ったのよ？」
lines.english: “I said that if I were born again... maybe I'd give love another try.”

lines.japanese:
「でね、さっきの高城さんが、ぜんぶ食べちゃって
　たの」
lines.english: “And then Takashiro, that girl from before, went and ate all of it.”

lines.japanese:
会話は、あまり頭に入らなかった。

lines.english: The conversation barely registered. Fueko had grown unusually talkative, as though trying to bridge the gap, and he simply listened to whatever she said.

lines.japanese:
それも長くは続かない。

lines.english: That did not last long either. By the time his can of coffee was about half gone—

lines.japanese: 「……笛子は、何か悩み事があるんじゃないの？」
lines.english: “...Is something bothering you, Fueko?”

lines.japanese: ぴたり、と少女の言葉が途切れた。
lines.english: The girl's words stopped dead.

lines.japanese:
３０秒かけて、抑制された質問を押し出す。
　管理されすぎていささか冷たい語調で。
lines.english: She took thirty seconds to force out the carefully restrained question, her tone chilled by too much control.

lines.japanese: 「どうしてそう思うの？」

lines.japanese: 「なんとなく」

lines.japanese: 「……なんとなく、か」
lines.english: “...A feeling, huh.”

lines.japanese:
張りつめかけた空気を、笛子は際に達する前に自

lines.japanese: 「まいったわね。わかっちゃうんだ……」
lines.english: “Well, you've got me. So you can tell...”

lines.japanese: 「……僕らの関係って、なんだろう」
lines.english: “...What are we to each other?”

lines.japanese: 「か、関係って……」
lines.english: “O-our relationship...?”

lines.japanese: うろたえる。
lines.english: She faltered.

lines.japanese: 「友達だと思って、いいんだよね？」
lines.english: “I can think of you as a friend, right?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ええ……そっちの方なら……もちろん」
lines.english: “Oh, yes... If that's what you mean... of course.”

lines.japanese:
「僕は人付き合いがうまくないし……こんな時笛子

lines.english: “I'm not good with people... and at a time like this, I don't know how to act around you.”

lines.japanese:
「友達のことを心配するのは、間違っていない

lines.english: “But worrying about a friend isn't wrong, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「どうなの？」
lines.english: “Well?”

lines.japanese: 「……間違ってはいないわ」
lines.english: “...No. It isn't wrong.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたはちゃんと考えてる。つきあいに慣れてな

lines.english: “You put real thought into it. Even if you're not used to being close to people, you conduct yourself so you won't hurt them needlessly. You're trying to.”

lines.english: “That's why you bought that book, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「……笛子も」

lines.japanese: 「そうね。だから今こうしているわけよね……」
lines.english: “Yes. That's why we're here together now...”

lines.english: “I only have six friends.”

lines.english: “One of them is struggling with something. And that... is probably one seventh of the world to me.”

lines.japanese: 「助けになれるかも知れない。助けになってもいい」
lines.english: “Maybe I can help. Maybe it's all right for me to help.”

lines.japanese: 「……いや、違うな。この言い方は」

lines.japanese: 「助けてあげたい」

lines.japanese: 笛子の目を見て告げた。

lines.japanese:
「……最近、自分がよくわからない。昔だったら、

lines.english: “...Lately, I haven't known what to make of myself. Before, I never would've felt this way.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は間違ってる？」

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「それで、できたら……ずっと……」
lines.english: “And if possible… always…”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと一緒に―――」
lines.english: “Stay together, always—”

lines.japanese: 「ダメよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 決然とした口調。
lines.english: Her voice was resolute.

lines.japanese: 「なぜ？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese:
「確かに、僕は頼りないかも知れないけど……だけ

lines.english: “I know I may not be very dependable... But if you taught me more—more of what you know—then maybe...”

lines.japanese: 「そうじゃないの」
lines.english: “That's not it.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあなぜ？」
lines.english: “Then why?”

lines.japanese: 「忍が、エスコートしてくれるんでしょう？」
lines.english: “You're going to escort me, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ」
lines.english: “I suppose.”

lines.japanese:
「……じゃあ、今日は規則とか忘れてイチャつきま
　しょ」
lines.english: “...Then let's forget the rules for today and act as lovey-dovey as we like.”

lines.japanese: 「ストレートすぎるよね、その発言は」
lines.english: “That's a little too direct.”

lines.japanese: 「……言ってから私もそう思った」
lines.english: “...I thought so too as soon as I said it.”

lines.japanese: ふと思いついて、顔を寄せる。
lines.english: The thought came to him, and he leaned closer.

lines.japanese: 「……な、なにっ」
lines.english: “...W-what?”

lines.japanese: 「動かないで」
lines.english: “Don't move.”

lines.japanese:
少し退くが、逃げなかった。
　額が接触しそうな距離で、目を合わせる。
　限界まで引いた顎が初々しい。
lines.english: She leaned back a little but didn't flee. Their eyes met, their foreheads almost touching. The way she'd tucked her chin in as far as it would go was endearingly innocent.

lines.japanese: 「……な、なによう」
lines.english: “...W-what is it?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、恥っかきもデートの醍醐味のうちかなと」
lines.english: “I figured making fools of ourselves was part of what makes a date fun.”

lines.japanese: 「そっち全然焦ってない。不公平」
lines.english: “You're not flustered at all. That's unfair.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、性格だしね」
lines.english: “That's just my personality.”

lines.japanese: 「美人のお姉さんと暮らしてるものね」
lines.english: “You do live with a beautiful older sister.”

lines.japanese: 「……千鳥姉さんは、まあ美人だけど」
lines.english: “...My sister Chidori is beautiful, I suppose.”

hyperlinks.preview: Presenting a continuing series on Sis Chidori’s peculiar daily life, complete with horrifying facts.

lines.japanese: 「生気がないんだよね。イマイチ」
lines.english: “But she has no life in her. Kind of a letdown.”

lines.japanese: 「私にはパリッとしてるように見えるんだけど……」
lines.english: “She looks perfectly polished to me...”

lines.japanese: 「認識の違いってやつだね」
lines.english: “Different perspectives.”

lines.japanese: 「今の私の認識も、普段と違ってるみたいよ？」
lines.english: “My perspective seems different from usual today too, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「いいことだ。有効活用しよう」
lines.english: “Good. Let's put that to use.”

lines.japanese: 「……でも、どういう風の吹き回し？」
lines.english: “...But what brought this on?”
“Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「……わかんない。なんとなく」
lines.english: “...I don't know. I just felt like it.”

lines.japanese: 「いい思い出になるかなって」
lines.english: “I thought it might be a good memory to have.”

lines.japanese: 「……ふぅん」

「でも、どうなんだろ……こういうのが、あとで悪
　い思い出になったりするのかしら……」
lines.english: “Still... I wonder if something like this could turn into a bad memory later...?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why would it?”

lines.japanese: 言葉を失った。
lines.english: She fell silent.

lines.japanese:
忍のいびつな心では、機微に触れることはできな
かった。
lines.english: Shinobu's misshapen heart could not register such delicate nuances.

lines.japanese: やがて笛子が声色を変えた。
lines.english: At length, Fueko's tone changed.

lines.japanese: 「そろそろ行く？」
lines.english: “Shall we get going?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「おでこあったかいけどね」
lines.english: “Your forehead is warm, though.”

lines.japanese: いつの間にか、密着していた。
lines.english: Somehow, they had ended up pressed right against each other.

lines.japanese: 「……対応に、困るんですけど……」
lines.english: “...I have no idea how to respond to this...”

lines.japanese: 「そう？」
lines.english: “Really?”

lines.japanese: 口には出さず、忍はめいっぱい反応を楽しんでいる。
lines.english: Without saying so, Shinobu savored her reaction to the fullest.
“Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「この格好って、バカップルに見えるんじゃ？」
lines.english: “Don't we look like one of those idiot couples right now?”

lines.japanese: 「というかバカップルそのものだな」
lines.english: “We don't just look like one. We are one.”

lines.japanese: 「はいここまでぇ！」
lines.english: “And that's enough of that!”

lines.japanese: 引き剥がされた。
lines.english: She tore herself away.

lines.japanese: 「……さっき任せるって」
lines.english: “...You said you'd leave things up to me.”

lines.japanese: 「おでこは任せない！」
lines.english: “Not my forehead!”

lines.japanese: 「そすか……」
lines.english: “Right, then...”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、どこへなりと連れていってくれる！？」
lines.english: “Now, will you take me somewhere—anywhere!?”

lines.japanese: 「へーい」
lines.english: “Okaaay.”

lines.japanese: 忍と笛子は、まあ健全な一日を過ごした。
lines.english: And so Shinobu and Fueko spent a fairly wholesome day together.

lines.japanese: 「……じゃあ、こんな感じかな」
lines.english: “...Well, I guess that's about it.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうね」
lines.english: “...I suppose so.”

lines.japanese: 「どうだった？」
lines.english: “How was it?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　そうね……まあまあ」
lines.english: “What? Well... it was all right.”

lines.japanese:
「うわ、それはどうだろう……
　一所懸命腰振ったのに」
lines.english: “Ouch, that's lukewarm... After all that hard work with my hips.”

lines.japanese: 「やめいっ！」
lines.english: “Stop that!”

lines.japanese: 吠えた。
lines.english: She roared.

lines.japanese: 「……え？　なにを？」
lines.english: “...What? Stop what?”

lines.japanese: 「誤解を招くような表現やめなさい！」
lines.english: “Stop phrasing things so people can take them the wrong way!”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……気が付かなかった」
lines.english: “Sorry... I didn't realize.”

lines.japanese: 「まったく……」
lines.english: “Honestly...”

lines.japanese: 微笑。
lines.english: A smile.

lines.japanese: 「でも、それが忍よね」
lines.english: “But that's just who you are, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「心外です」
lines.english: “I'm offended.”

lines.japanese: 「……嘘、楽しかった。あんがと」
lines.english: “...I'm kidding. I had fun. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、送ろうか？」
lines.english: “Oh, should I walk you home?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい。ちょっと妹迎えに行かないと」
lines.english: “Sorry. I have to go pick up my younger sister.”

lines.japanese: 「……そっか。じゃ、よろしく伝えといて」
lines.english: “...I see. Tell her I said hi, then.”

lines.japanese: 「了解よ」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、さよなら」
lines.english: “Goodbye, then.”

lines.japanese: 「さよなら、忍」
lines.english: “Goodbye, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: そして二人は別れた。
lines.english: And with that, they parted.

lines.japanese: そして笛子は、忍の後ろ姿を微動だにせず見守った。
lines.english: Fueko stood perfectly still, watching Shinobu recede into the distance.

lines.japanese: 奇妙な心持ちであった。
lines.english: A strange feeling came over her.

lines.japanese:
振り返って欲しいとも、そのまま歩み去ってほし
いとも思った。
lines.english: Part of her wanted him to look back; part of her wanted him to keep walking away.

lines.japanese:
自分を気にしてほしいとも、無視してほしいとも
思った。
lines.english: Part of her wanted him to care; part of her wanted him to ignore her.

lines.japanese:
相反する感情、しかし決着はついていた。
　葛藤は生じず、ただ痛みだけがある。
lines.english: The feelings contradicted each other, but the matter was already settled. There was no inner struggle, only pain.

lines.japanese:
自分が今まで何をしていて、これからどうしよう
としていたのか、記憶が飛んでいた。
lines.english: She'd forgotten what she'd been doing until now, or what she'd meant to do next.

lines.japanese: ぽっかりと放り出されて、何者でもない笛子だった。
lines.english: Cast out into the void, Fueko was no one at all.

lines.japanese: 「……ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese:
呟きを絹糸のように風に織り込む。
　そのかそけし声を聞く者はいない。
lines.english: She wove the murmur into the wind like a strand of silk. No one heard that faint voice.

lines.japanese: 「なんて……言う資格もない……」
lines.english: “As if... I even have the right to say that...”
“Ah—”

lines.japanese:
しゃがみこんでしまいたくなる。
　でも、それをしたらおしまいだ。
lines.english: She wanted to sink down into a crouch. But if she did, it would all be over.

lines.japanese:
しゃがんで諦め、考えることやめられたら、どれ
ほど楽だろう。
lines.english: How much easier it would be to crouch down, give up, and stop thinking altogether.

lines.japanese:
逆に、それをしたらおしまいだという恐怖もある。
　追いつめられた時、人は強くはいられない。
lines.english: But she was also afraid that doing so would mean the end. People couldn't stay strong when cornered.

lines.japanese:
葛藤の狭間に立って、解決不能と思える様々な問
題に直面すると、人は脆い。
lines.english: Caught between conflicting impulses, facing problems that seemed impossible to resolve, people were fragile.

lines.japanese:
だが笛子は思う。
　まだそれほど追い込まれてはいないはずだ、と。
lines.english: But Fueko thought: Surely she had not been driven that far yet.

lines.japanese: どこかで楽な自分がいる。確かに。
lines.english: Somewhere inside, a part of her was still at ease. That much was certain.

lines.japanese:
考えを巡らせようとすれば、意識は頭痛がするほ
ど錯綜し、細密な像を結ばない。
lines.english: Whenever she tried to think, her thoughts tangled until her head ached, refusing to resolve into a detailed picture.

lines.japanese: 疲れていた。
lines.english: She was tired.

lines.japanese:
もしかするとすでに諦め放棄した者の心境なので
はないかとさえ、笛子は感じた。
lines.english: Fueko even wondered if this was how it felt to be someone who had already given up on everything.

lines.japanese: 喉が渇く。
lines.english: Her throat was dry.

lines.japanese:
あまり設備の整った駅ではないが、ロータリーは
一部広場になっていて、水飲み場が設置されていた。
lines.english: The station was not especially well equipped, but part of the traffic circle opened into a plaza with a drinking fountain.

lines.japanese:
そこで笛子は顔を洗った。顔を引き締めて、冷た
い人間になろうと思った。
lines.english: Fueko washed her face there. Then she composed her features and resolved to become cold.

lines.japanese:
若い娘がするにしては奇妙な光景だが、幸い人通
りはほとんどない。
lines.english: It was an odd thing for a young woman to do, but fortunately there was hardly anyone passing by.

lines.japanese: 丹念に洗う。
lines.english: She washed carefully.

lines.japanese:
ついでに水も飲んだ。
　胃袋に冷たいものが流れた。
lines.english: She drank some water while she was at it. Something cold flowed into her stomach.

lines.japanese: 「こんなに、重いの……？」
lines.english: “everything... so heavy...?”

lines.japanese:
取り巻く環境のことごとくが、粘液となって笛子
に絡んだ。
lines.english: Everything around Fueko turned to slime and clung to her.

lines.japanese: 全てが億劫だ。
lines.english: Everything felt like too much trouble.

lines.japanese:
そして、その状態に対して強い焦りを感じる。
　唐突に悟る。
lines.english: She grew intensely anxious about the state she was in. Suddenly, she understood.

lines.japanese: 逃げても駄目なのだ。
lines.english: There was no use running.

lines.japanese:
逃げても未練がある限り、葛藤は生じてしまうの
だから。
lines.english: Even if she fled, there would still be conflict as long as her attachments remained.

lines.japanese:
痛みのない逃避をしようとすれば、また強さが必
要になってくる。
lines.english: To flee without pain would take a strength of its own.

lines.japanese:
今までのものを切り捨てる、強靱な冷淡さが。
　それがないから逃げるのに―――
lines.english: It would take an iron indifference strong enough to sever all that had come before. Yet she was fleeing precisely because she lacked it—

lines.japanese:
残したものに残留する気持ち。つらさ。苦痛。
　弱いまま逃げては、その苦しみを受け入れる他ない。
lines.english: Feelings that remained in all she'd left behind. Misery. Pain. If she fled while still weak, she had no choice but to accept that suffering.

lines.japanese: 消えないのだ。
lines.english: It wouldn't go away.

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、そうか」
lines.english: “...Oh. I see.”

lines.japanese:
麻痺すればいいんだ。
　感じないようにしてしまえば、いい。
lines.english: Then she only had to numb herself. Make herself unable to feel.

lines.japanese:
麻酔であらゆる体内の信号を殺し、ゆらゆらと揺
れる自由に身を任せる。
lines.english: Let anesthesia kill every signal in her body and surrender herself to a freedom that rocked and swayed.

lines.japanese:
新しいものを生み出す活力を、二度と得ることは
できないだろう。
lines.english: She would probably never again find the vitality to bring forth anything new.

lines.japanese:
“もの”とは自身のことだ。
　我……人格のことだ。
　人は莫大なエネルギーを投じて、自分を形作る。
lines.english: By ‘thing,’ she meant herself. The ego—the personality. It takes an enormous amount of energy for a person to shape a self.

lines.japanese:
二度創出するだけの余分なものを、持っている者
などいない。
lines.english: No one had enough left in reserve to create a self twice.

lines.japanese:
一度、麻痺―――いや、蘇生なき麻痺をそうとは
呼ぶまい―――破壊してしまったら、二度目はない
のだ、きっと。
lines.english: Once she numbed it—no, numbness from which there was no revival should not be called numbness—once she destroyed it, there would be no second chance. Surely not.

lines.japanese: 人の心に保険はない。
lines.english: The human heart had no insurance policy.

lines.japanese: 「私……なにしてるんだろ……」
lines.english: “What... am I doing...?”

lines.japanese:
愛した人がいる。
　仕方のないことだった。
　貴宮忍のことは好きだ。
lines.english: She had loved someone. It couldn’t be helped. She liked Shinobu Atemiya.

lines.japanese:
一緒にいて安心できる。あれで意外と頼れること
も知っている。
lines.english: With him, she felt safe. And she knew that, appearances to the contrary, he could be relied on.

lines.japanese:
言葉にはできない恩義がある。
　だが一枚目ではなかった。
lines.english: She owed him a debt no words could express. But his was not the first layer.

lines.japanese: 心に最初に張った情愛の薄膜は……忍ではなかった。
lines.english: The first thin film of affection spread across her heart... had not been Shinobu's.

lines.japanese:
だというのに、いまだ忍の存在は笛子にとって安
息そのものだ。
lines.english: And yet Shinobu's presence still brought Fueko perfect repose.

lines.japanese:
卑劣な、寄生虫のようで。
　笛子は吐いた。
lines.english: Vile. Like a parasite. Fueko vomited.

lines.japanese: 「笛子」
lines.english: “Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 少女は振り向いて、応じた。
lines.english: The girl turned and answered.

lines.japanese: 「……宗ちゃん」

慣れぬ気遣いに無表情になった顔が、高みに置か
れていた。
lines.english: Above her was a face gone blank with the unfamiliar effort of showing concern.

lines.japanese: 「へー」
lines.english: “Ohhh.”

lines.japanese: 中庭を見るなり、笛子は感嘆に声をあげた。
lines.english: Fueko cried out in admiration the moment she saw the courtyard.

lines.japanese: 「またキレーに整ってるわね」
lines.english: “Still as beautifully kept as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「ちゃんと手入れしてるからね」
lines.english: “I take proper care of it.”

lines.japanese:
「うん、これはいいわね。自分で歩き回れるのがい
　いな」
lines.english: “This is wonderful. I love that I can actually walk around in it myself.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、芝生って歩いたらだめだっけ？」
lines.english: “Oh, am I not supposed to walk on the lawn?”

lines.japanese: 「いよ。歩きなよ」
lines.english: “It's fine. Go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「うわぁ、ふわふわぁ」
lines.english: “Oh, it's so soft!”

lines.japanese: 「フフフ、女の子みたいに喜んで」
lines.english: “Heh heh. You’re getting all excited, like a girl.”

lines.japanese: 「女の子です！」
lines.english: “I am a girl!”

lines.japanese: 「知ってる」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: 「……寝そべってもいい？」
lines.english: “...Can I lie down?”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、寝そべろうか」
lines.english: “Sure. Let's lie down.”

lines.japanese: 二人は寝そべった。
lines.english: They lay down together.

lines.japanese: 「イカすわ……あなたの家」
lines.english: “This place is fantastic...”

lines.japanese: 「こればっかりは工場には用意できないものだしね」
lines.english: “The factory can't exactly give us something like this.”

lines.japanese: 「あったら怖いけどね……」
lines.english: “I'd be scared if it could...”

lines.japanese: 「これ、手入れ大変でしょう？」
lines.english: “This must take a lot of work to maintain.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。でも趣味みたいなものだから……」
lines.english: “It does. But it's practically a hobby...”

lines.japanese: 「いーなー、いいなぁ……」
lines.english: “I'm so jealous... So jealous...”

lines.japanese: 「本気でうらやましがってますね、この人」
lines.english: “Someone’s awfully jealous.”

lines.japanese: 「こういうの憧れてたの！」
lines.english: “I've always dreamed of something like this!”

lines.japanese: 「ここでお茶を飲みます」
lines.english: “I'd drink tea out here.”

lines.japanese: うっとりと言う。
lines.english: She spoke dreamily.

lines.japanese: 「なるほど……」
lines.english: “I see...”

lines.japanese: 「使ったことないの？　お客さん来たときとか……」
lines.english: “You've never used it? What about when people come over...?”

lines.japanese: 「来ない……」
lines.english: “No one comes...”

lines.japanese:
「そ、そうなの？　でも忍のお客さんじゃなくても、
　お姉さんとか？」
lines.english: “R-really? Even if they're not your guests, what about your sister's?”

lines.japanese: 「あの人、そんな社交的な人間じゃないよ」
lines.english: “She's not exactly a sociable person.”

lines.japanese: 「友達ひとりもいなかったりして」
lines.english: “Maybe she doesn't have a single friend.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか」
lines.english: “Surely not.”

lines.japanese: 刈り込まれた芝生の感触を、楽しむように転がる。
lines.english: She rolled around on the lawn, luxuriating in the feel of the clipped grass.

lines.japanese: 「このまま、大草原の小さな家で暮らしたい……」
lines.english: “I want to live like this, in my own Little House on the Prairie...”

lines.japanese: 「こらこら……」
lines.english: “Now, now...”

lines.japanese: 次にガーデンの花に目を留める。
lines.english: Then the flowers in the garden caught her eye.

lines.japanese: 「お花もきれい。いい時期に来ちゃった」
lines.english: “The flowers are beautiful too. I came at a good time.”

lines.japanese: 「季節ごとの花をつけるよ」
lines.english: “Something blooms here in every season.”

lines.japanese:
「私、ここだったら昼間から来たかった。
　というか朝から晩までいてもいいわよ」
lines.english: “I'd have liked to come here during the day. Actually, I'd happily stay from morning till night.”

lines.japanese: 「そう？　他には何もないよ？　退屈だよ？」
lines.english: “Really? There's nothing else here. You'd be bored.”

lines.japanese:
「紅茶飲みながら読書してるだけで、気持ちよさそ
　うだもの」
lines.english: “Just sitting here reading over a cup of tea sounds wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなもんか……わかんないけど」
lines.english: “Is that how it works...? I wouldn't know.”

lines.japanese: 「いい庭だわ。味が出てる」
lines.english: “It's a lovely garden. It has character.”

lines.japanese: 「笛子の家だって、いい庭だと思った」
lines.english: “I thought your garden was nice too.”

lines.japanese:
「……うちのは見るだけで、庭でお茶とかできない
　もの」
lines.english: “...Ours is only for looking at. We can't sit out there and have tea.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　忍って、うちに来たことあった？」
lines.english: “Wait—have you been to my house?”

lines.japanese: 「通りがかりに一度」
lines.english: “I passed by once.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、いい庭はいい庭なのかも知れないけど……
　ちょっと荒れてたでしょ？」
lines.english: “I mean, maybe it is a nice garden... But it was a little overgrown, wasn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「そうかな。ちょっと細かくは見てないのでわから
　なかったよ」
lines.english: “Was it? I didn't look closely enough to notice.”

lines.japanese: 「手入れしてないの？」

lines.english: The factory was a boundary between all seven of them and the outside world, holding them in a gentle embrace. Within it was an unconditional sense of safety, something irreplaceable. But the courtyard of his own home was another matter.

母国語以外の言葉ではじめて意思の疎通を果たせ

物理が示す世界のルールは想像もつきないもので

校内で学ぶ節度ある集団生活のことわりに絶対的

学んだ事柄が有機的に結合されより高次の体系的

lines.japanese: 「すいません」

lines.japanese: 「あなたの数学は……」

lines.japanese: 溜めた。

lines.japanese: 「ひぎぃぃっ！？」

lines.english: “Granted, she did make me treat her to an awful lot.”

lines.japanese: 「目の前のエサしか見えていないというか」

もう子供ではないのだから処分しろと命じられた

章二あたりが見れば価値のないガラクタのような

lines.english: “Is it the same one?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。まったく同じ」
