lines.japanese: 「……やめてよ……そういう気分じゃないの……」
lines.english: “...Stop it... I'm not in the mood...”

lines.japanese: 「む、寝不足ならもうちょっと寝てきたら？」
lines.english: “Hm. If you're short on sleep, why not go lie down a little longer?”

lines.japanese: 「寝付けないから……慣れたベッドじゃないし」
lines.english: “I can’t get to sleep… I’m not used to that bed.”

lines.japanese: 「おんなのこみたいなこと言ってる」
lines.english: “There you go sounding like a girl again.”
“...Shinobu!”

lines.japanese: 「やっと戻った」
lines.english: “There you are.”

lines.japanese: 「えぇ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「塞いでてもしょうがないじゃない。笛子がいろい
　ろ問題抱えてるのはわかるけど……今日はいい朝
　だよ。笑ってもいいかと思われます」
lines.english: “There's no point moping. I know you have all kinds of problems on your mind... but it's a beautiful morning. I submit that you are allowed to smile.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうね」
lines.english: “...You're right.”

lines.japanese: 弱々しくはあるが、口の端を吊り上げた。
lines.english: She managed a weak smile.

lines.japanese:
作り笑いであるとわかったが、それだけでずいぶ
ん落ち着くものだ。
lines.english: He knew it was forced, but even so, the smile was remarkably reassuring.

lines.japanese: 大概、心は体についてくるのだから。
lines.english: The mind followed the body more often than not.

lines.japanese: 「で、初の外泊のご感想は？」
lines.english: “So, what's your verdict on your first night away from home?”

lines.japanese:
「……のんきね……その顔見てると、なんか真面目
　に生きてるのが馬鹿馬鹿しくなってきそう……」
lines.english: “...You're so carefree... Looking at that face of yours makes me feel like an idiot for taking life seriously...”

lines.japanese: 「のんき呼ばわりはもういいよ。飽きた」
lines.english: “I've heard enough of ‘carefree.’ It's getting old.”

lines.japanese: 「だってのんきでしょ」
lines.english: “But you are.”

lines.japanese: 「にしても……もう学校には間に合わないわね」
lines.english: “Still... there's no way we'll make it to school now.”

lines.japanese: 「だね」
lines.english: “Nope.”

lines.japanese: 突如、笛子は頭をかきむしった。
lines.english: Fueko abruptly clawed at her hair.

lines.japanese:
「うー……男の子と一つ屋根の下ー！
　みんなに会わせる顔がないー！
　どうしたらいいのよー！」
lines.english: “Ugh... I spent the night under the same roof as a boy! I can never face anyone again! What am I supposed to do?!”

lines.japanese:
憤懣やるかたない笛子の様子を、忍は言葉もなく
見つめた。
lines.english: Shinobu watched Fueko fume without a word.

lines.japanese: 「……まあ顔でも洗ってスッキリしなさい」
lines.english: “...Go wash your face. It'll clear your head.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね……そうします……」
lines.english: “Yes... I think I will...”

lines.japanese: とぼとぼと裏手に向かった。
lines.english: She trudged off around the back.

lines.japanese: 「……さて、これからが大変だぞ」
lines.english: “...Now comes the hard part.”

lines.japanese: 「どうするかな……」
lines.english: “Now what...?”

lines.japanese: 「……そろそろ六限がはじまったかな？」
lines.english: “...Think sixth period's started by now?”

lines.japanese:
「完璧にサボってしまったわ……しかも半日、ぼん
　やりしてただけ……」
lines.english: “I ended up skipping the whole day... and spent half of it just sitting in a daze...”

lines.japanese: 「僕のせいだね」
lines.english: “My fault.”

lines.japanese: 「かぶられると立つ瀬がないわね」
lines.english: “If you take all the blame, what am I supposed to do with myself?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、忍のせいって言ったらそうかしら」
lines.english: “Then again, I suppose it is your fault.”

lines.japanese:
「妹まで巻き込んで……
　こんなところに連れ込んじゃって……はぁ」
lines.english: “Dragging my little sister into this, too... Bringing her to a place like this... Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「まあそれは申し訳ないかなと」
lines.english: “I suppose I do owe you an apology for that.”

lines.japanese: 「姿が見えないね？」
lines.english: “Where is she?”

lines.japanese: 「あそこ」
lines.english: “Over there.”

lines.japanese:
鉄骨の山を指さす。
　小さな影が頭を出した。
　後頭部だけしか見えない。
lines.english: She pointed at a mountain of steel beams. A small shadow rose above them. Only the back of a head was visible.

lines.japanese: 「あの鉄骨崩れないかしら？」
lines.english: “You don't think those beams will collapse?”

lines.japanese: 「前に章二が調べてた。安定してるから平気だって」
lines.english: “Shouji checked them before. He said they're stable, so it's fine.”
“Okay.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、あの子は平気でしょう。頑丈だから」
lines.english: “Well, she’ll probably be fine. She’s tough.”

lines.japanese: 「頑丈？」
lines.english: “Tough?”

lines.japanese:
「ええ。前も二階から落ちて怪我一つしなかったも
　の」
lines.english: “Yes. She fell from the second floor once without a scratch on her.”

lines.japanese: 「危ないね」
lines.english: “That's not safe.”

lines.japanese:
「落ちた、と言っても自分で平気って判断した高さ
　から飛び下りただけみたいだし」
lines.english: “Though when I say she fell, apparently she only jumped from a height she had decided was safe.”

lines.japanese: 「二階から押入の家に降りたとかじゃなくて？」
lines.english: “Not just down from the ‘second floor’ of a closet or something?”

lines.japanese:
「ベランダからね。うち、二階の一部がテラスみた
　いになってるの」
lines.english: “From the balcony. Part of our second floor is set up like a terrace.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、そこからならぶら下がるようにすれば、
　一階に下りることはそう難しくないし」
lines.english: “And from there, if you lower yourself by your arms, getting down to the first floor isn't that difficult.”
“Right...”

lines.japanese: そこで忍は追及をやめた。
lines.english: At that, Shinobu stopped asking questions.

lines.japanese: 「にしても……さすがに退屈ねぇ」
lines.english: “Still... this is getting awfully boring.”

lines.japanese: 「ゲームでもしようか」
lines.english: “Want to play a game?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、いい。忍とやってもつまらない」
lines.english: “Mm, no. Playing with you is no fun.”

lines.japanese: 気分を害した。
lines.english: That hurt his feelings.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、学校休むと、不安にならない？」
lines.english: “Say, don't you get anxious when you miss school?”

lines.japanese: 「あまり」
lines.english: “Not particularly.”

lines.japanese:
「習慣が崩れるって感じの恐怖じゃないけれど、
　どう言ったらいいのかしら」
lines.english: “It isn't exactly fear of breaking your routine... How can I put it?”

lines.japanese: 「……自分の存在価値が揺らぐような」
lines.english: “...Like your whole sense of worth starts to wobble.”

lines.japanese: 「風邪ひけないね」
lines.english: “Better not catch a cold, then.”

lines.japanese:
「病欠は仕方ないし、それはかなり強い免罪符だか
　ら、だいぶ軽減されるけど」
lines.english: “Being off sick can’t be helped, and it’s a pretty good excuse, so that makes it much easier.”

lines.japanese: 「一週間ぶりに学校に行くのが怖いのと一緒ね」
lines.english: “It's like being afraid to go back after a week away.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それは少しわかるかな」
lines.english: “Oh, I think I understand that a little.”

lines.japanese: 「それが、ズル休みだと一日で？」
lines.english: “And if you're cutting class, a single day is enough to do that?”

lines.japanese: 「レールを外れるってストレスがいるのよ」
lines.english: “It takes a lot out of you to step off the rails.”

lines.japanese: 「だけどねぇ」
lines.english: “Even so...”

lines.japanese: 「……まったく、強引なんだから」
lines.english: “...Honestly, you're so pushy.”

lines.japanese: 「んー」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「昔っからそう」
lines.english: “You always have been.”

lines.japanese: 「こっちは振り回されっぱなしです」
lines.english: “All you ever do is drag me around.”

lines.japanese:
「適度に遊ばなかったら、笛子なんて一ヶ月でオバ
　サンだね」
lines.english: “If you didn't have a little fun now and then, you'd be an old lady within a month.”

lines.japanese: 「無茶苦茶言うな」
lines.english: “Oh, give me a break.”

lines.japanese: 「……は、おなかすいた。何か作ってくれない？」
lines.english: “...Ugh, I'm hungry. Would you make me something?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、ちょっと待っててくれる」
lines.english: “Oh—actually, could you wait a second?”

lines.japanese: 「待つの？」
lines.english: “Wait?”

lines.japanese: 「……ん、来たよ」
lines.english: “...There. She's here.”

lines.japanese: 鉄扉を切り開かれ陽光が侵入してくる。
lines.english: The iron door swung open, letting sunlight spill inside.

lines.japanese: 「ご注文の品でーすー……」
lines.english: “Your order is heeere...”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「頼んでおいたの」
lines.english: “I ordered lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「ドキドキしたー」
lines.english: “That was nerve-racking!”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 質問が重なる。
lines.english: The two questions overlapped.

lines.japanese: 「学校にこんなお金持つだなんてさ」
lines.english: “Carrying this much money to school, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「取られるかと思った」
lines.english: “I thought somebody might take it from me.”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、現金だめなんだっけね」
lines.english: “...Oh, right. You're not allowed to bring cash, are you?”

lines.japanese:
確かに学校に禁じられたものを持って行く不安は
あるのかも知れない。
lines.english: Bringing something forbidden to school probably did make a person nervous.

lines.japanese: 「取られる、取られるよー」
lines.english: “They would! They'd totally take it!”

lines.japanese: 「誰によ……」
lines.english: “Who would?”

lines.japanese:
笛子は呆れ半分で呟いただけで、返答を期待した
わけでもなかったのだろうが。
lines.english: Fueko had only muttered in half-exasperated disbelief; she probably had not expected an answer.

lines.japanese:
あずさは問われ、ぴたりと凍てついた。
　すかさず忍が、
lines.english: At the question, Azusa froze solid. Shinobu immediately cut in.

lines.japanese: 「食べよう」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、えーとね、からあげ弁当あたしの。一番上が
　忍くんのね」
lines.english: “Oh, um, the fried chicken one's mine. Yours is the one on top, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
忍は袋をがさごそとあさり、四人分の弁当を取り
分けた。
lines.english: Shinobu rummaged through the bag and handed out lunches for four people.

lines.japanese: 「おつりあげる」
lines.english: “You can keep the change.”

lines.japanese: 「やった」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: 「笛子、どれ食べる？」
lines.english: “Which one do you want, Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええと……何があるの？」
lines.english: “What? Um... What are the choices?”

lines.japanese: 「からあげ以外でー、どうかー」
lines.english: “Anything but the fried chicken, please!”

lines.japanese:
「あとは、のりとフライとハンバーグ。ライスは大
　盛りふたつと普通ふたつ」
lines.english: “The others are seaweed-and-rice, fried food, and hamburger steak. Two large portions of rice and two regular.”

lines.japanese: 「忍は？」
lines.english: “What about you?”

lines.japanese: 「全部好き。特にからあげが好き」
lines.english: “I like all of them. Fried chicken especially.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃーん！」
lines.english: “Noooo!”

lines.japanese:
「……じゃあ私はのり弁もらうわね。あ、おみそ汁
　もあるんだ。あーん、ちょっとこぼれてる」
lines.english: “...Then I'll take the seaweed-and-rice one. Oh, there's miso soup too. Ah, a little spilled.”

lines.japanese:
「走ってきたから、ごめん。
　あったかい方がいいでしょ？」
lines.english: “Sorry. I ran here. It’s better while it’s hot, right?”

lines.japanese: 「あっため直そうか？」
lines.english: “Should I heat it up again?”

lines.japanese: 炊事場を指さす。
lines.english: He pointed at the kitchen area.

lines.japanese: 「いいわよ、このままで」
lines.english: “No, it's fine like this.”

lines.japanese: 「忍くん忍くん、からあげひとつちょうだいよ」
lines.english: “Shinobu, Shinobu, can I have one piece of fried chicken?”

lines.japanese: 泣きそうな顔。
lines.english: She looked ready to cry.

lines.japanese: 「冗談だって。からあげあずさが食べていいよ」
lines.english: “I'm kidding. You can have the fried chicken, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「うあ、かどわかされた……」
lines.english: “Waaah, you lured me in...”

lines.japanese: 「だまされた」
lines.english: “You got tricked.”

lines.japanese: 「だまだま」
lines.english: “Trick-tricked.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese:
三人は火の投じられない缶を習慣的に囲み、食事
をはじめた。
lines.english: By force of habit, the three gathered around the unlit drum and began their meal.

lines.japanese:
寒くも暑くもない駘蕩とした空気の中、机がある
わけでもない遅めの昼食は、互いの会話一つない。
lines.english: In the mild, languid air, the three ate their late lunch without a table or a word between them.

lines.japanese:
忍に関して言えば食事中は無心に過ぎて、いくぶん
知能が低下していることは否めない有様だが、
lines.english: Shinobu, for his part, went so blank over a meal that one could hardly deny his intelligence dropped a few points. But—

lines.japanese:
今日に限ってはあずさも笛子も黙々と滋養の摂取に
専念していた。
lines.english: today, for once, Azusa and Fueko also devoted themselves in silence to the intake of nourishment.

lines.japanese:
一番早くに食べ終えた忍は、食後の飲み物を作る
べく炊事スペースに向かう。
lines.english: Shinobu finished first and headed for the kitchen area to make something to drink after the meal.

lines.japanese:
飲み物を持って戻る頃には、二人とも一息ついて
いた。
lines.english: By the time he returned with the drinks, both girls were relaxing.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ忍、お弁当のお金は？」
lines.english: “Shinobu, what about the money for lunch?”

lines.japanese: 「今日はいいや。無理言って休んでもらったんだし」
lines.english: “It's on me today. I'm the one who talked you into taking the day off.”

lines.japanese: 「……ん、じゃあごちそうさまです」
lines.english: “...Mm. Then thanks for lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「いつもごちそうさまです」
lines.english: “Thanks, as always.”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「ところでね」
lines.english: “By the way...”

lines.japanese: 「うん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと散歩しない？」
lines.english: “Want to take a walk?”

lines.japanese: いろいろなことを考える。
lines.english: He weighed a number of things.

lines.japanese: 「いいよ」
lines.english: “Sure.”

lines.japanese: 「あたしも」
lines.english: “Me too.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ三人で行こうか」
lines.english: “Then let's go, all three of us.”

lines.japanese: 「そうしよう」
lines.english: “Let's.”

lines.japanese:
「さっきから気になってたんだけど、人の
　気配ない？」
lines.english: “I've been wondering for a while—doesn't it feel like someone's around?”

lines.japanese: 「うちの子です」
lines.english: “That's my sister.”

lines.japanese: 「あー」
lines.english: “Ohhh.”

lines.japanese: 納得。
lines.english: That explained it.

lines.japanese: 「置いておいていいの？」
lines.english: “Is it okay to leave her behind?”

lines.japanese:
「一番暴れてる人なんだから、今さら散歩なんてし
　なくても平気」
lines.english: “She's the most hyper person here. She'll be fine without yet another walk.”

lines.japanese:
「……今日は私、なんとなく息詰まっちゃった
　から……」
lines.english: “...I've just felt a little cooped up today, so...”

lines.japanese: 「森林浴でもしますか」
lines.english: “How about a little forest bathing?”

lines.japanese: 「虫、いるかしら？」
lines.english: “Do you think there'll be bugs?”

lines.japanese: 「この時期だと、虫いるかなー」
lines.english: “Think there'll be any bugs this time of year?”

lines.japanese:
言葉の意味は同じでも、内に込められた両者の真
意にはずいぶんと隔たりがある。
lines.english: Their words meant the same thing, but the intentions behind them were very different.

lines.japanese: 忍は笑った。
lines.english: Shinobu laughed.

lines.japanese: しばらく工場回りを歩いていると、日が暮れ始めた。
lines.english: After they had walked around the factory for a while, the sun began to set.

lines.japanese: 「もう夕方か……」
lines.english: “It's evening already...”

lines.japanese: 「早いような、長かったような」
lines.english: “It feels like it went by quickly, and like it lasted a long time.”

lines.japanese: 「一旦工場に戻ろうか」
lines.english: “Let's head back to the factory for now.”

lines.japanese: 「忍くん、今夜も泊まるの？」
lines.english: “Are you sleeping here again tonight, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね……」
lines.english: “I guess so...”

lines.japanese: 「笛子ちゃんも？」
lines.english: “Fueko, are you staying too?”

lines.japanese: 「え、わ、私は……その……」
lines.english: “I—I... well...”

lines.japanese: 「どうなの、かしら？」
lines.english: “Am I staying?”

lines.japanese: 忍に振った。
lines.english: She passed the question to Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「……どうなんだろうね」
lines.english: “...I wonder.”

lines.japanese: 「ねぇ？」
lines.english: “Well?”

lines.japanese: 二人は笑うしかなかった。
lines.english: The two of them could only laugh.

lines.japanese: 「いいね、合宿」
lines.english: “A sleepover? Nice.”

lines.japanese: 特に気分を害した様子もなく、あずさは息を吐いた。
lines.english: Azusa let out a breath, apparently not put off in the least.

lines.japanese:
異性同士の距離感に、まだ疎いのだ。
　その間に流れる空気さえ、読み取れていない。
lines.english: She still knew little about how boys and girls related to one another. She could not even read the atmosphere between them.

lines.japanese: 「お母さんが家をあける時にでも―――」
lines.english: “Maybe the next time your mother is away—”

lines.japanese:
忍は立ち止まらなかった。
　周囲を見渡しもしなかった。
lines.english: Shinobu did not stop walking. Nor did he look around.

lines.japanese:
変わらぬペースで歩き続け、左右にいる少女たち
に小声で囁く。
lines.english: He continued at the same pace, whispering to the girls on either side of him.

lines.japanese: 「工場には戻らない」
lines.english: “We're not going back to the factory.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「チョッキ？」
lines.english: “A vest?”

lines.japanese: 「驚かないでくれる？」
lines.english: “Can you keep from reacting?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese:
「……わかりやすく、
　いろいろはぶいて説明するけど」
lines.english: “...I'm going to explain this simply, and leave out a lot.”

lines.japanese: 「僕らは、複数の悪意ある人間に見られてる」
lines.english: “We're being watched by several people who mean us harm.”

lines.japanese: きょとんとした。
lines.english: She stared blankly.

lines.japanese:
それ以上のいかなる反応も、若い少女の心には用
意されていないのだ。
lines.english: Her young mind had no other response ready for news like that.

lines.japanese: 言葉のみでは。
lines.english: Not from words alone.

lines.japanese:
一方、笛子は表情を張りつめさせた。
　状況の悪さは一目瞭然と言えた。
lines.english: Fueko's face, by contrast, went taut. The danger of their situation was obvious.

lines.japanese:
彼らが工場を秘密基地にしたのは、人目につかな
いからだ。
lines.english: They had made the factory their secret base because it was hidden from prying eyes.

lines.japanese:
イコールそれは、人の助けを期待できないという
ことでもある。
lines.english: Which also meant they could not count on anyone coming to help.

lines.japanese:
「……工場の場所を知られたくないし、笛子の妹も
　いる」
lines.english: “...I don't want them finding out where the factory is, and Fueko's sister is still there.”

lines.japanese: 「だからこのまま逃げる」
lines.english: “So we keep moving and get away.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、どういうこと？　誰が？」
lines.english: “Wait, what are you talking about? Who's watching us?”

lines.japanese: 「立ち止まるな」
lines.english: “Don't stop walking.”

lines.japanese:
「急ぎ足にもなるな。難しいだろうけど、そのまま
　歩いてくれ。遠くから見ると、ちょっとの動揺も
　すぐにわかる」
lines.english: “Don't speed up, either. I know it's hard, but keep walking exactly as you were. From a distance, the slightest sign of panic is easy to spot.”

lines.japanese: 「……慣れた追跡者なら」
lines.english: “...At least to an experienced pursuer.”
“...Experienced...”

lines.japanese: 「だって、あたしたち何もしてないよ？」
lines.english: “But we haven't done anything!”

lines.japanese: 「理由は今は考えなくてもいいよ」
lines.english: “You don't need to think about why right now.”

lines.japanese: 笛子を横目で見る。
lines.english: He glanced sideways at Fueko.

lines.japanese: 「とにかく逃げよう。まずは」
lines.english: “First things first, let's get away.”

lines.japanese:
冷静な思考を働かせながら、安息の地での日々が
もっとも陰湿な形で幕を閉じたのだと悟った。
lines.english: Even as he thought calmly, he realized that their days in this refuge had ended in the most insidious way possible.

lines.japanese:
舌打ちしたくなる。
　いや、そのようなアクセントのみで済ませられる
ことではない。
lines.english: He wanted to click his tongue. No—this was too grave for so small a gesture.

lines.japanese: 静かな少年の表情に、冷たい憤激の色が漲っている。
lines.english: Cold fury suffused the quiet boy's face.

lines.japanese: （だけど今は……二人がいる）
lines.english: (But right now... I have the two of them with me.)

lines.japanese:
懸念はしていた。
　回避すべく行動には注意していた。
　工場にいる時に狙われた。
lines.english: He had anticipated the possibility. He had been careful in his actions to avoid it. They had targeted him while he was at the factory.

lines.japanese: これが何を意味しているのかは明らかだ。
lines.english: What that meant was obvious.

lines.japanese: 調べられている―――
lines.english: He was being investigated—

lines.japanese:
そして一人や二人ではない人間を駆り出して、こ
こに置いた。
lines.english: And they had mobilized more than one or two people and planted them here.

lines.japanese:
夕刻から夜になろうとしている今だ。
　相手の本気が仄見えて、忍は歯を切す。
lines.english: It was dusk, with night closing in. That glimpse of his opponents' resolve made Shinobu grind his teeth.
“............What do we do?”

lines.japanese:
状況を把握している笛子の声は、ことさらに重い。
　三人とも表情が強ばっている。
lines.english: Fueko understood the situation, which made her voice graver still. All three faces had gone rigid.

lines.japanese:
こちらが気付いていることに、向こうは気付いて
いるかも知れない。
lines.english: Their watchers might already know they had been made.

lines.japanese:
だとしても、訓練も受けていないあずさと笛子に、
熟達した行動を求められるわけがないのだ。
lines.english: Even so, he could hardly expect untrained Azusa and Fueko to move like experts.

lines.japanese:
携帯を取り出す。
　樋口章二にかける。
　電波状況が悪く、繋がらない。
lines.english: He pulled out his phone. Called Shouji Higuchi. The signal was poor. The call wouldn't go through.

lines.japanese:
メールだけ飛ばしておく。
　念のため、その他全員にも。
lines.english: He sent a message instead. And, to be safe, sent one to everyone else.

lines.japanese: （……伊勢崎、宗多……あいつの仕業……なのか？）
lines.english: (...Souta Isezaki... Is this... his doing?)

lines.japanese:
確かに本気でつけ狙うなら、忍たちの集まる工場
こそ襲撃するには適している。
lines.english: If someone really was hunting them, the factory where Shinobu and the others gathered would certainly be the ideal place to attack.

lines.japanese:
人里離れた工業地域。
　もし彼らが忍たちを害しても、処理する手段が無
数にある。
lines.english: An industrial district, far from anywhere people lived. They could hurt Shinobu and the others here, then cover it up in any number of ways.

lines.japanese:
（なんとか逃げないと……
　でもあずさと笛子がいる。どうする？）
lines.english: (We have to get away somehow... But Azusa and Fueko are with me. What do I do?)

lines.japanese:
考える。
　このまま前方に歩きたくはない。
　視線は後方に感じるが……。
lines.english: Think. He didn't want to keep walking straight ahead. He could feel eyes on him from behind, but...

lines.japanese:
計算された行動であるなら、すでに待ち伏せされ
ているだろう。
lines.english: If their pursuers had planned this out, there would already be an ambush waiting for them.

lines.japanese:
そういうことのできる箇所がいくらでもある。
　工場と街を繋ぐ道は一本のみ。
　しかも両脇には建物が並び、容易に接近を許す。
lines.english: There were any number of places to set one. Only one road connected the factory to town. Buildings lined both sides, making it easy to approach them.

lines.japanese:
この道は、キルゾーンだ。
　歩んではならない。
　右左折し草原を進むのも危険だ。
lines.english: This road was a kill zone. They must not follow it. But turning off across the fields to either side was dangerous too.

lines.japanese:
建物で視界がほとんど確保できない。
　扇状に包囲されていたら、どのみちアウトだ。
lines.english: The buildings left them with almost no field of view. If their pursuers had fanned out around them, they were finished either way.

lines.japanese: なら、こちらから仕掛けたら？
lines.english: What if he struck first?

lines.japanese:
相手の位置に目星をつける。
　こちらから襲って、無力化。突破する。
lines.english: Work out where they were. Attack first. Incapacitate them. Break through.

lines.japanese:
そう、それが一番確実な方法だろう。
　別に銃器を持っているわけじゃない。
lines.english: Yes. That was probably the surest method. It was not as though they had firearms.

lines.japanese: だが―――
lines.english: But—

lines.japanese: 「……駄目だ」

実質、それを忍一人で実行することになる。
　相手がひとりならともかく……だ。
lines.english: In practice, Shinobu would have to do it alone. If there were only one of them, that would be one thing...

lines.japanese:
黙り込んでいたらしい。
　ふたりの目が不安に揺れて、溢れそう。
lines.english: He must have gone quiet. Anxiety trembled in both girls' eyes, threatening to spill over.

lines.japanese: 「……大丈夫」
lines.english: “...It's all right.”

lines.japanese: 言えることはそれだけだ。
lines.english: That was all he could say.

lines.japanese: 「絶対に大丈夫」
lines.english: “It’ll definitely be all right.”

lines.japanese:
保証のない言葉ではあるが、実現しなくてはなら
ない。
lines.english: The words carried no guarantee, but he had to make them come true.

lines.japanese:
もし相手が悪意をもって襲いかかってきた場合、
少女二人には自分よりもつらい仕打ちが加えられる
可能性もあるのだ。
lines.english: If their pursuers meant them harm, the two girls might be subjected to something worse than anything they would do to him.

lines.japanese: （…………あるいは）
（…………もしかすると）
