lines.japanese: 「こわいよ……黙らないで……」
lines.english: “I'm scared... Don't go quiet...”

lines.japanese: 「ん……ごめんごめん」
lines.english: “Mm... Sorry, sorry.”

lines.japanese:
笑おう。忍は思った。
　まず、笑おう。
lines.english: Smile, he told himself. First, smile.

lines.japanese:
相手が自分を観察しているなら、勘違いをしてく
れるかも知れない。
lines.english: If they were watching him, perhaps they would misread the situation.

lines.japanese:
油断してくれるかも知れない。
　小さな努力ではあるが。
lines.english: Maybe they would let their guard down. It wasn't much, but still.

lines.japanese:
小数点以下を積み重ねて、１にできるかも知れな
いのだから。
lines.english: If he piled up enough fractions, they might add up to one in the end.

lines.japanese: 「……今ね、逃げる方法を考えていたんだ」
lines.english: “...I was thinking of a way for us to get away.”

lines.japanese: 「……何か、あるの？」
lines.english: “...Do you have one?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね」
lines.english: “I think so.”

lines.japanese: 目を閉じる。
lines.english: He closed his eyes.

lines.japanese:
いくつかの方針を選び、わずかな希望的観測を破
棄し、最後に自身の覚悟を決めた。
lines.english: He settled on several courses of action, discarded a little wishful thinking, and finally steeled himself.

lines.japanese: 「……相手は複数いると思う」
lines.english: “...I think there's more than one of them.”

lines.japanese:
ほとんど円にまで開かれた、あずさの瞳に語りか
ける。
lines.english: Azusa's eyes were almost perfectly round as he spoke to her.

lines.japanese:
恐慌状態一歩手前の兆候だ。
　肩に手を置く。
lines.english: She was one step from panic. He put a hand on her shoulder.

lines.japanese:
「たぶん、変質者か不良か……どちらにしても集団
　だね」
lines.english: “Probably perverts or delinquents... Either way, there are several of them.”

lines.japanese: 「……そんな」

「きっとたまたま僕らを見つけて、目をつけたんだ
　と思う。後ろから何人か来ている感じがする」
lines.english: “They probably happened to spot us and decided we'd make good targets. It feels like several of them are coming up behind us.”

lines.japanese: 「後ろから……」
lines.english: “Behind us...”

lines.japanese: 「振り返らないでいいよ。気付いたことがばれる」
lines.english: “Don't look back. They'll know we've noticed.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese:
噛み砕いたつもりだが、理解しているようには見
えない。
lines.english: He thought he had put it simply, but she did not seem to understand.

lines.japanese:
あずさの小さな心は、もういっぱいに恐怖だけを
詰め込んで膨張しているのだ。
lines.english: Azusa's little heart was already stretched to bursting, packed with nothing but fear.

lines.japanese:
「それで、どうするの？　あの、さっきの携帯って
　……助けを求めたの？」
lines.english: “Then what do we do? When you used your phone just now... did you call for help?”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、だから時間を稼いだら助かる」
lines.english: “...Yes. So if we buy enough time, help will come.”

lines.japanese: 無論、嘘だった。
lines.english: Of course, it was a lie.

lines.japanese: 「いい、あずさ、笛子。僕の考えをよく聞いて」
lines.english: “Listen, Azusa, Fueko. Pay close attention to my plan.”

lines.japanese:
「この道を真っ直ぐ行っても、すぐ追いつかれるだ
　けだと思う。もしかすると、今も先回りされてい
　るかも知れない」
lines.english: “If we keep going straight down this road, I think they’ll catch us in no time. They might even be waiting ahead of us already.”

lines.japanese:
推測できる状況から最悪を除外し、楽観的な意見
を口にした。
lines.english: He left the worst possibilities unspoken and gave them an optimistic assessment.

lines.japanese: ふたりには、自力で走ってもらわねばならない。
lines.english: The two girls would have to run on their own two feet.

lines.japanese:
人間は緊急時にそうそう動けるものではない。
　覚悟のできていない一般人は、いざという時に足
がすくんでしまう可能性がある。
lines.english: People didn't simply spring into action in an emergency. Someone unprepared for danger might find their legs refusing to move when the moment came.

lines.japanese: 「だからね、森に入る」
lines.english: “So we're going into the woods.”
“...The woods?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そう」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「あそこなら僕は詳しい」
lines.english: “I know the woods well.”

lines.japanese:
「どこに抜けているかもよく知ってる。坂があって、
　少し厳しいコースになるけど……オリエンテーショ
　ンとでも思ってつきあって欲しい」
lines.english: “I know where you can come out on the other side, too. There's a slope, and it'll be a little rough... but just pretend it's orienteering and bear with me.”

lines.japanese:
「あずさ、学校でオリエンテーションはやった
　よね？」
lines.english: “Azusa, you've done orienteering at school, right?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、やった……やったよ」
lines.english: “Yes. I did... I did.”

lines.japanese: 「それをやればいいんだ。冷静にね」
lines.english: “That's all we're doing. Just stay calm.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、どうやって森に入るの？」
lines.english: “How are we going to get into the woods?”

lines.japanese: 「森に入るまで走るしかない」
lines.english: “We'll have to make a run for the woods.”

lines.japanese: 「もう少し進んだところから、左側の草原に入るよ」
lines.english: “A little farther on, we'll turn into the field on the left.”

lines.japanese: 「どこ？　どこ？」
lines.english: “Where? Where?”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ、キョロキョロしないの」
lines.english: “Azusa, don't look around.”
“Oh... r-right...”

lines.japanese: 「指さすことはできないから、ちゃんと聞いてね」
lines.english: “I can't point, so listen carefully.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……はい」
lines.english: “Okay... Yes.”

lines.japanese:
「１００メートルちょっと手前くらいのところにあ
　る、右手の木わかるかな」
lines.english: “Can you see the tree on the right, a little less than a hundred meters ahead?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、わかる」
lines.english: “Yes, I see it.”

lines.japanese:
「あの真横から、鉄条の下をくぐって草原に出るよ
　左側ね。木は目印だけど右側。その反対の左側に
　行く。いい？」
lines.english: “Beside it, we'll duck under the wire and enter the field on the left. The tree is our marker, but it's on the right. We go left, the opposite direction. Got it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、左ね」
lines.english: “Yes. Left.”

lines.japanese:
「そしたらダッシュだ。
　あずさと笛子が前。僕が後ろ」
lines.english: “Then we run for it. You and Fueko in front. I'll bring up the rear.”

lines.japanese:
「ずっと前に章二たちと一緒にクワ取りに行ったで
　しょ？　わかる？」
lines.english: “Remember when we went stag-beetle hunting with Shouji and the others a long time ago? Do you know where I mean?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、わかる。おぼえてる」
lines.english: “Yes, I know. I remember.”

lines.japanese: 「そこから入る」
lines.english: “That's where we go in.”

lines.japanese: 「……わかった」
lines.english: “...All right.”

lines.japanese: 「けっこう、あるよね……距離」
lines.english: “It's pretty far... isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「僕が足止めだけはするから」
lines.english: “I'll hold them off, at least.”

lines.japanese: 「駄目よっ」
lines.english: “No!”
“...Fueko. Keep your voice down.”

lines.japanese:
口を押さえる。
　しかし実のところ、忍はもう不審な挙動を隠す気
はなかった。
lines.english: She covered her mouth. In truth, though, Shinobu had already stopped trying to conceal what he was doing.

lines.japanese:
背中にねっとりとまとわる視線の質が、嘲りを帯
びていたからだ。
lines.english: The stares clinging damply to his back had taken on a mocking edge.

lines.japanese:
馬鹿にされている。
　彼らは狩りを楽しむつもりなのだと、知れた。
　つまり、たかが知れた。
lines.english: They were looking down on him. They meant to enjoy the hunt. He could tell. Which told him how little they amounted to.

lines.japanese:
もっともこちらは油断などしない。
　我が身一つでも、多対一で油断など入る余地もない。
lines.english: He, of course, would not let down his guard. One man against many left no room for carelessness.

lines.japanese: 向こうにはあるようだが。
lines.english: They, on the other hand, seemed to have plenty to spare.
(...Fools—)

lines.japanese: 忍の顔をのぞきこんで、笛子は息を呑む。
lines.english: Fueko peered into Shinobu's face and caught her breath.

lines.japanese: 「……どうかした？」
lines.english: “...Something wrong?”

lines.japanese: 笛子はそこに、いつもの忍の顔を見た。
lines.english: There, Fueko saw Shinobu's usual face.

lines.japanese: 「ううん、別に……」
lines.english: “No, nothing...”

lines.japanese: 「でも足止めって……一人で……」
lines.english: “But holding them back... alone...”

lines.japanese:
「なんとかなるよ。
　こういう時の対処は、章二に教わってるし」
lines.english: “I'll manage somehow. Shouji taught me what to do in situations like this.”

lines.japanese: 「強くないと、いけなかったんだ」
lines.english: “I had to be strong.”

lines.japanese: 「つよく？」
lines.english: “Strong?”

lines.japanese:
「君たちくらいは守れないといけなかった。
　そのかわりに他の何かを犠牲にするとしても」
lines.english: “I had to be able to protect you, at least. Even if it meant sacrificing something else.”

lines.japanese:
「なんとかなる。そう思ってきた。
　たった６人守ればいいんだって」
lines.english: “I thought I could manage somehow. That I only had to protect six people.”

lines.japanese:
そしてどうしてこんな思い上がりをしていたんだ
ろうと、今は思う。
lines.english: Now he wondered how he had ever been so arrogant as to believe that.

lines.japanese: 全能感が人を弱くする。愚かにする。
lines.english: A sense of omnipotence weakened people. Made fools of them.

lines.japanese:
「そういう油断が、こんな状況を作ったのかも知れ
　ない。僕はいつでも備えてなければいけなかった
　のかも」
lines.english: “Maybe that's the complacency that got us into this situation. Maybe I should have been prepared at all times.”

lines.japanese: ふたりを交互に見て、
lines.english: He looked from one girl to the other.

lines.japanese: 「みんなのことは、守るよ」
lines.english: “I'll protect everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「……七人でしょ？」
lines.english: “...Seven people, right?”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「守るのは、７人。忍くんを入れて」
lines.english: “Seven. You have to protect seven people, including yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうか、そうだね」
lines.english: “...I see. Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「にー」
lines.english: “Eee.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。いい笑顔だあずさクン」
lines.english: “Yes. That's a good smile, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとだけ、恐くなくなってきた」
lines.english: “I'm a little less scared now.”

lines.japanese: 「そのくらいでいいんだ、こういう状況では」
lines.english: “That's enough in a situation like this.”

lines.japanese: 「……そろそろだね。笛子もいいね？」
lines.english: “...It's almost time. Fueko, are you ready?”

lines.japanese: 目線だけで目標地点を見て、笛子の声が硬くなる。
lines.english: Fueko glanced toward their destination without turning her head. Her voice tightened.

lines.japanese:
「森を目指して走ってね。で、入ったあとは……森
　の広場まで行って。僕のことは振り返らずに行く
　ように」
lines.english: “Run for the woods. Once you're inside... make for the clearing. Keep going. Don't turn around to check on me.”

lines.japanese: 「……忍くんは平気？」
lines.english: “...Will you be okay, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese:
「なんとかする。
　別に直接殴り合うわけじゃないから」
lines.english: “I'll manage. It's not as though I'm going to trade punches with them.”

lines.japanese: 「で、状況見て合流が無理そうなら、一人で逃げる」
lines.english: “And if it looks like I can't meet back up with you, I'll get away on my own.”

lines.japanese:
「だから笛子、あの場所で５分待って僕が行かなかっ
　たら、そのまま森の奥に行けば処理場みたいな場所
　に出るんで、そこからは何とかうまく街に行って」
lines.english: “So, Fueko, wait there for five minutes. If I don’t come, keep going deeper into the woods. You’ll come out at what looks like a treatment plant; from there, find your way back to town somehow.”

lines.japanese: 「……わかった」
lines.english: “...All right.”

lines.japanese: 「で、章二に連絡ね」
lines.english: “Then contact Shouji.”

lines.japanese: 「……しゃくだなぁ」
lines.english: “...That's so annoying.”

lines.japanese: 「はは」
lines.english: “Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: ぽん、と頭を撫でる。
lines.english: He patted her on the head.

lines.japanese: 「さ、行こう。衣服ひっかけないようにくぐって」
lines.english: “All right, let's go. Duck under without snagging your clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいの？」
lines.english: “I-is it okay?”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、行って」
lines.english: “Yes. Go.”

lines.japanese:
ふたりは鉄条の下をくぐり、向こう側に出た。
　忍も続く。
lines.english: The two girls ducked beneath the wire and emerged on the other side. Shinobu followed.

lines.japanese: 「走ろう」
lines.english: “Let's run.”

lines.japanese: そして、走り出す。
lines.english: They broke into a run.

lines.japanese:
背後の気配が、泡を食って一斉に飛び出してくる
のが感じられた。
lines.english: He felt the people behind them scramble into motion all at once.

lines.japanese:
５０メートルほど先からも、何人かが。
　それだけを確認して、忍はふたりのあとに続いた。
lines.english: Several more emerged about fifty meters ahead. Once he had confirmed that much, Shinobu followed the girls.

lines.japanese:
絶望的な状況にあってなお、忍は凄絶な笑みを浮
かべた。
lines.english: Even in this desperate situation, Shinobu wore a savage smile.

lines.japanese: 先に笛子が見たのと同様の。
lines.english: The same smile Fueko had seen earlier.

lines.japanese:
駆ける。
　あずさのペースに合わさるため、そう性急な足取
りではない。
lines.english: They ran. They kept their pace moderate to match Azusa’s.

lines.japanese: 小走りといった感じで、あずさが突出しすぎれば、
lines.english: It was more of a jog, and whenever Azusa pulled too far ahead—

lines.japanese:
「もう少しゆっくり。
　朝のペースより少し早いくらい」
lines.english: “A little slower. Just a little faster than your morning pace.”

lines.japanese: 返事はないが、速度は落ちた。
lines.english: She gave no answer, but slowed down.

lines.japanese:
肩越しに背後をうかがうと、８名。
　こちらは無茶なペースだ。全力疾走に近い。
lines.english: He glanced over his shoulder. Eight people. They were coming at a reckless pace, almost a dead sprint.

lines.japanese:
そのためせっかくの集団なのに、三つほどのグル
ープにわかれてしまっている。
lines.english: At that pace, what should have been one group had split into roughly three clusters.

lines.japanese: 距離は４、５０メートルほどだろうか。
lines.english: The distance was perhaps forty or fifty meters.

lines.japanese:
追撃側はかなりの無茶をしなければ、縮められる
距離ではない。
lines.english: The pursuers would have to push themselves dangerously hard to close that distance.

lines.japanese:
とはいえ先に疲弊するのはこちら側だろう。
　その前に森に入ってしまう必要がある。
lines.english: Even so, Shinobu's group would probably tire first. They had to reach the woods before that happened.

lines.japanese: （……といっても……どうするか）
lines.english: (...But even then... what do I do?)

lines.japanese:
いかに各個に分裂したとはいえ、忍には棒きれの
一本もない。
lines.english: Split up though they were, Shinobu did not have so much as a stick to use as a weapon.

lines.japanese:
（８対１じゃ無理だな……こっちから仕掛けるなら、
　１人ずつでないと……）
lines.english: (Eight against one is impossible... If I make the first move, it has to be one at a time...)

lines.japanese: （１人ずつに分断するには……ここじゃ無理だ）
lines.english: (If I'm going to separate them and take them one at a time... I can't do it here.)

lines.japanese:
そこで忍は、唯一効果的にできること……自分を
囮として２人を逃がすことを選ぶ。
lines.english: So Shinobu chose the one useful thing he could still do... use himself as bait and let the two girls escape.

lines.japanese:
速度を落とし、追手との距離を縮める。
　彼らに自らを意識させた上で、少しずつコースを
ずらしていく。
lines.english: He slowed down, letting the pursuers close the distance. Once he had drawn their attention to himself, he gradually veered off course.

lines.japanese:
向かう先は同じ森だ。
　ただし、入る箇所が違う。
lines.english: He was still heading for the same woods. He would simply enter somewhere else.

lines.japanese: （よし）
lines.english: (Good.)

lines.japanese:
統制を失っているのか、８人の敵意が忍にロック
された。
lines.english: Perhaps they had lost all discipline. The hostility of all eight locked onto Shinobu.

lines.japanese: （……これで全部なのか？）
lines.english: (...Is this all of them?)

lines.japanese: 伊勢崎宗多の姿がない。
lines.english: Souta Isezaki was nowhere in sight.

lines.japanese:
もしこの連中が宗多絡みの人間なら、本人はどこ
で何をしているのか？
lines.english: If these people were connected to Souta, where was Souta himself, and what was he doing?

lines.japanese:
嫌な予感に駆られ、視界を広く取る。
　すると―――いた。
lines.english: A bad premonition made Shinobu widen his search. And then—there he was.

lines.japanese:
２人の部下を従える小柄で敏捷な影は、その歩き
の癖から伊勢崎宗多と判断できた。
lines.english: The small, agile figure with two men in tow had a distinctive gait. It was Souta Isezaki.

lines.japanese:
ずいぶんと見当違いの方角から向かう先に、黒々
と繁る森が断崖の如くそびえている。
lines.english: They were approaching from far off to one side, heading toward the woods, which rose black before them like a sheer cliff.
(I see—)

lines.japanese:
側面から先回りを計るつもりなのだ。
　なにしろ本人が出てきているくらいだ。
　少年を行動に駆り立てたものは昔年の憎悪だろう。
lines.english: They meant to circle around and cut them off from the side. Souta himself had come out, after all. It must have been an old hatred that drove the boy to act.

lines.japanese:
彼は忍たちが街外れの工場を根城にしていること
を知った。
lines.english: He had learned that Shinobu's group used a factory on the edge of town as their base.

lines.japanese:
メンツに少女が多く、総勢で１０名に満たないこ
とを知った。
lines.english: He had learned that the group was mostly girls, and that there were fewer than ten of them altogether.

lines.japanese:
手下もいる。
　恨みも消えていない。
lines.english: He had followers. And his grudge had not faded.

lines.japanese: 言ったとおりのことを実行するに、何の理由もない。
lines.english: There was nothing stopping him from doing exactly what he'd said he would.

lines.japanese:
忍は宗多にとって路傍の石ではない。
　向かう先に転がる目障りな……排除の対象。
lines.english: To Souta, Shinobu was no mere stone by the roadside. He was an eyesore lying directly in his path... something to be removed.

lines.japanese:
（全部で１１名……
　いや、伊勢崎宗多と１０名と見るべきか）
lines.english: (Eleven altogether... No. I should think of it as Souta Isezaki and ten others.)

lines.japanese:
恐らく、この１１名の中で一番腕っ節が強いのは
宗多だろう。
lines.english: Souta was probably the strongest fighter among those eleven.

lines.japanese:
いかにも荒っぽそうな面々から発せられる敵意は、
いかにも粗暴なものだ。
lines.english: The hostility radiating from that rough-looking crew was every bit as brutish as they looked.

lines.japanese:
しかしそれだけに、強い者には敏感であるはずだ
った。
lines.english: But that also meant they should be keenly sensitive to who was strong.

lines.japanese: （逃げ延びることを考えた方がいいな）
lines.english: (I should focus on surviving this.)

lines.japanese:
しかし隙があれば潰していく。
　そう。
　思い出す。
lines.english: But if an opening presented itself, he would take them out. Yes. He remembered.

lines.japanese:
忍はひとりだった。
　ひとりからはじめた。
lines.english: Shinobu had been alone. He had started alone.

lines.japanese:
他の多くがそうであるように、ひとりのまま生ま
れてきた。
lines.english: Like so many others, he had come into the world alone.

lines.japanese:
冷たい場所で育ち、親のぬくもりを知らない。
　自己を意識したのは幾つだったろうか。
lines.english: He had grown up in a cold place, knowing nothing of a parent's warmth. How old had he been when he first became aware of himself?

lines.japanese:
“自己”の発達がひどく遅かったことは、後にな
って知った。
lines.english: Only later did he learn how terribly late his sense of “self” had developed.

lines.japanese:
仕方ないのだった。
　人格が軽んじられたのは、それが必要とされなか
ったからだ。
lines.english: There had been no helping it. His personhood had counted for little because no one had needed him to have one.

lines.japanese:
問題にならないよう、最低限の倫理さえ複写すれ
ば良かったのだ。
lines.english: All they had needed to do was copy the bare minimum of ethics into him—just enough to keep him from causing problems.

lines.japanese:
それが施設というものだ。
　後に千鳥に引き取られ、ともに暮らすようになっ
たが、変わりはなかった。
lines.english: That was how institutions worked. Chidori took him in later, and they began living together, but nothing changed.

lines.japanese:
むしろ姉と名の付くものとの間に横たわる冷たい
関係が、ことさらに忍を薄情にした。
lines.english: If anything, the cold relationship between him and the thing called a sister made Shinobu more unfeeling still.

lines.japanese:
自己改革を迫られた。
　そうしなければ、他者との間にまともな交友関係
も結べないと理解したからだ。
lines.english: He had no choice but to remake himself. He understood that otherwise he could never form anything resembling a real friendship with another person.

lines.japanese:
友達とは？
　人間性とは？
lines.english: What was a friend? What made someone human?

lines.japanese:
どうすれば、触れる喜びを解することができるの
か？
lines.english: How could he learn to understand the joy of touching another person?

lines.japanese: 「……ふざけるな……」
lines.english: “...Don't fuck with me...”

lines.japanese: 走りながら呟く声に、冷然とした怒気が込められる。
lines.english: The words he muttered as he ran carried a cold, level fury.

lines.japanese:
今の忍は、多少なりとも情を知る者だ。
　自分でもそう感じている。
lines.english: Now, at least, Shinobu knew something of affection. He could feel that much for himself.

lines.japanese:
喜怒哀楽が肌のものとして得られることは、かつ
てなかった祝福だ。
lines.english: To feel joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure in his own skin was a blessing he had never known before.

lines.japanese: 自力で、手にした。
lines.english: He had gained it through his own efforts.

lines.japanese:
自ら行動し、疎まれながらかき集めた。
　好きになろうと決めて集めた。
lines.english: He had taken action himself and gathered them together, even as they shunned him. He had decided he would grow to like them, and gathered them together.

lines.japanese: 自力で、好いた。
lines.english: He had come to like them through his own efforts.

lines.japanese:
他の誰にも渡す気はない。
　一部だからだ。
lines.english: He had no intention of surrendering them to anyone else. They were a part of him.

lines.japanese:
たとえ暴力という手段に、端緒を求めることにな
ったとしても。
lines.english: Even if violence had to be where it began.

lines.japanese:
交友の黎明。
　忍は暴力を振るった。
　無差別な行使ではない。
lines.english: At the dawn of friendship, Shinobu had used violence. Not indiscriminately.

lines.japanese:
樋口章二と塚本斎。
　３人で危害を加えようとする人間に、恐怖を与え
てきた。
lines.english: Shouji Higuchi and Itsuki Tsukamoto. The three of them had struck fear into anyone who meant to harm them.

lines.japanese:
もとより忍は、伊勢崎宗多のいじめのターゲット
になっていた。
lines.english: Shinobu had originally been a target of Souta Isezaki's bullying.

lines.japanese:
自分だけなら気にする必要もないが、仲間に及ぶ
なら話は別だ。
lines.english: If he alone was the target, there was no need to care. But if his friends were threatened, that was another matter.

lines.japanese:
忍は宗多を殺さず、壊した。
　そのため少年はいなくなったが、取り巻きはその
後も、指揮官を失った兵隊のように悪意に駆られた。
lines.english: Shinobu had broken Souta without killing him. The boy disappeared as a result, but his followers remained driven by malice afterward, like soldiers who had lost their commander.

lines.japanese:
ありとあらゆる手段を使って、駆逐することにな
った。
lines.english: He had driven them out by every means at his disposal.

lines.japanese:
忍は無名だった。
　しかし子供たちの別世界においては、実質的な支
配者だった。
lines.english: Shinobu had been nobody. But in the separate world children inhabited, he had been its ruler in all but name.

lines.japanese:
その頃はまだ心を知らない時代だった。
　機械の冷たさが、身のうちにあった。
　冷徹で残酷な歯車を、もう一度はめ込もう。
lines.english: In those days, he still knew nothing of the human heart. The coldness of a machine had lived inside him. Now he would slot that cold, cruel gear back into place.

lines.japanese:
忍は決意する。
　指折り拳砕く演算を、五体をもって描けるように。
　あずさと笛子が森にたどり着く。
lines.english: Shinobu made up his mind. He would make his whole body perform the calculations for breaking fingers and crushing fists. Azusa and Fueko reached the woods.

lines.japanese:
５０センチほどの段差は、重機によって削られた
まま根と土に覆われてできたもので、ふたりはそれ
を乗り越えて奥に進んだ。
lines.english: Heavy machinery had cut the half-meter ledge, which was now covered in roots and earth. The two girls clambered over it and went deeper into the woods.
(Good...)

lines.japanese:
次に、宗多たちが先に森に消える。
　彼らは後方の８人より冷静だと見るべきだ。
　地形を把握している、と見るべきだ。
lines.english: Then Souta and his men disappeared into the woods ahead of him. He had to assume they were calmer than the eight behind. He had to assume they knew the terrain.

lines.japanese:
あずさたちとの合流場所を彼らは知るまいが、時
間の問題だろう。
lines.english: They could not know where he meant to meet Azusa and Fueko, but it would only be a matter of time before they found the place.

lines.japanese:
そして後ろの８人を引きつれるよう、一足飛びに
森に飛び込んだ。
lines.english: Then he plunged into the woods in a single bound, drawing the eight pursuers in behind him.

lines.japanese:
藪畳を掻き分けて、身を隠せるほど奥に入る。
　遠くから見ると鬱蒼としているが、踏み込めばこ
んなものだ。
lines.english: He pushed through the carpet of undergrowth until he was deep enough to hide. The woods looked dense from a distance, but once inside, they were no denser than this.

lines.japanese:
視界は通りやすく、逃走者を目視することは難し
くない。
lines.english: The sight lines were relatively clear. It would not be difficult to spot someone fleeing.

lines.japanese:
距離を開けば、視認はそれだけ困難になる。
　忍は温存した体力を意識しつつ、足跡の残らない
箇所を慎重に選んで進み出した。
lines.english: The farther away he got, the harder he would be to see. Mindful of the strength he had conserved, Shinobu moved on, carefully choosing ground that would leave no footprints.

lines.japanese: 長い夜のはじまりだった―――
lines.english: It was the beginning of a long night—

lines.japanese:
それからしばらく進むと、忍は人為的な物音の一切
から切り離されていた。
lines.english: After pressing on for a while, Shinobu found himself cut off from every man-made sound.

lines.japanese: ただ自分が立てるものをのぞけば。
lines.english: Except for the sounds he made himself.

lines.japanese: （まいた……か？）
lines.english: (Did I... lose them?)

lines.japanese:
木の幹によりかかり、携帯で経過時間を確認。
　２０分ほど経過していた。
lines.english: He leaned against a tree and checked the time on his phone. About twenty minutes had passed.

lines.japanese: （あずさたち、逃げたかな）
lines.english: (Did Azusa and Fueko get away?)

lines.japanese: もとより合流する意図はそれほどなかった。
lines.english: He had never really intended to rejoin them.

lines.japanese:
追いつかれない程度に距離を取り、意図的に物音
を立てながら、かつ足音を残さずに……少年たちを
誘導するのが目的だったからだ。
lines.english: His plan had been to stay far enough ahead not to be caught, make noise deliberately without leaving a trail… and lead the boys away.

lines.japanese:
実際、１０分ほど前まで追撃の気配はあった。
　諦めて帰っただろうか？
lines.english: In fact, he had sensed them in pursuit as recently as ten minutes ago. Had they given up and gone home?

lines.japanese: 相手がどれだけ本気なのか、安易な結論が出せない。
lines.english: There was no telling yet how serious they were.

lines.japanese: 伊勢崎宗多の憎悪の大きさが決めるのだろうが。
lines.english: It probably depended on how deep Souta Isezaki’s hatred ran.

lines.japanese:
もとより夜は彼らの時間だ。
　本気であれば夜通し追いかけてくるだろう。
lines.english: Night was their time. If they were serious, they would chase him until morning.

lines.japanese:
忍としては、振り切って人目につく場所に戻れば
良い。
lines.english: All Shinobu had to do was lose them and make it back somewhere with people around.

lines.japanese:
この段になっては、千鳥の助力も厭う理由もなく
なる。
lines.english: At this point, he no longer had any reason to refuse Chidori's help.

lines.japanese:
街のことなら、章二に頼ることもできる。
　逃れれば勝ちだ。
lines.english: In town, he could rely on Shouji too. If he got away, he won.

lines.japanese:
と考え一息つける精神状態になると、途端にあず
さ達のことが心配になった。
lines.english: The moment that thought let him breathe again, he began to worry about Azusa and the others.

lines.japanese: （……指示通りに移動したかな？）
lines.english: (...Did they move on like I told them?)

lines.japanese:
まさかとは思う。
　しかし、あるいはという不安がつきまとう。
lines.english: Surely not. And yet the thought—what if?—wouldn't leave him.

lines.japanese: 見に行く必要性を感じた。
lines.english: He felt compelled to go and check.

lines.japanese:
約束の場所には、簡単に辿り着けた。
　忍にとっても懐かしい場所、そうそう忘れること
はできない。
lines.english: He reached the agreed spot easily. It was a familiar place for Shinobu too, full of memories—not somewhere he would easily forget.

lines.japanese:
かつて皆で逃げ帰ったコースを逆に辿ったものが、
今通ってきた道程だ。
lines.english: The route he had just taken was the reverse of the one they had all once followed in their flight home.

lines.japanese:
あの逃走は楽しかった―――
　危機に晒されているというのに、顔がほころんだ。
　それも一瞬。
lines.english: That escape had been fun—even with danger all around him, he found himself smiling. But only for a moment.

lines.japanese: 「……あのね」
lines.english: “...Listen.”

lines.japanese: 「だって……」
ふたりは膝を抱えて、そこに座っていた。
lines.english: The two girls sat there, hugging their knees.

lines.japanese: 「だって、忍くんが来るかも知れなかったんだもん」
lines.english: “But you might have come, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「軍隊ならあずさはもう失格になってるよ」
lines.english: “If this were the military, you'd already be disqualified.”

lines.japanese: 「失格になったら決勝戦に出られなくなる……」
lines.english: “Then I wouldn't get to compete in the finals...”

lines.japanese: 「クイズ番組じゃない」
lines.english: “This isn't a game show.”

lines.japanese: もうひとり、笛子にも抗議の視線を向けた。
lines.english: He turned the same reproachful look on Fueko.

lines.japanese: 「君までいながら」
lines.english: “Even with you here...”

lines.japanese: 笛子は、震えていた。
lines.english: Fueko was trembling.

lines.japanese: 「……どうしたの？」
lines.english: “...What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきからずっと……恐いんだと思う」
lines.english: “I think... she's been afraid this whole time.”
“Fueko...”

lines.japanese:
「……ごめんなさい……
　慣れなくて、こういうの……」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry... I'm not used to things like this...”

lines.japanese:
膝を抱く両手が、驚くほど青白い。
　命を薄めたような質感の指が、震えていた。
lines.english: The hands clasped around her knees were shockingly pale. Her fingers trembled, as though life itself had been watered down.

lines.japanese: 「でも良かった……来てくれて」
lines.english: “But I'm glad... I'm glad you came.”
“Oh. Yes...”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、アザできてる、顔？」
lines.english: “Wait—is that a bruise on your face?”

lines.japanese:
「うん。単独行動をしてるのがいたんで、隙を見て
　攻撃したんだ」
lines.english: “Yes. One of them was moving alone, so I waited for an opening and attacked.”

lines.japanese:
扇状になった追手の左端にいたふたりが突出して
いたので、側面に回り込んで襲撃し、気絶させた。
lines.english: Two men at the far left of the pursuers' fan had pulled ahead, so he had circled around their flank, attacked, and knocked them unconscious.

lines.japanese: アザはその時に、肘鉄をくらってできたものだ。
lines.english: The bruise was where he had caught an elbow during the fight.

lines.japanese: そんな経緯を、簡単に話した。
lines.english: He gave them a brief account of what had happened.

lines.japanese: 「それはまた……よくできたね。ドラマみたい」
lines.english: “Wow... you really pulled that off. It's like something out of a TV drama.”

lines.japanese: 「章二に教わったから」
lines.english: “Shouji taught me.”

lines.japanese: 「うー、また章二が立ちふさがる」
lines.english: “Ugh, Shouji gets in my way again.”

lines.japanese: 複雑な表情で、忍の顔に触れる。
lines.english: With a conflicted look, she touched Shinobu's face.

lines.japanese:
「……でも、そんなひどくないみたいだね。
　舐めてあげようか？」
lines.english: “...It doesn't look too bad, though. Want me to lick it for you?”

lines.japanese: それよりも忍は笛子が心配だった。
lines.english: Shinobu was more concerned about Fueko.

lines.japanese: 「そっちは動ける？」
lines.english: “Can you move?”

lines.japanese: 「笛子？」
lines.english: “Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 肩に手をかけた。刹那―――
lines.english: He placed a hand on her shoulder. In that instant—

lines.japanese: 強く振り払われ、忍は呆然と立ち尽くした。
lines.english: She shook his hand off violently, leaving Shinobu standing there in shock.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうしたの？」
lines.english: “W-what's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「……私は……いいから」
lines.english: “...Don't worry about me.”

lines.japanese:
「いいって何がさ。せっかく３人で合流したんだか
　ら、逃げてしまおう。反対側に抜ければもう終わ
　りだ。心配しなくても……」
lines.english: “What do you mean, 'don't worry about you'? We've finally found each other, so let's get away together. Once we make it out the other side, this is over. You don't have to worry...”

lines.japanese: 「私は……っ」
忍たちと目を合わせようとしない。
lines.english: She wouldn't look either of them in the eye.

lines.japanese:
いきり立ったように身を伸ばし、地面に強い視線
を落とす。
lines.english: She drew herself up as though in a fury and fixed the ground with a fierce stare.

lines.japanese: 震える肩。
lines.english: Her shoulders trembled.

lines.japanese: 「……ここに残る」
lines.english: “...I'm staying here.”

lines.japanese: 「どーして！？」
lines.english: “Why?!”

lines.japanese: 「……た、他人だからよ！」
lines.english: “...B-because we're strangers!”

lines.japanese: 「他人？」
lines.english: “Strangers?”

lines.japanese: 「だから……その……」
lines.english: “Because... I mean...”

lines.japanese: 神経質な仕草で、前髪をかき乱す。
lines.english: She raked a nervous hand through her bangs.

lines.japanese:
「……あんたたちと一緒にいたから、こんなことに
　なったのよ」
lines.english: “...This happened because I was with all of you.”

lines.japanese: 「そうよ、あんたたちのせいで！」
lines.english: “That's right. This is your fault!”

lines.japanese:
「迷惑千万だわ。こんな……こんな目に遭うなんて
　……何が平気よ……冗談じゃないわよ！」
lines.english: “This is intolerable. Having something like this happen... What do you mean, 'we'll be fine'...? You've got to be kidding me!”

lines.japanese:
「もし襲われて辱められていたらどうする気だった
　の？　心の傷ができましたじゃすまないのよ！」
lines.english: “What would you have done if they'd attacked and violated us? We wouldn't have walked away with nothing worse than emotional scars!”

lines.japanese:
「私だけじゃなくあずさまで……
　こんな人目につかない危険な場所で集まって……
　馬鹿だったのよ！」
lines.english: “And not only me, but Azusa too... Meeting in a dangerous place where no one would see us... We were idiots!”

lines.japanese:
「ね、ねぇ、ちょっとクールになろうよ……
　なんか言ってることおかしいよ？」
lines.english: “H-hey, let's cool down for a second... What you're saying doesn't make sense.”

lines.japanese: 「おかしくない！」
lines.english: “There's nothing wrong with it!”

lines.japanese: 一喝され、あずさはびくんと両肩を跳ね上げた。
lines.english: The shout made Azusa flinch, her shoulders jerking upward.

lines.japanese: 怒気に掠れる低い声が、
lines.english: A low voice, hoarse with anger—

lines.japanese: 「……むしろ正常だわ」
lines.english: “...If anything, I'm the one being reasonable.”

lines.japanese:
「そうよ。よく考えれば、郊外の廃墟にろくでもな
　い人間が来るなんてわかることでしょう？」
lines.english: “That's right. Think about it: of course lowlifes would show up at an abandoned place out in the suburbs.”

lines.japanese:
「男の子だけならまだしも、女の子がいるグループ
　で集まるなんて……配慮なさすぎるわよ」
lines.english: “It would be one thing if you were all boys, but for a group with girls in it to meet here... That was far too thoughtless.”

lines.japanese:
「今まで何も起こらなかったことは偶然でしかない。
　いつ何が起きてもおかしくなかった！」
lines.english: “It was sheer luck that nothing had happened before now. Something could have happened at any time!”

lines.japanese: 「……今日、はっきりとそれがわかったわ」
lines.english: “...Today made that perfectly clear.”

lines.japanese: 「忍、あなたのミスじゃないとは言わせないわよ」
lines.english: “And don't try to tell me this wasn't your mistake, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね」
lines.english: “You're right.”

lines.japanese: あっさりと忍は認めた。
lines.english: Shinobu admitted it without hesitation.

lines.japanese:
「確かに、僕らの秘密基地がある種の危険にさらさ
　れていたことは認める」
lines.english: “I admit that our secret base was exposed to a certain kind of danger.”

lines.japanese:
「……素直じゃない。
　だったら、今の私の怒りもわかるわよね」
lines.english: “...Well. That was honest of you. Then you understand why I’m angry, don’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「そっちはわからないかな」
lines.english: “That part, I'm not sure I understand.”

lines.japanese: 飄々と。
lines.english: Utterly nonchalant.

lines.japanese: 「なんですって！？」
lines.english: “What did you say?!”

lines.japanese:
「……で、それがどう、ここに一人でとどまる理由
　になるわけ？」
lines.english: “...How does any of that justify you staying here alone?”

lines.japanese:
「言い分はあとで聞くよ。
　でも今は、虎口からの脱出に専念するべきだ」
lines.english: “I'll hear your side later. Right now, we need to focus on getting out of the lion's den.”

lines.japanese: 「何か異論でも？」
lines.english: “Any objections?”

lines.japanese:
横手の茂みを用もなく注視しながら、一切忍には
向き直らずに、
lines.english: She stared pointlessly into the brush beside them, never once turning back to Shinobu—

lines.japanese: 「……お断りだわ」
lines.english: “...I refuse.”

lines.japanese: 「笛子ちゃんってば！」
lines.english: “Fueko!”

lines.japanese:
叫びかけたあずさを忍は制した。
　少女の声が一番よく通る。
lines.english: Shinobu stopped Azusa as she began to shout. Her voice carried farther than anyone else's.

lines.japanese:
もっとも、素人追跡者に木々に反響する声の方位
が聞き分けられるかどうか。
lines.english: Though whether amateur pursuers could tell which direction a voice echoing among the trees came from was another question.

lines.japanese:
とにかく慄然といきり立つべき忍が今なお冷静で
いる以上、あずさは抗弁することはできない。
lines.english: In any case, as long as Shinobu—who had every reason to be terrified and agitated—remained calm, Azusa could hardly argue.

lines.japanese:
「……だから……あなたたち……と……
　一緒にいることが苦痛だからよ」
lines.english: “...Because... being with all of you... is painful.”

lines.japanese:
話しながら模索する風を、忍は暴き立てようとは
しない。
lines.english: Shinobu did not call attention to the way she seemed to be feeling her way as she spoke.

lines.japanese: 「いやだから、一緒にいたくないから……」
lines.english: “Because I hate it. Because I don't want to be with you...”

lines.japanese:
「今回のことだってあなたのせいだし、これからさら
　にひどいことに巻き込まれるかも知れない……
　だから一緒にいたくない」
lines.english: “This happened because of you, and I might get dragged into something even worse next... That's why I don't want to be with you.”

lines.japanese:
「ひとりで逃げてひとりでつかまっても、それは私の
　責任だもの。納得できるでしょ」
lines.english: “If I run alone and get caught alone, that's my responsibility. Surely you can accept that.”

lines.japanese:
「でもあなたと一緒にいて、捕まって……
　それは私のせいじゃないもの」
lines.english: “But if I stay with you and get caught... then it isn't my fault.”

lines.japanese:
「だから私はひとりで行くわ。
　あなたたちはさっさと逃げたらいいのよ」
lines.english: “So I'm going alone. The two of you should hurry up and get away.”

lines.japanese:
「……それで、もう二度と関わらないでくれる？
　つきまとわなければ、私からもこれ以上ぐだぐだ
　言う気はないわ」
lines.english: “...And once this is over, will you stay out of my life for good? If you leave me alone, I won't drag this out any further either.”

lines.japanese: 「……でもひとりは危険だな、この状況では」
lines.english: “...But in this situation, going alone is dangerous.”

lines.japanese:
「相手は興奮していると思う。もし向こうのボスが
　手下に何か命じていたとしても……たとえば、狙
　いは僕ひとりだけであるとか」
lines.english: “I think they're worked up. Even if their leader gave his followers an order... even if, for example, he told them their only target was me—”

lines.japanese: 「だとしても……所詮は子供だ」
lines.english: “Even then... they're just kids.”

lines.japanese:
「感情のままに君にだってひどいことをするかも知
　れない。笛子を傷つけたりするかも知れない」
lines.english: “They might get carried away and do something awful to you too. They might hurt you, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「君は見た目がちょっと、美人すぎるから」
lines.english: “You're a little... too beautiful.”

lines.japanese:
「……それはありがとう、貴宮君。でもあなたに誉
　められても嬉しくないから」
lines.english: “...Thank you, Atemiya. But praise from you doesn't make me happy.”

lines.japanese:
「同世代の女の子しか見てない連中には、キレイな
　タイプは刺激が強すぎる」
lines.english: “For boys who've only ever looked at girls their own age, someone as beautiful as you would be far too much for them.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、僕は彼らに君を晒す気は毛頭ないんだ」
lines.english: “Which is why I have no intention whatsoever of exposing you to them.”

lines.japanese: 「……渡すつもりはないってことだ」
lines.english: “...I'm not handing you over.”

lines.japanese: 笛子は鼻で笑う。
lines.english: Fueko snorted.

lines.japanese:
「なにそれ。私はあなたのものじゃないわ。私のも
　のでしょう？」
lines.english: “What is that supposed to mean? I don't belong to you. I belong to myself, don't I?”

lines.japanese:
「渡すかどうかは私が決めるし、そこに至る選択も
　自分の責任でします。あなたの決断は関係ないの」
lines.english: “I decide whether I give myself to anyone, and I take responsibility for every choice that leads me to that point. Your decisions have nothing to do with it.”

lines.japanese:
「危険なんだよ、笛子。嫌うのはいい。けど逃げて
　からにしよう」
lines.english: “It's dangerous, Fueko. Hate me if you want. But do it after we've escaped.”

lines.japanese: 「今、逃げても……っ」
lines.english: “Even if we get away now...!”

lines.japanese: 「……それも何とかする」
lines.english: “...I'll do something about that too.”

lines.japanese: 「できるわけないでしょ！　馬鹿じゃないの！？」
lines.english: “You can't! Are you an idiot?!”

lines.japanese: 「……静かに」
lines.english: “...Quiet.”

lines.japanese: 笛子は唇を噛む。
lines.english: Fueko bit her lip.

lines.japanese: 「……無理よ。ああいう連中はしつこいの」
lines.english: “...It's impossible. People like that never give up.”

lines.japanese:
「僕もしつこい。それにこういうことは、手段を選
　ばない方が勝つんだ。ケンカだってそうさ」
lines.english: “I'm persistent too. Besides, in this kind of situation, the person willing to use any means necessary wins. Fights are the same.”
“...Shinobu... you...?”

lines.japanese:
「さあ、もう戯れ言はいいだろう？
　逃げよう。ここだっていつ見つかるか」
lines.english: “That's enough nonsense, don't you think? Let's go. We could be found here at any moment.”

lines.japanese: 「だからひとりで……逃げてって言ったじゃないっ」
lines.english: “I told you to run... without me!”

lines.japanese:
「私は……ひとりで逃げられるから……自分の身の
　安全くらい、ひとりで守れるからっ」
lines.english: “I... can get away by myself... I'm perfectly capable of keeping myself safe on my own!”

lines.japanese:
「ねえ、あ、あたしは恐いな……恐いよ……
　３人で逃げたいよ……」
lines.english: “Hey, I-I'm scared... Really scared... I want all three of us to run together...”

lines.japanese: 笛子の袖を引く。
lines.english: She tugged at Fueko's sleeve.
“...You little squirt...”

lines.japanese: そのとき、３人以外の人の声が聞こえた。
lines.english: At that moment, they heard a voice that belonged to none of them.
“...What was that?”
“...The enemy?”

lines.japanese:
「まだ遠いけど、こっち方向に来てるね……でも、
　おかしいぞ？」
lines.english: “They're still far away, but they're coming this way... Still, something's strange.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なにが？」
lines.english: “W-what?”

lines.japanese: 凝然と森の奥に、錐のような視線を飛ばす。
lines.english: He drove a gimlet stare deep into the woods.

lines.japanese: 「…………行こう。笛子も」
lines.english: “............Let's go. You too, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 忍は笛子を抱擁した。
lines.english: Shinobu embraced Fueko.
“...!? Wh-what are—”

lines.japanese:
「そんなに怯えなくていいから。どんな結果になっ
　てもいいから。だから……今だけは、頼むよ」
lines.english: “You don't have to be so frightened. No matter how this turns out, it's okay. So... just for now, please.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと忍……っ」
lines.english: “W-wait, Shinobu...”

lines.japanese:
「いいんだよ、もっと安心して生きて。思う通りに
　やったらいい。嫌いたかったら嫌ってくれてもい
　い。そのことで、僕は笛子を責めたりしない」
lines.english: “It's all right. You can live without being so afraid. Do whatever you want. If you want to hate me, then hate me. I won't blame you for that, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「約束するから」
lines.english: “I promise.”

lines.japanese:
解放する。
　この場にはそぐわない呑気な顔を、忍は笛子に向
けた。
lines.english: He let her go. Shinobu faced Fueko with a carefree expression utterly unsuited to the moment.

lines.japanese: 「そしたら、また口説きなおすさ」
lines.english: “Then I'll just have to win you over again.”

lines.japanese: 「……もう、馬鹿」
lines.english: “...You idiot.”

lines.japanese: 目尻を一度だけぬぐう。
lines.english: She wiped once at the corner of her eye.

lines.japanese: 「……行きましょう」
lines.english: “...Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。行こうあずさ」
lines.english: “Yes. Let's go, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「うす」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese:
３人は歩き出した。
　先頭が女子ふたり。後方に忍。
　急激に、オレンジ色の輝きが濃度を増した。
lines.english: The three of them set out on foot. The two girls led, with Shinobu behind them. The orange light abruptly gathered depth.

lines.japanese:
その帰着する結末としての黒を主張しはじめ、瞬
く間に木々の間は夜気で満たされた。
lines.english: Black—the inevitable end of orange—began to assert itself, and in moments night filled the spaces between the trees.

lines.japanese:
変わらずやってくるはずの夜が、今日ばかりはど
こかしら不吉な臭気をともなっていた。
lines.english: Night came as it always did. Only today, it carried the faint stench of something ominous.

lines.japanese: ３人は会話もなく森を走る。
lines.english: The three ran through the woods without speaking.

lines.japanese:
先ほどまでは歩いていたが、背後からの気配がい
よいよ強くなると、目視できない距離まで引き離す
必要があった。
lines.english: They had been walking until then, but as the presence behind them grew stronger, they needed to put enough distance between them that the pursuers could no longer see them.

lines.japanese:
夜の闇は彼らをよく助けたが、それ以上に追跡者
たちは鋭敏に、忍たちの足取りを辿ってくる。
lines.english: The darkness of night helped conceal them, but their pursuers followed Shinobu's group with even greater acuity.

lines.japanese: （おかしい……妙に統制が取れている気がする！）
lines.english: (This is strange... They seem unusually well coordinated!)

lines.japanese:
（……こんな暗闇で明かりもなく、精密な追跡がで
　きるのか？　足跡も見えないだろうに……）
lines.english: (...Can they really track us this precisely in darkness without any light? They shouldn't even be able to see our footprints...)

lines.japanese:
得体の知れない圧力を後方から感じる。
　森の外で見たときとは、段違いの危機感だ。
lines.english: He felt an unfathomable pressure behind him. The sense of danger dwarfed what he had felt outside the woods.

lines.japanese:
少なくともこの連中は、忍たちをまったく見くび
ってはいない。
lines.english: At the very least, these people were not underestimating Shinobu and the others in the slightest.

lines.japanese:
（ふたり潰したせいで警戒されたか？　だけどこれ
　じゃ、本物の軍隊並の追撃だ……）
lines.english: (Did taking out those two put them on their guard? But this pursuit is on the level of a real military operation...)

lines.japanese: 「はっ、はっ、はっ……！」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah...!”

lines.japanese: 「はっ、はっ、はっ……」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah...”

lines.japanese: 体力的には、笛子の消耗が大きい。
lines.english: Fueko was badly worn out.

lines.japanese:
あずさは意外と元気で、忍はほぼ完全に体力を温
存できている。
lines.english: Azusa was surprisingly energetic, while Shinobu still had almost all of his strength in reserve.

lines.japanese:
森にいる限り、忍の優位性は絶対だ。
　地形を知り尽くしていることも大きい。
lines.english: As long as they remained in the woods, Shinobu's advantage was absolute. It helped enormously that he knew the terrain inside out.

lines.japanese:
だが……背後から染みてくる敵意も憎悪も感じさ
せない、ただ圧倒的な念意は、そんな自信さえも希
薄なものとしてしまう。
lines.english: Yet the overwhelming force of will seeping from behind them, carrying neither hostility nor hatred, made even that confidence feel insubstantial.

lines.japanese:
それは集団の気配だ。
　直感的なものではない。
　確信だった。
lines.english: It was the presence of a group. This was not intuition. It was certainty.

lines.japanese:
なぜなら、無音だったからだ。
　もし雑な追跡なら、こちらの走行に焦り足並みを
乱すはずだ。
lines.english: Because they made no sound. Sloppy pursuers would have panicked when their quarry ran and fallen out of step.

lines.japanese:
駆ければ枝を踏み葉を揺らす。
　そういった物音がまったくしない。
　逆に、人為的な消音を予期させるのである。
lines.english: Anyone running would snap branches and stir leaves. There was none of that noise whatsoever. The absence itself suggested deliberate silence.

lines.japanese:
一切の情報がないという観測結果は、同時に一帯
を埋め尽くす何かがあることも示す。
lines.english: The complete absence of information was itself an observation: something was filling the entire area.

lines.japanese:
無は逆に有であるのだ。
　忍は最悪も検討しなければならなくなった。
lines.english: The absence itself was a presence. Shinobu was forced to consider the worst.

lines.japanese: 「ふたりとも」
lines.english: “You two.”

lines.japanese:
ペースを上げて間に割り込み、足を止めずに話し
かける。
lines.english: He increased his pace, slipped between them, and spoke without breaking stride.

lines.japanese:
「ハイキングコースに出る。
　で、道なりに曲がっていこう」
lines.english: “We're about to come out onto the hiking trail. Then we'll follow it around the bend.”

lines.japanese:
呼吸に忙しいふたりは返事もできない。
　両者の背中をぽんと叩いて、
lines.english: The two were too busy catching their breath to answer. He patted each of them on the back.

lines.japanese: 「頑張って、大丈夫だから」
lines.english: “Keep going. You're all right.”

lines.japanese:
あずさが頷く。
　笛子はもう顎が出ていて、それどころではない。
lines.english: Azusa nodded. Fueko was already running with her chin jutting forward, too exhausted even to respond.

lines.japanese:
３人は開けた道に出た。
　障害物のない地面だ。
　移動はしやすいが、それだけに危険でもある。
lines.english: The three emerged onto an open trail. There were no obstacles underfoot. It was easier going, and therefore more dangerous.

lines.japanese: （……待ち伏せはない……はず）
lines.english: (...There shouldn't... be an ambush.)

lines.japanese:
忍たちが向かっているのは、高いフェンスで遮ら
れた、いわば袋小路なのだ。
lines.english: They were heading toward what amounted to a dead end blocked by a high fence.

lines.japanese:
ただ一箇所だけ、向こう側に出ることのできる穴
がある。
lines.english: Only one opening allowed passage to the other side.

lines.japanese:
子供時代に見つけたもので、これは追跡者も知ら
ないはずである。
lines.english: They had found it when they were children, and their pursuers should not know about it.

lines.japanese:
匂いでも辿っているのでなければ、コース予想は
困難のはずだった。
lines.english: Unless they were tracking them by scent, the pursuers should have found this route difficult to predict.

lines.japanese: 「はっ、はっ、はっ？」
lines.english: “Hah, hah... hah?”

lines.japanese: あずさが振り返り、なだらかに左折する道を指さす。
lines.english: Azusa looked back and pointed to the trail curving gently left.

lines.japanese:
「そう、そっちに。逆らわないで。あとちょっとペ
　ース落として」
lines.english: “Yes, that way. Follow the bend. And slow down a little more.”

lines.japanese: スピードを落として、笛子は大きく息を吸い込む。
lines.english: Slowing down, Fueko drew a deep breath.
“Now then...”

lines.japanese:
後方に注意を向ける。
　暗闇はいかなる情報も伝えない。
　虚無の壁がそそり立っている。
lines.english: He turned his attention behind them. The darkness conveyed no information. A wall of nothingness towered there.

lines.japanese:
しかし……その向こうから追ってくる者がいると
いう事実は、忍には確実なものとして受け止められ
ていた。
lines.english: But Shinobu was certain that someone was pursuing them from beyond that wall.

lines.japanese:
迂回路。
　追手は当然、距離を詰めるために弧状に逃げる忍
たちへの最短距離を選ぶ。
lines.english: Their route was a detour. Naturally, the pursuers would take the shortest line to close on Shinobu's group as they fled along an arc.

lines.japanese:
始点と終点で作る弓が忍たちのルートだとすれば、
弦は追跡者だ。
lines.english: If Shinobu and the others were traveling the curve of a bow between two points, the pursuers were its string.

lines.japanese: 距離のリソースを失い、相手を有利にしている。
lines.english: They were spending their lead and handing their opponents the advantage.

lines.japanese:
しかしただ一点、逃走側に優位が生まれる。
　相手の動きを誘導できるということだ。
lines.english: But it also gave the fugitives one advantage. They could steer their opponents' movements.

lines.japanese:
地形さえ把握していれば、状況によってはかなり
の決め打ちが可能となる。
lines.english: Depending on the situation, knowing the terrain allowed him to anticipate their movements with considerable certainty.

lines.japanese: 即ち……罠である。
lines.english: In other words... a trap.

lines.japanese:
果たして、小さな悲鳴。
　忍は内心、快哉を叫んだ。
lines.english: Sure enough: a small cry. Shinobu cheered inwardly.

lines.japanese:
この蛇行ルートに挟まれる位置には、合流前に設
置した蔓と枝のトラップが置かれている。
lines.english: Between the bends of this winding route lay a trap of vines and branches he had set before rejoining the girls.

lines.japanese:
草むらに隠し幹に結んだ蔦と、ちょうど倒れた当
たりに逆向きに固定された鋭い枝。
lines.english: A vine hidden in the grass and tied to a trunk, and a sharpened branch secured pointing backward at exactly the place where the victim would fall.

lines.japanese:
足をかけて転倒すれば、刺さることもあるだろう。
　原始的な罠だ。
lines.english: If someone caught a foot and fell, the branch might impale them. A primitive trap.

lines.japanese:
時間がなかったせいもあるが、実際のところとて
も効果を期待できるものではない。
lines.english: Partly because he had been short on time, he could not realistically expect the trap to accomplish much.

lines.japanese:
狙いは別にある。
　これもまた、追撃側の認識を操作できるのだ。
lines.english: Its true purpose lay elsewhere. This too could manipulate the pursuers' perception.

lines.japanese:
向かう先に罠が仕掛けられているとなれば、足も
鈍る。
lines.english: Knowing that traps lay ahead would slow them down.

lines.japanese:
事実、背後から伝わったたった一つの情報が、
忍の精神をずいぶんと楽にした。
lines.english: In fact, that single piece of information from behind put Shinobu considerably more at ease.

lines.japanese:
殺傷力のある罠は一つだけだ。
　あとは全て、蔦を結んだだけのダミーである。こ
れは三箇所に設置されている。
lines.english: Only one trap was capable of serious injury. All the rest were dummies made by simply tying vines. He had set three of those.

lines.japanese:
見つかれば見つかるほど、相手の意志を鈍らせる
だろう。
lines.english: The more they discovered, the more their resolve would falter.

lines.japanese: 「森に入るよ」
lines.english: “We're going back into the woods.”

lines.japanese:
どちらにしても、道は移動を読まれやすいのであ
まり使いたくない。
lines.english: In any case, he did not want to use the trails any more than necessary; they made their movements too easy to predict.

lines.japanese: ３人は再び、樹木の加護に身を委ねた。
lines.english: The three again entrusted themselves to the protection of the trees.

lines.japanese: 「歩こう。なるべく音を立てないように」
lines.english: “Let's walk. Make as little noise as you can.”
“Hah... hah... haaah...”
“Hah, hah, hah, hah...”

lines.japanese:
ふたりともぐったりしている。
　少女の体力では、さすがに厳しいようだ。
lines.english: Both girls were limp with exhaustion. It seemed to be too much for their stamina.

lines.japanese: 「行くよ、もう一がんばり」
lines.english: “Come on. One more push.”

lines.japanese: 「……はっ、はっ……あい……」
重い体を引きずるようにして、奥に―――
lines.english: They dragged their exhausted bodies deeper into the woods—

lines.japanese:
右手前方の闇に、光点を見つけた。
　それは一瞬で消えたが、明らかに人工の光だった。
lines.english: He spotted a point of light in the darkness ahead and to the right. It vanished in an instant, but it had clearly been artificial.

lines.japanese: 「……近い……まさか」
lines.english: “...So close... It can't be.”

lines.japanese:
すぐに思いつくのは、ハイキングコースにあらか
じめ配置されていた別働隊だろう。
lines.english: The first explanation that occurred to him was a separate unit stationed in advance along the hiking trail.

lines.japanese:
手際が良すぎる、と忍は思った。
　今のミスは痛烈だった。
lines.english: They were far too efficient, Shinobu thought. That mistake had been costly.

lines.japanese:
が、先ほどまで追っていたチームと連絡を取り合
った結果としての行動と考えれば、位置的には納得
できてしまう。
lines.english: But if this move was the result of communication with the team that had pursued them until moments ago, the position made disturbing sense.

lines.japanese:
こちらが森に入ったから、追撃を入れ替えたのだ
としたら―――
lines.english: If they had switched pursuit teams when Shinobu’s group entered the woods—

lines.japanese: 「……まずいな」
lines.english: “...This is bad.”

lines.japanese: ふたりに気付かれないよう、忍は呟く。
lines.english: Shinobu murmured it without letting the girls hear.

lines.japanese:
少ない情報から組み立てられる最もストレートな
解答は、ある程度の訓練を受けた兵隊……である。
lines.english: The most straightforward answer the sparse evidence suggested was that the pursuers were soldiers with some degree of training.

lines.japanese:
携帯はライトが危険で確認できないが、おそらく
使用できないだろう。
lines.english: He could not risk the phone's light by checking it, but it was probably unusable anyway.

lines.japanese:
だが敵は連絡を取り合っている。
　強力な無線装備があるのではないか、と考えられる。
lines.english: Yet the enemy was communicating. It was reasonable to assume they had powerful radios.

lines.japanese:
また携帯が使えないことも、ある種の妨害行動な
のではないかと―――
lines.english: Perhaps the loss of phone service was itself some form of jamming—

lines.japanese:
頭を振る。
　予想しすぎは危険だ。
　確実に手元にある情報をまず信頼する。
lines.english: He shook his head. Too much speculation was dangerous. He would first trust only what he knew for certain.

lines.japanese: そして取捨選択を明確にしておく。
lines.english: Then he would decide clearly what to keep and what to discard.

lines.japanese: 忍はあずさに近寄る。
lines.english: Shinobu approached Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「……抜け道、わかる？」
lines.english: “...Do you know the shortcut?”

lines.japanese: 「昔、向こう側に抜ける時に使ったの？」
lines.english: “The one we used to get through to the other side a long time ago?”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう。あのパイプ廃墟都市への道」
lines.english: “That's it. The road to that ruined city of pipes.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、わかると思うけど……」
lines.english: “I think I know it, but...”

lines.japanese: 「暗いよ？」
lines.english: “It's dark.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、見えるし」
lines.english: “I can still see.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうか」
lines.english: “Oh, right.”

lines.japanese: あずさは夜目がきくのである。
lines.english: Azusa could see in the dark.

lines.japanese: 「……ふたりで行ってもらっていい？」
lines.english: “...Can the two of you go without me?”

lines.japanese: 少女の眉間に不安の二文字。
lines.english: Anxiety was written between the girl's brows.

lines.japanese: 「信じて」
lines.english: “Trust me.”
“...O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 長年の積み重ねで、強引に納得させる。
lines.english: The weight of all their years together forced her to accept it.

lines.japanese: 「笛もよろしく」
lines.english: “Take care of Fue for me too.”

lines.japanese: 「……どうするの？　また？」
lines.english: “...What are you going to do? Again?”

lines.japanese: 「けっこう厄介な連中みたい。本気モードで行くよ」
lines.english: “They seem fairly troublesome. I'm going all out.”

lines.japanese:
「忍……でも……こんなところで捕まったら……
　あなただって」
lines.english: “Shinobu... but... if they catch you in a place like this... Even you—”

lines.japanese: 忍はひとつかみもある石を拾い上げ、
lines.english: Shinobu picked up a stone large enough to fill his hand—

lines.japanese: こともなく片手で握りつぶした。
lines.english: —and crushed it in one fist as if it were nothing.
“Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「本気モードってやつだよ」
lines.english: “That's what I mean by going all out.”

lines.japanese: 「見えないのに……」
lines.english: “But you'd never know by looking...”

lines.japanese:
「よっぽど訓練された人間じゃなければ、打たれ負
　けない。章二のお墨付きだよ」
lines.english: “Unless someone's had extraordinary training, I won't lose in a straight fight. Shouji vouches for that.”

lines.japanese: 「……あまり、無理しないでよ？」
lines.english: “...Don't push yourself too hard, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「できることしかしないよ」
lines.english: “I'll only do what I know I can.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃここで一旦分離だ。冷静に逃げてね。
　あずさよろしく」
lines.english: “Then this is where we split up for now. Stay calm and keep running. I'm counting on you, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……忍くんも」
lines.english: “Okay... You too, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、笛子。詳しい話はまた後日」
lines.english: “Fueko, we'll have the rest of that conversation another day.”
“Shinobu...”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 振り向きもせず笛子は言った。
lines.english: Without turning, Fueko spoke.

lines.japanese: 「……さっきは……ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry... about before.”

lines.japanese: 「僕の好意は完璧です。揺らぐことはありません」
lines.english: “My affection is perfect. It will never waver.”

lines.japanese:
「……と言ったけどね、本当はけっこう心が弱かっ
　たりする」
lines.english: “...I said that, but I’m actually pretty fragile at heart.”

lines.japanese:
「さらに親睦を深める機会があればいいのだけど……
　まあこのつまらない状態を脱出してからだね」
lines.english: “I hope we get another chance to know each other better... after we get out of this tiresome situation, anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、もう一度話し合おう」
lines.english: “So let's talk it over again.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、また」
lines.english: “See you, then.”

lines.japanese: 忍は足を止めた。
lines.english: Shinobu stopped.

lines.japanese:
ふたりもつられて止まりかかるが、両手で前に押
し出して歩かせる。
lines.english: The two girls started to stop with him, but he pressed them onward with both hands and kept them walking.

lines.japanese: 闇に消えるまでを確認し、
lines.english: He watched until they disappeared into the dark.

lines.japanese:
両手を揉みほぐし、闇を睨んだ。
　相変わらずの無音が、忍び寄ってくる。
　どこに何人いるか、観測することもできない。
lines.english: He worked the tension from his hands and glared into the darkness. That same silence crept closer. He could not tell how many there were or where they stood.

lines.japanese:
予測と、あとは応変の対処で対抗しなければなら
ない。
lines.english: He would have to rely on prediction, then improvise whatever response the moment demanded.

lines.japanese:
目的は二つ。
　まず笛子とあずさの脱出をサポートする。
　そしてもう一つが、敵の確認である。
lines.english: He had two objectives. First, help Fueko and Azusa escape. Second, identify the enemy.

lines.japanese:
つついてまずそうだったら、即逃げるつもりだ。
忍も死ぬつもりはない。
lines.english: If a quick probe suggested they were too dangerous, he would run at once. Shinobu had no intention of dying either.
“...All right.”

lines.japanese:
相手がそれなりに知っている相手なら、うかつな
陽動はかえってふたりを危険にする。
lines.english: If the enemy knew what they were doing, a careless diversion might put the girls in even greater danger.

lines.japanese:
先ほどやったような、側面からの襲撃も警戒され
ている可能性が高い。
lines.english: They were also likely to be on guard against another attack from the flank like the one he had used earlier.

lines.japanese:
だから忍は、本気を出すことにした。
　不可能を打破するには、それなりの魔法が必要な
のである。
lines.english: So Shinobu decided to get serious. To break through the impossible, he would need magic to match.

lines.japanese:
環境については申し分がない。
　夜の森。
　不利なようでいて、大きなアドバンテージ。
lines.english: The environment was ideal. A forest at night. An apparent disadvantage—and an enormous advantage.

lines.japanese: 目を凝らす。
lines.english: He peered into the dark.

lines.japanese:
最初は純黒のベールでしかないそれが、次第に木
々や狭間に潜むものを、朧気に浮上させてきた。
lines.english: At first it was nothing but a veil of pure black. Gradually, the trees and whatever lurked between them emerged in dim relief.

lines.japanese:
体内で筋肉が小さく鳴るのを意識しながら、忍は
下肢をたわませた。
lines.english: Aware of the faint creak of muscle inside his body, Shinobu coiled his legs.

lines.japanese: 暴れ始める少年に仕掛け、もみ合いを続けて１５秒。
lines.english: He caught the boy in a hold as he began to thrash. They grappled for fifteen seconds.

lines.japanese:
不意を突いたつもりが、首にかけた腕に拳を入れ
られ、存外に苦戦した。
lines.english: Shinobu had thought he had taken the boy by surprise, but the boy drove a fist into the arm around his neck, making the struggle unexpectedly difficult.

lines.japanese:
相手がペアであれば失敗だったろう。
　忸怩たる思いだが、純然たる肉体の闘争は思考を
白紙にする。
lines.english: Had the boy not been alone, Shinobu would have failed. Humiliating as that was, a contest of pure physical strength wiped his mind clean.

lines.japanese:
拳の上から万力のような力で締めると、声だけは
封じることができた。
lines.english: He tightened his arm like a vise, the boy's fist still wedged beneath it, and managed at least to silence him.

lines.japanese:
しかし常人の数倍もの負荷をかけているというの
に、気絶に持って行くことが難しい。
lines.english: But even while applying several times the pressure an ordinary person could exert, he struggled to render the boy unconscious.

lines.japanese: 少年の動き方は、知ったものだった。
lines.english: The way the boy moved was familiar.

lines.japanese:
背後から襲われたにも関わらず相手の攻撃に対処
し、身のこなしによってなんとかこちらの消耗を誘
おうとしている。
lines.english: Though attacked from behind, the boy had responded to the assault and used his movements to try to wear Shinobu down.

lines.japanese:
永遠のような１５秒が過ぎ、ようやく締め落とす
ことができた。
lines.english: After fifteen seconds that felt eternal, Shinobu finally choked him unconscious.

lines.japanese:
完全に気絶した体を、そっと横たえる。
　それなりに鍛えられた肉体だった。
lines.english: He gently laid the unconscious body down. The boy had clearly undergone some training.

lines.japanese:
命に別状はないが、死亡しても構わないと忍は思
った。
lines.english: The boy's life was not in danger, though Shinobu would not have cared if he died.

lines.japanese: 命がけの闘争とはそういうことだ。
lines.english: That was what a life-and-death struggle meant.

lines.japanese:
さて、検分している暇はない。
　すぐに移動を開始する。
　次なる獲物を求めて―――
lines.english: There was no time to examine him. Shinobu immediately began moving again. In search of his next prey—

lines.japanese: 崩れる体を支え、音を立てずに地面に置いた。
lines.english: He supported the collapsing body and laid it on the ground without a sound.

lines.japanese: これで３人。
lines.english: That made three.

lines.japanese: 少し呼吸を整える。
lines.english: He steadied his breathing.

lines.japanese: （こんな女の子まで……）
lines.english: (Even a girl like this...)

lines.japanese:
３人目の敵は、少女だったのだ。
　しかもこちらはひどく華奢で、まったく何の鍛錬
もしていないとわかった。
lines.english: The third enemy had been a girl. And she was terribly slight; it was obvious she had undergone no training whatsoever.

lines.japanese:
柔らかい思春期の身体でしかない。
　気絶させるのも簡単で、むしろ前のふたりが手強
かった分、拍子抜けだった。
lines.english: Nothing but the soft, untrained body of an adolescent. Knocking her unconscious had been easy. After the difficulty of the previous two, the ease of it was almost anticlimactic.

lines.japanese:
この気の緩みは危険だな、と自覚できた。
　４人目に挑めば、致命的なミスをするような感覚
が、胃の腑にわだかまっている。
lines.english: He knew it was dangerous to let his guard down. A knot in the pit of his stomach told him that challenging a fourth would invite a fatal mistake.

lines.japanese:
こういう直感は信じた方が良い。
　肉体の声なのだから。
　冷静に検討しても、反撃としては充分な数だ。
lines.english: He should trust intuition of this kind. It was the voice of his body. Even by a calm assessment, three was enough of a counterattack.

lines.japanese: 追跡者は恐らく１０人を越えてはいないはずだ。
lines.english: There were probably no more than ten pursuers.

lines.japanese:
それ以上は人員過剰だ。効率が落ちる。
　少なく見積もっても損耗３割。
　これで撤退しないなら素人だろう。
lines.english: Any more would be excessive and reduce their efficiency. Even by the lowest estimate, they had lost thirty percent of their strength. If they did not retreat now, they were probably amateurs.

lines.japanese:
忍は注意深く周囲に目線を飛ばしつつ、闇夜に身
を溶け込ませた。
lines.english: Casting careful glances around him, Shinobu melted into the night.

lines.japanese:
ずいぶん歩いた気がする。
　森は変わらず静かだった。
　移動を続け、やがて少し開けた箇所に出た。
lines.english: He felt as though he had been walking for ages. The forest remained silent. He continued on until he emerged into a small open space.

lines.japanese: 光に驚いて空を見ると、月だった。
lines.english: The light startled him. He looked up and saw the moon.

lines.japanese:
月光の光量が、今の忍には強い刺激となった。
　広場のような場所だった。
　忍も知らなかった。
lines.english: The moonlight struck Shinobu’s eyes with startling intensity now. It was a place like a clearing. Even Shinobu had not known it was here.

lines.japanese: ちょうど円形に抜けていて、まるで、
lines.english: The opening was circular. Almost like—
(An arena—)

lines.japanese: そして闘争を暗示するかのように、
lines.english: And as if to promise battle—

lines.japanese: 「やー、すげえすげえ！」
lines.english: “Whoa! Awesome, awesome!”

lines.japanese:
拍手とともに、向こう側の暗がりから一人の少女
が無造作に歩いてきた。
lines.english: Applauding, a girl sauntered out of the darkness on the far side.

lines.japanese:
傾いだ光源に全身が照らされる。
　スリムだがどこか野性的な四肢の上、鮮やかに流
れる金色が月の魔力を受けて淡い燐光を発している。
lines.english: The slanting light illuminated her from head to toe. Her limbs were slender but somehow feral. Above them, a vivid river of gold caught the moon's sorcery and glowed with a pale phosphorescence.

lines.japanese:
金髪なのだ。
　異国の少女、しかし言葉は達者だ。
lines.english: Blond hair. A foreign girl, though she spoke Japanese fluently.

lines.japanese: 「どもどもー、見てたよー、君の活躍」
lines.english: “Hey, hey! I saw what you did out there!”

lines.japanese:
軽い口調で、少女は６メートルほどの距離に踵を
置いた。
lines.english: Her tone breezy, the girl stopped some six meters away.

lines.japanese: その顔に、実に、実に楽しげな笑み。
lines.english: A truly, truly delighted smile filled her face.

lines.japanese:
「あ、お呼びでない～？　お呼びでないかぁ？
　こりゃまた失礼いたしま―――」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm not wanted? Not wanted, huh? Well then, pardon the intru—”

lines.japanese: 眼光が、
lines.english: Her gaze—

lines.japanese: 「せん！」
lines.english: “—sion? Not!”

lines.japanese:
煌々と灯る。
　人間じゃないな、と忍は感じた。
lines.english: —blazed brilliantly. She's not human, Shinobu felt.

lines.japanese:
つまり……情愛が破損しているのだ。恐らく、
この少女は。
lines.english: In other words... her capacity for affection was damaged. That was probably what was wrong with this girl.

lines.japanese:
それは人ではない。
　ヒト型の何かだ。
lines.english: This was no person. It was something shaped like a human.

lines.japanese: 「……おー、可愛いこわい顔しちゃって、また」
lines.english: “Ooh, look at you making such a cute, scary face.”

lines.japanese:
「ま、こっちもそんな詳しく知らないんだけどね。
　見てたってのは嘘だし。でも３人やったの、君で
　しょ？」
lines.english: “Well, I don't know much about it myself. And I lied about watching. But you're the one who took out those three, right?”

lines.japanese:
「やったって顔してるしね。ん、でも殺してはいな
　いのか？　んー、駄目だこりゃ、ガード固いね」
lines.english: “Your face says you did. Hmm, but you didn't kill them? Ah, no good. Your guard's tight.”
“...My guard?”

lines.japanese: べろべろばあ、のポーズで、
lines.english: Pulling a childish face—

lines.japanese: 「読心術！」
lines.english: “Mind reading!”

lines.japanese:
「あー、地形効果ってやつかもね。この森の地形効
　果を最大限に生かすユニットが君なわけだ」
lines.english: “Ah, maybe it's a terrain bonus. You're the unit that makes maximum use of this forest's terrain bonus.”

lines.japanese:
忍は周囲に注意を払う。
　仲間の存在を確かめるためだ。
lines.english: Shinobu remained alert to his surroundings. He was checking for her companions.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いないよ。あたしだけ」
lines.english: “Oh, nobody else is here. Just me.”

lines.japanese: ぱたぱたと手を振る。
lines.english: She flapped a hand.

lines.japanese:
「あたし、ジーン。
　アメリカ人の誇りを持った日本人」
lines.english: “I'm Gene. A Japanese girl with the pride of an American.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそりゃ、アハハハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “What does that even mean? Ahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese:
「ハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハ、ハハ
　ハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハハ
　ハハハ！」
lines.english: “Hahahahahahahahahahaha—haha hahahahahahahahahahahaha haha!”

lines.japanese:
突然真顔になる。
　キレイに狂ってるな、と思った。典型的すぎて。
lines.english: Her face abruptly went blank. Beautifully crazy, he thought. Almost textbook.

lines.japanese:
「まあ、つまり殺っちまおうってことなんだわ、
　これがまたしかし」
lines.english: “Well, basically, the idea is I kill you. But here's the thing—”

lines.japanese:
「ところが、あたしはフェアプレイ精神。やるなら
　対等にやりたい。フェアネス！　フェアネス！
　いちごフェア！」
lines.english: “But I'm a believer in fair play. If we're going to do this, I want us on equal terms. Fairness! Fairness! Strawberry fair!”

lines.japanese: 「うっそーん！　バキューン！」
lines.english: “Just kidding! Bang!”

lines.japanese:
背後から突然銃を取り出して、忍に向けた。
　しかし弾丸も出ないし発砲音もしない。
lines.english: She suddenly produced a gun from behind her back and aimed it at Shinobu. But no bullet came out. There was no report.

lines.japanese:
身構えた忍だが、こんな緊急時にありながら妙に
気恥ずかしくなった。
lines.english: Shinobu had braced himself, but even in the middle of the emergency he felt strangely self-conscious.

lines.japanese: 「…………ふざけるのも―――」
lines.english: “............Enough screwing arou—”

lines.japanese:
「うぉほほほほほほほほほほ！
　弾入ってねーんですよ！」
lines.english: “Ohohohohohohohoho! There aren't any bullets in it!”

lines.japanese:
「つうかね、なんか今日は猛烈卑劣に闇討ちしたい
　気分でござって、銃装備さしてくれって言ったら、
　ヒヒヒヒヒ……モデルガンかよ！」
lines.english: “See, I was in the mood for a really vicious, underhanded ambush today, so I asked them to give me a gun, and heeheeheehee... they give me a model gun!”

lines.japanese:
「玩具支給かよ！　つうかこれ誰の私物なんだよ！
　くっだらねー！」
lines.english: “They issued me a toy?! Whose personal junk is this, anyway?! What a load of crap!”

lines.japanese:
地面に叩きつけた。
　軽い音から、確かにそれが模型銃の類と理解できた。
lines.english: She slammed it against the ground. The light clatter confirmed that it was indeed some kind of replica gun.

lines.japanese: 「ぷんぷんだ！」
lines.english: “I'm so mad!”

lines.japanese:
「……あ、ごめんね。
　今日はちょっと脳がぐるんぐるんでさ」
lines.english: “...Oh, sorry. My brain's doing loop-de-loops today.”

lines.japanese: 「薬物を使っているんだろう、狂人？」
lines.english: “You're on drugs, aren't you, you lunatic?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、わかるー？」
lines.english: “Oh, you can tell?”

lines.japanese: 「めろめろですにゃー」
lines.english: “I'm all melty-welty, meow.”

lines.japanese: 「アハハハハハハハハハハハ」
lines.english: “Ahahahahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「……ひとりだってのは？」
lines.english: “...And you really came alone?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、つるむのキラーイ」
lines.english: “Mm. I hate hanging around in packs.”

lines.japanese: 真実なのだろうな、と思った。
lines.english: That, Shinobu thought, was probably the truth.

lines.japanese:
「あとはこの話、ちょっと興味あったしね。みんな
　の目的はあっちの女の子なんだろうけど……あた
　しはこっちのがいいし」
lines.english: “And I was kind of interested in this whole business. Everyone else is probably after that girl over there... but personally, I like this one better.”

lines.japanese: ニタリと笑う。
lines.english: She flashed a broad grin.

lines.japanese: 「あたしは、こっちのがいいんだ」
lines.english: “I like this one better.”

lines.japanese:
前のめる。
　倒れるのではないかと思わせたが。
lines.english: She pitched forward. For an instant, it looked as though she might simply fall.

lines.japanese:
「年頃のぉ、
　女の子だからさぁッッッ！！」
lines.english: “Because I'm a girl of a certain aaaaage!”

lines.japanese: 駆けた。早い。
lines.english: She charged. Fast.

lines.japanese: 「せーっきーんせーんだーーーーーっ！！」
lines.english: “CLOSE-QUARTERS COMBAAAAAAT!”

lines.japanese: 獣の駆動で、少女は身を低めた。
lines.english: Moving like an animal, the girl dropped low.

lines.japanese:
脳天気な口ぶりからは裏腹に、低く低く、地を舐
めるようなタックル。
lines.english: Belying that carefree shout, she came in low—lower still—with a tackle that seemed to skim the ground.

lines.japanese:
呼吸を吐いた瞬間に突っかけられていたら、恐ら
く間に合わなかったと思える。
lines.english: Had she launched herself the instant Shinobu exhaled, he probably would not have reacted in time.

lines.japanese:
そういう領域の体術だ。
　まともに食らう。
　咄嗟に下肢を落として、重心を下げた。
lines.english: That was the level of her technique. The tackle hit him squarely. On instinct, Shinobu dropped his hips and lowered his center of gravity.

lines.japanese: かろうじてこらえる。
lines.english: He barely held his ground.

lines.japanese: 「ぐぬぬぬぬぬぬ～～～！」
lines.english: “Nnnnnngggghhh!”

lines.japanese:
女性とは思えないずっしりと骨格の重みを乗せた
タックルに、忍は内心たじろぐ。
lines.english: The tackle came with the solid weight of a frame he could hardly believe belonged to a woman. Shinobu flinched inwardly.

lines.japanese:
瞬時に思考を切り替えた。
　戦力的には、同格の男と思った方がいい。
　抱え込んだ肩が背が、思いの外広い。
lines.english: He revised his assessment in an instant. In raw combat terms, he was better off treating this opponent as a man with strength to match his own. The shoulders and back locked in his grasp were unexpectedly broad.

lines.japanese:
細いように見えて、大作りの体格だ。
　そして脂肪の下には、指触りを阻む筋肉の感触。
lines.english: She looked slender, but she had a large frame. Beneath the fat, his fingers met unyielding muscle.

lines.japanese: （この相手に正面は……厄介だな……！）
lines.english: (Taking her head-on... is going to be trouble...!)

lines.japanese:
相手はいつでも仲間を呼べる。
　いや、さっきの叫びが届いていれば、すでに。
　その上で、この膂力を捌かねばならない―――
lines.english: His opponent could call for backup at any time. No—if that earlier scream had carried, it might already be on its way. And on top of that, Shinobu had to contend with this brute strength—

lines.japanese:
「くらあ！
　真面目にやれぇぇぇぇぇぇ！」
lines.english: “Hey! Take me seeeeriously!”

lines.japanese:
思考も千々に飛ぶ。
　ジーンと名乗った少女は、忍の片腿を抱えていた。
lines.english: His thoughts scattered in every direction. The girl who had called herself Gene had wrapped her arms around one of Shinobu's thighs.

lines.japanese:
マウントを取られたら終わる。
　本能的な恐怖が、忍の身を可動させた。
lines.english: If Gene got the mount, it was over. Instinctive terror drove Shinobu's body into motion.

lines.japanese:
相手の背中に肩を乗せるように、体重をかけていく。
手は腹部に巻き付けてロックしてしまう。
lines.english: He bore down with his weight, laying a shoulder across Gene's back. He locked his hands around her midsection.

lines.japanese:
これで自分だけが横倒しになることはない。
　潰せばこちら、押し切られれば向こう。
　背中を潰す。
lines.english: That kept Shinobu from being the only one dragged sideways. If he crushed her down, he won; if she drove through him, she did. He bore down on her back.

lines.japanese:
押し引きの機微が、時に体重以上の加重をその背
に強いた。
lines.english: The subtle shifts between pushing and pulling sometimes brought far more than Shinobu's body weight to bear on her back.

lines.japanese: 「う……なんじゃ、そら……」
lines.english: “Ugh... wh-what the hell is this...?”

lines.japanese:
忍も力だけは負けていない。
　いや、正確には体術でも数段上を行っているだろう。
lines.english: In raw strength alone, Shinobu was her equal. In technique, in fact, he was likely several levels above Gene.

lines.japanese:
ジーンが唯一忍を凌駕するのは、その瞬発力のみ
だった。
lines.english: The only thing Gene had over Shinobu was her explosive speed.

lines.japanese:
獣を思わせる力だが、最初のタックルを止めた時
点で、忍が優位を確保していたのだ。
lines.english: It was an animal kind of power, but the moment Shinobu stopped that first tackle, he had secured the advantage.

lines.japanese:
本来なら、これに怪力を合わせて押し潰すのが彼
女の勝ちパターンなのだろうが……。
lines.english: Gene's usual winning pattern was probably to add her monstrous strength to that momentum and simply crush her opponent, but...

lines.japanese: 五度目の押しつけ。
lines.english: He bore down a fifth time.

lines.japanese: 「い！？　いーっ！？」
lines.english: “Eek?! Eeeee?!”

lines.japanese:
真上からかかる猛烈な負荷に、ジーンの上肢が膝
より下にずれた。
lines.english: Under the tremendous load bearing straight down, Gene’s arms slipped below Shinobu’s knee.

lines.japanese: （……終わりだな）
lines.english: (...It's over.)

lines.japanese: 少し危険だが、脊髄に打撃を加えることにする。
lines.english: It was a little dangerous, but Shinobu decided to strike the spine.

lines.japanese:
たとえ死んでも構わない。
　少なくとも、そんな覚悟はとっくの昔にすませて
あるのだ。
lines.english: If Gene died, so be it. Shinobu had steeled himself for at least that much a very long time ago.

lines.japanese:
二本の指を突出させた鋭利な拳を振り上げた矢先、
　危険信号が、全身を走り抜けた。
lines.english: Just as he raised a knife-edged fist with two fingers extended, a warning signal raced through his entire body.

lines.japanese:
いかなる勘定によるものか、肉体は少女ジーンか
らの離脱を要求。
lines.english: By whatever calculation it had made, his body demanded that he disengage from the girl named Gene.

lines.japanese: 忍も逆らわず、後方に飛びすさる。
lines.english: Shinobu obeyed and sprang backward.

lines.japanese:
チリ、とした痛みだか熱だか判別できないものが、
大腿の裏に穿たれていた。
lines.english: A tiny sting—pain or heat, he could not tell—had pierced the back of his thigh.

lines.japanese: ジーンがしがみついていた箇所だ。
lines.english: Exactly where Gene had been clinging.
(...A weapon?)

lines.japanese:
両手に隠し持つ何か。
　針……ではないだろう。
lines.english: Something concealed in both hands. Needles...? Probably not.

lines.japanese:
この感じからすれば、ペンチのようなもので肉を
剥いだか、かぎ爪を打ち込んだか……大方そのあた
りであろうと予想できた。
lines.english: Judging from the sensation, she had either torn away flesh with something like pliers or sunk claws into him... Most likely something along those lines.

lines.japanese: 「鋭いねー」
lines.english: “Sharp instincts.”

lines.japanese:
忍が飛び退いたことで、ジーンは地面に突っ伏し
ていた。
lines.english: When Shinobu sprang away, Gene lay facedown on the ground.

lines.japanese:
のんびりとした動作で身を立てる。
　隙だらけの動作だが、攻撃する気にはなれなかった。
lines.english: She rose to her feet with leisurely movements. She left herself wide open, but Shinobu had no desire to attack.

lines.japanese:
そもそも先の危険信号は、彼女が生身以上の殺傷
力を行使しようとしていたことによる。
lines.english: The warning had come because Gene was about to use a killing force no unarmed human body should possess.

lines.japanese:
もしあのまま組んでいたなら、動脈あたりを抉ら
れて大量に出血することになったろう。
lines.english: Had Shinobu remained locked with her, Gene would likely have gouged into an artery and left him bleeding profusely.

lines.japanese:
幸い、怪我はかすり傷のようだった。
　目を凝らす。
lines.english: Fortunately, the injury seemed no worse than a scratch. Shinobu narrowed his eyes.

lines.japanese:
彼女は両手に、何一つ持っていない。
　指輪のひとつもしていない……無腰だ。
lines.english: Gene held absolutely nothing in either hand. She was not even wearing a ring... She was unarmed.

lines.japanese:
「厄介な場所だなぁ、電波通じないんだもんな、こ
　こ」
lines.english: “This place is such a pain. Can't get a signal anywhere out here.”

lines.japanese:
世間話の調子で話すジーンと、油断なく張りつめ
る忍。
lines.english: Gene chatted as casually as if making small talk; Shinobu remained taut and vigilant.

lines.japanese: 両者の温度差が、境界線を作っている。
lines.english: The gulf between their moods drew a line between them.

lines.japanese:
「無線が駄目なら、有線しかないと思ったんだけ
　ど……」
lines.english: “So if wireless was out, I figured I'd have to go with a wired connection...”

lines.japanese:
自らの五指を見つめ、動作に異常がないか確かめ
るようわきわきと動かす。
lines.english: She stared at her five fingers, wiggling them experimentally as though checking them for anything unusual.

lines.japanese:
無線とは遠距離攻撃、有線とは直接的な攻撃を意
味しているのだろう。
lines.english: By wireless, she presumably meant a long-range attack; by wired, an attack involving direct contact.

lines.japanese: 独特な言葉遣いだ。
lines.english: It was a peculiar turn of phrase.

lines.japanese:
「有線だと相手にも気取られちゃうんだな、そりゃ
　そうか」
lines.english: “But with a wired connection, the other person notices, huh? Well, I guess they would.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなると普通に殴り勝たないと駄目だ」
lines.english: “Then I guess I'll just have to beat you by punching you.”

lines.japanese: （まさかとは思うけど……今のは握力か？）
lines.english: (Surely not... Was that nothing but grip strength?)

lines.japanese:
（レスリングで相手を押し倒し、できなければしが
　みついてはむしり取る……厄介だな）
lines.english: (She wrestles her opponent down, and if that fails, she clings on and tears chunks out of them... What a nuisance.)

lines.japanese:
組み討ちは危険だが、離れて倒すのも難しい。
　それこそ先ほどの彼女ではないが、拳銃の一丁も
欲しくなる。
lines.english: Grappling with her was dangerous, but bringing her down from a distance would be difficult. Like Gene a moment ago, Shinobu found himself wishing he had a handgun.

lines.japanese:
構えを取る。
　打撃に関しては忍は素人で、戦術にさほどの幅も
ない。
lines.english: He took his stance. Shinobu was an amateur when it came to striking and had little variety in his tactics.

lines.japanese: 浅く握った拳を、脇を締めて掲げる。
lines.english: He raised his lightly clenched fists, keeping his elbows tucked in.

lines.japanese: 忍の戦意に、ジーンは瞳を輝かせた。
lines.english: Gene's eyes lit up at Shinobu's willingness to fight.

lines.japanese: （遊びだな、この子は）
lines.english: (This is a game to her.)

lines.japanese: （……子供だ）
lines.english: (...She's a child.)

lines.japanese: （学ばせて、終わらせよう）
lines.english: (I'll teach her a lesson and put an end to this.)

lines.japanese:
すり足で詰めていく。
　が、ジーンは大胆に数歩前に出て、両者の距離を
一気に３メートルほどに縮めた。
lines.english: Shinobu closed in with gliding steps. Gene, however, boldly stepped forward and closed the gap between them to roughly three meters in a single burst.

lines.japanese:
そこから、構える。

はストレートなものを好むのだろう。
lines.english: Only then did she take a stance. It spoiled the charged air before their showdown, but perhaps she simply preferred a straightforward fight.

lines.japanese:
快楽においても。
　中途半端な体勢だ。
lines.english: Even in pleasure. Her stance was half-formed.

lines.japanese:
最善の姿勢を取らないことは、その多くが身体能
力に対する絶対の自信を示す。
lines.english: More often than not, a failure to assume the optimal stance reflected absolute confidence in one's physical abilities.

lines.japanese:
どう挑まれても、なんとかできるという自負。
　また先行きを不透明にすることによる賭博にも似
た混濁。
lines.english: The conviction that she could handle whatever came. And a murky exhilaration, almost like gambling, born from leaving the outcome uncertain.

lines.japanese:
愉悦に染まる顔が、月明かりに冴えて妖しい。

った。
lines.english: Her face, steeped in delight, looked preternatural in the clear moonlight. Shinobu wondered what in the world he was doing.

lines.japanese:
まるで決闘だ。
　現代日本。
　決闘。
lines.english: It was like a duel. Modern-day Japan. A duel.

lines.japanese:
現代日本。
　決闘。
lines.english: Modern-day Japan. A duel.

lines.japanese: おかしくて、
lines.english: The absurdity of it—

lines.japanese: 笑ってしまった。
lines.english: He could not help but laugh.

lines.japanese:
同じ好機を得ても、全身を押し出すレスリングと
末端だけを突き出す打撃では、その価値に雲泥の差

lines.english: The same opening had a vastly different value in wrestling, which drove the whole body forward, and in striking, which committed only one limb.

lines.japanese:
もっとも打撃は必然軽くなりがちで、対して組み
討ちは力任せに押し切れば一方的な蹂躙に至る。
lines.english: Strikes, by their nature, tended to land light. Grappling, by contrast, could become a one-sided mauling if brute force carried the day.

lines.japanese:
タックルは回避しなくてはならないが、逃走する
のでもなければ、思うほど簡単なものではない。
lines.english: The tackle had to be evaded, but unless one meant to flee outright, that was not nearly as simple as it sounded.

lines.japanese:
だから自ら仕掛けた。

　捕まるわけにはいかない。
lines.english: So Shinobu struck first. If Gene threw him against the ground, he would black out. He could not allow her to catch him.

lines.japanese:
慎重にジーンは一歩退いた。

　先ほどより５センチ身を低めて、顎を拳で挟む。
lines.english: Gene cautiously took one step back. She must have sensed something dangerous in Shinobu's intent. She lowered herself another five centimeters and held both fists tight around her chin.

lines.japanese: 不意の打撃への警戒だ。
lines.english: She was guarding against an unexpected blow.

lines.japanese:
（普通……女の子は、殴られること自体を好まない

lines.english: (Normally... I’d think girls wouldn’t want to be hit at all...)

lines.japanese:
（一発二発もらってでも組み付く気まんまんだな……
　なんだこの人……）
lines.english: (She’s fully prepared to eat a punch or two if it lets her clinch... What kind of person is she...?)

lines.japanese: （楽しいのか）
lines.english: (Is she enjoying this?)

lines.japanese:
癪というわけでもないが、相手をすることが馬鹿
らしくなった。
lines.english: It did not exactly gall him, but continuing to indulge her was beginning to feel ridiculous.

lines.japanese: ふと忍は、上空を見上げる。
lines.english: On impulse, Shinobu looked up.
The sky—

lines.japanese:
ジーンが動く空気の流れ。
