lines.japanese: それはとても冷徹なものだった。
lines.english: It was utterly cold and ruthless.

lines.japanese: （ヤメロ―――こんなものは視たくない！！）
lines.english: (STOP—I don't want to see this!!)

lines.japanese:
「穴が……開いていたんだってよ。
　伊月笛子に殺された連中」
lines.english: “Apparently there were holes... in the bodies of the men Fueko Izuki killed.”

lines.japanese:
「全身に穴が、まるでキリでも差し込まれたみたい
　に」
lines.english: “Holes all over their bodies, as if someone had gone at them with an awl.”

lines.japanese:
「数百箇所だ。どうやってやったのか、凶器はなん
　なのか……誰もわからなかった」
lines.english: “Hundreds of them. Nobody knew how she'd done it, or what weapon she'd used... nothing.”

lines.japanese:
「勉強しか取り柄がねぇって吹聴してたような女が
　……体格に勝る男数人を無力化。仮にどんな高度
　な訓練を受けていたとしても、現実味のない話だ」
lines.english: “A girl who went around telling people her only talent was studying... incapacitated several men much bigger than her. Even if she'd had the most advanced training imaginable, it strains belief.”

lines.japanese:
「警察もそう判断した。女の子ができることではな
　いってな」
lines.english: “The police thought so too. They said no girl could have done it.”

lines.japanese:
「無罪放免だよ。五人からの不良が死んでるんだぜ？
　いくら法律が厳しくなったご時世とは言ってもな
　……ぎこちなさすぎる」
lines.english: “They let her walk. Five or more delinquents were dead, you know? Even with the law as strict as it is these days... the whole thing simply didn't add up.”

lines.japanese:
「で、そのあとのことは、おまえはよく知ってるは
　ずだな？」
lines.english: “And you should know perfectly well what happened after that, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そういう人間は長くは保たないもんだ」
lines.english: “People like that don’t tend to last long.”

lines.japanese: 「章二」
lines.english: “Shouji.”

lines.japanese:
「ヘ、恐い顔だ。なら救えたのか？
　おまえは、あいつを」
lines.english: “Heh. Scary face. So could you have saved her? Could you?”

lines.japanese: 咬合が強められた。
lines.english: His jaw clenched tighter.

lines.japanese: 「今おまえはどこにいる。何をしている？」
lines.english: “Where are you now? What are you doing?”

lines.japanese:
「こうやって家の前をうろついて、自分は無力だっ
　て吹聴してまわってるのか？」
lines.english: “Loitering outside her house, parading your helplessness for all the world to see?”

lines.japanese: 「……見つからないんだ。助けるための手が」
lines.english: “...I can't find a way to help her.”

lines.japanese:
「あの時だってそうだった。もっとそばにいてやれ
　れば……笛子を救うことはできた！」
lines.english: “It was the same then. If only I'd stayed closer to her... I could have saved Fueko!”

lines.japanese:
「……だがおまえはそのとき、そばにいることはで
　きなかった」
lines.english: “...But at the time, you couldn't be there for her.”

lines.japanese: 「そして今になって、未練たらしくうろついてる」
lines.english: “And now you're hanging around here, still unable to let go.”

lines.japanese: 「だって……」

「伊月笛子は危険な存在だ、おまえがどう思ったと
　しても、警察が見逃したとしても」
lines.english: “Fueko Izuki is dangerous, whatever you may think, and whether the police let her go or not.”

lines.japanese: 忍は、反論できなかった。
lines.english: Shinobu had no answer.

lines.japanese: 「……仕方ないんだ。どうしようもなかった」
lines.english: “...There was no choice. There was nothing I could do.”

lines.japanese:
「黙って見ていたかったわけじゃない。
　けど……どうしようもなかった」
lines.english: “It's not as if I wanted to watch in silence. But... there was nothing I could do.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだろうよ」
lines.english: “Of course there wasn't.”

lines.japanese: 「なあ忍、いつまで笛子に関わってる気だ？」
lines.english: “Tell me, Shinobu. How long are you planning to stay involved with Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 愕然とした顔を親友に向けた。
lines.english: Shinobu stared at his best friend in shock.

lines.japanese:
「……もう放っておくしかないって、わかってるだ
　ろ、おまえ」
lines.english: “...You know there's nothing left to do but leave her alone, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「……しかしね！」
「しばらく放っておけ、あれはもう駄目だ」
lines.english: “Leave her alone for a while. She's beyond help now.”

lines.japanese: 伊月家の二階を見上げた。
lines.english: He looked up at the second floor of the Izuki house.

lines.japanese: 「壊れてる。笛子は壊れちまった」
lines.english: “She's broken. Fueko is broken.”

lines.japanese: 「何の証拠があって！」
lines.english: “What evidence do you have?!”

lines.japanese:
「……こんな言い方が嫌なら、様子を見ろとでも受
　けとっとけ」
lines.english: “...If you hate hearing it put that way, then take it as me telling you to wait and see.”

lines.japanese:
冷たい言葉とは裏腹に、章二の口調は優しさをは
らんでいる。
lines.english: Despite the cold words, Shouji's voice carried a trace of tenderness.

lines.japanese: 「あずさや沙也加だっている。葉子もだ」
lines.english: “Azusa and Sayaka are still here. So is Youko.”

lines.japanese:
「今は三人の方を気に掛けてやれよ。こんな時じゃ
　ねぇか」
lines.english: “For now, look after those three. This is exactly when they need you, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだろ？」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese: 「章二は何も知らない……」
lines.english: “You don't know anything, Shouji...”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「とにかく、今は……笛子が……」
lines.english: “In any case, right now... Fueko...”

lines.japanese:
「今度こそ失敗したかないって気持ちは、わかるが
　な」
lines.english: “I get it. You don't want to fail again this time.”

lines.japanese:
「……確かにあいつ、笛子は……無理があったな……
　いろいろと葛藤があったんだろうよ」
lines.english: “...Fueko... she'd been carrying too much... She must have been fighting herself over all kinds of things.”

lines.japanese: 「休ませてやれよ」
lines.english: “Let her rest.”

lines.japanese:
「……オレがいなくなったら、おまえがみんなを守
　らないといけないんだぜ？」
lines.english: “...If I'm not around anymore, you're the one who'll have to protect everyone.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: ほんの少し高い位置に浮いている、静かな章二の瞳。
lines.english: Shouji's quiet eyes hovered just above his own.

lines.japanese: 「少し、抜けさせてもらうぜ、オレは」
lines.english: “I'm going to step away for a little while.”
“To do what...?”

lines.japanese: 「また例の犠牲者が出た」
lines.english: “Another victim turned up.”

lines.japanese: と頭に指を突き立て、回転させる。
lines.english: He planted a finger against his head and made a circling motion.
“...One of those?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだ。何の証拠も残さず、頭に風穴あけるやつ
　だ」
lines.english: “Right. The kind that leaves no evidence and blows a hole in the victim's head.”

lines.japanese:
「警察の見解、笑えるぜ。棒を突っ込んでるんだっ
　てよ」
lines.english: “The police theory is a joke. They say somebody rammed a rod into the victim's head.”

lines.japanese:
「そんなんじゃ、仮に圧力がなくとも犯人を挙げる
　ことなんざできやしないさ」
lines.english: “Even without the pressure, they’d never catch the killer with an idea like that.”

lines.japanese: 「なあ、似てると思わないか？」
lines.english: “Don't you think they're similar?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「不自然な脳挫傷をもたらす殺傷法と」
lines.english: “The killing method that causes those unnatural cerebral contusions...”

lines.japanese: 「伊月笛子の殺傷法―――」
lines.english: “And Fueko Izuki's method—”

lines.japanese: 「それがオレの仕事だからな」

lines.japanese: 「……やめるんだ……」
絞り出すような声。

lines.japanese: 「おっと、昔の目だな」

lines.japanese: 「真面目な話だ。やめてくれ」

lines.japanese: 「……死ぬから」

lines.japanese: 「殺しあいをしにいくわけじゃない」

lines.japanese: 「もし……その犯人が……」

lines.japanese:
（笛子だったら？）

lines.japanese:
口には出せない。

lines.japanese: 「オレがトップス、てめぇがバックス」

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: ふっと微笑したかと思うや、

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「それが誰であろうとも、な」

背を向け、歩き出す。

lines.japanese: 「……万が一の時は、あと頼んだ」

lines.japanese: 「章二」
lines.english: “Shouji.”

lines.japanese:

今しがた少女の口から出た言葉を、忍は理解でき

lines.japanese: 「だから……さ……」
lines.english: “Like I said...”

その大きな瞳が今わざわざ捉えねばならない対象

横顔に滲むのは、冷えた失意だ。

lines.japanese: 「……死んだって」

lines.japanese: 一度しゃくりあげた。

lines.japanese: 「嘘だ……だって……」
lines.english: “It's a lie... because...”

lines.japanese:
最後に会ったのは自分だ。

lines.japanese:
アレが、最後の会話だったのだ。

“...Shouji...”

lines.japanese: 骸のない死は簡単には心に届かない。

lines.japanese:
心の防御機能である分厚い層に阻まれ、入り込も
うとしない。

lines.japanese: だがいずれは届く。
lines.english: But sooner or later, it would reach him.

lines.japanese:
ゆっくりとではあるが、一度浸透しはじめた事実

lines.english: Slowly—but once the fact began to seep in, it would find its way through. Inevitably.

lines.japanese:
忍の肌が粟立つ。
　耐えきれない。そう思った。
lines.english: Gooseflesh rose across Shinobu’s skin. He couldn’t bear it. That was what he thought.

lines.japanese: 「……どうして」
「どうして！」
lines.english: “Why?!”

lines.japanese: 「怒鳴らないでよぉ……っ」
lines.english: “Don't yell at me...!”

lines.japanese: 拳で目元をぬぐう。
lines.english: She scrubbed at her eyes with her fists.

lines.japanese:
「うちの学校に、来てたんだって……章二……
　それで……」
lines.english: “They said Shouji came to our school... and then...”

lines.japanese: 「殺されちゃったんだって……言ってた……」
lines.english: “They said... somebody killed him...”

lines.japanese: 「あずさの学校……」
lines.english: “Your school...?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてそんなところに……」
lines.english: “Why would he go there...?”

lines.japanese:
「わからない……

lines.english: “I don't know... Everyone says he was just messing around...”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことあるもんか」
lines.english: “That can't be true.”

lines.japanese: 「章二がそんな遊び方をするもんか……」
lines.english: “Shouji would never fool around like that...”

lines.japanese: 「あたしも、そう思うけど」
lines.english: “I don’t think he would either, but...”

lines.japanese: 「思……けど……ッ」
lines.english: “I don’t th... but...!”

lines.japanese:
そして忍は立ち尽くしてた。

lines.english: And Shinobu stood there, rooted to the spot. There was not a trace of grief in him. Only confusion.

lines.japanese:
見失った自分を取り戻す目処さえつかない。

lines.english: He had no idea how to recover the self he had lost. Azusa's frail voice brushed his ear.

「笛子ちゃんも……章二も……

lines.japanese: 「沙也加ちゃんも……っ！」

lines.japanese:
「……なんでこんなことになってんのか……わかん
　ないよ……」
lines.english: “...I don't understand... why any of this is happening...”

lines.japanese: 「おバカなあたしにはわかんないよっ！」
lines.english: “I'm too dumb to understand any of it!”

lines.japanese: 抱きつかれる。

lines.japanese:
それは感触ではなく、ぶれた視界の片隅に、淡い

lines.japanese:
強く、抱きしめられた。

lines.japanese:
きっとあずさにとって、章二の死は心に届いたあ

しかし忍にとっては、これからの出来事で。

lines.english: But for Shinobu, it was an event still to come. That was why he could not return her embrace now. His emptied heart made a dry sound.

樋口章二に言われた言葉が、脳裏をよぎらないで

lines.english: Shouji Higuchi's words crossed his mind, too.

が、意識はどうしても笛子に向いてしまう。

lines.english: Yet his thoughts kept turning toward Fueko. Now, of all times, they could turn nowhere else. How many days had it been since he last saw her?

lines.japanese:
未だかつて、こんなことはなかったのだ。

lines.english: Nothing like this had ever happened before. They had gotten along well. The friends Shinobu himself had gathered in childhood.

lines.japanese:
最初はぎこちなかったが、

lines.english: It had been awkward at first, but in time it had come to feel natural. He knew there was a certain strain in the relationship.

当初は意識にのぼることもなかった崩壊の日が、

lines.english: The day of collapse, which had not even entered his awareness at first, had somehow become taboo.

lines.japanese:
たったひとりの喪失が、他の五人分にも匹敵する

lines.english: The contradiction: losing just one of them would equal losing all five of the others combined.

lines.japanese:
軽いのはただ自分の命だけであるという本能への

lines.japanese: （……章二が死んだ）

lines.english: (Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died Shouji died—)

lines.japanese: ぶつぶつと呟く忍の姿は、幸い誰にも目撃されない。

lines.english: No one walked the streets in the dead of night. Step by step, Shinobu approached the Izuki residence. To see Fueko.

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「欠けたままに、なってしまう……から……」

lines.japanese:
いつしか鼻歌も止まっている。
　携帯の時計を確かめる。
　まだ七分しか経過していない。
lines.english: At some point, the humming had stopped. He checked the clock on his phone. Only seven minutes had passed.

lines.japanese:
押し潰されそうになった。
　渇きに呻くようにのどが上下する。
　しかし忍は求めるのとは正反対に、吐き出した。
lines.english: He felt on the verge of being crushed. His throat bobbed as though groaning with thirst. But instead of taking in what he craved, Shinobu let something out.

lines.japanese: 「…………何のために……生きてるんだ……………」
lines.english: “............What am I... living for...?”

lines.japanese:
千鳥がいつ帰ってきたのかはわからない。
　ただ階下に降りると、滅多につけられることのな
いテレビの音がして、忍はぎょっとした。
lines.english: Shinobu had no idea when Chidori had come home. All he knew was that when he went downstairs, the television—a set almost never switched on—was playing, and the sound made him jump.

lines.japanese:
千鳥はソファに座って、見るともなしに画面を眺
めていた。
lines.english: Chidori sat on the sofa, looking absently at the screen.

lines.japanese:
目線はぼんやりと彷徨い、焦点を失っている。
　彼女はテレビなど見ていないことがわかる。
lines.english: Her gaze drifted without focus. She was not watching the television at all.

lines.japanese: 「姉さん？」
lines.english: “Sis?”

lines.japanese:
すっくと、立ち上がって首を巡らせた。
　まばたきを忘れたかのような視線で、忍は射竦め
られる。
lines.english: She rose abruptly to her feet and turned her head. Her unblinking gaze pinned Shinobu where he stood.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたんです？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「……こっちに来なさい、忍」
lines.english: “...Come here, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
掠れた声。
　忍は眉を集める。
lines.english: Her voice was hoarse. Shinobu's brows drew together.

lines.japanese:
咎める風でもない。
　怒っているようでもない。
　無感情なのでもない。
lines.english: It was not reproach. Nor anger. Nor an absence of emotion.

lines.japanese: 「……あの、いったい……？」
lines.english: “...Um, what is this about...?”

lines.japanese: 「いけない子ですね」
lines.english: “You have been a bad boy.”

lines.japanese: 千鳥の方が動いた。
lines.english: Chidori moved toward him.

lines.japanese:
ソファに突き飛ばされて、低く呻く。
　いつもの千鳥からは考えられない、強引な触れ方
だった。
lines.english: She shoved him down onto the sofa, drawing a low groan from him. It was a forcefulness he could never have imagined from the Chidori he knew.

lines.japanese:
おおよそ思い返す限り、忍は体罰を受けたことは
ない。
lines.english: As far back as he could remember, Shinobu had never been subjected to corporal punishment.

lines.japanese: しかしこの仕打ちは、体罰とも違う。
lines.english: Yet this was something other than corporal punishment.

lines.japanese: 「誰と仲良くしていたんですか？」
lines.english: “Who have you been making friends with?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたは一人でいたら、もっと自由に振る舞えた
　のでしょうね」
lines.english: “Had you remained alone, I suppose you could have conducted yourself with greater freedom.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 平手打ちが、頬を打った。
lines.english: The slap landed across his cheek.

lines.japanese: 忍は一瞬、自分がされたことを理解できなかった。
lines.english: For an instant, Shinobu could not understand what she had done to him.

lines.japanese: 「……な、姉さん……千鳥、さん？」
lines.english: “...S-Sis... Chidori?”

lines.japanese: 「隠し事をするから」
lines.english: “Because you keep secrets.”

lines.japanese: 「隠し事って……僕は……」
lines.english: “Secrets...? I...”

lines.japanese: 「一人ぼっちで寂しそうだったんですよ、あなたは」
lines.english: “You used to look so lonely, all by yourself.”

lines.japanese: 過去のことだ、と瞬時に悟った。
lines.english: He understood at once that she was speaking of the past.

lines.japanese:
「いつも一人だったんです。誰にも心を開かなかっ
　た。私にも」
lines.english: “You were always alone. You opened your heart to no one. Not even to me.”

lines.japanese:
「私はあなたに自由をあげた……でもそれは、ただ
　れた生活を送らせるためではありませんよ」
lines.english: “I gave you freedom... but not so that you could live a life of depravity.”

lines.japanese: 「全員、手なずけるだなんて」
lines.english: “To think you tamed every one of them.”

lines.japanese:
いつもと変わりない千鳥の口調に、見下す抑揚を
かすかに感じ取った。
lines.english: In her otherwise familiar tone, he caught the faintest note of contempt.

lines.japanese:
「僕は……あなたに言われた通り、自分のことを自
　分でしただけです！」
lines.english: “I... only took care of my own affairs, exactly as you told me to do!”

lines.japanese:
「ただれたなんて言われるようなことは、していま
　せん！」
lines.english: “I've done nothing you could call depraved!”

lines.japanese: 「……本当にそう言い切れますか？」
lines.english: “...Can you truly say that?”

lines.japanese: 「何一つ逆らってはいない！」
lines.english: “I haven't disobeyed you once!”

lines.japanese: 「もう一度訊きます」
lines.english: “I will ask you once more.”

lines.japanese: 「本当に、そうですか？」
lines.english: “Is that truly so?”

lines.japanese: 見下す千鳥から、冷気が降りてきた。
lines.english: A chill descended from Chidori as she looked down on him.

lines.japanese: 「……やりようというものがあるでしょうに」
lines.english: “...There are proper ways to go about these things.”

lines.japanese:
手が伸びてきた。
　家族に触れる仕草ではない、モノを扱う手つき。
lines.english: A hand reached toward him. Not the touch of one family member to another, but the handling of an object.

lines.japanese: 思い出すのは、幼い頃、施設で過ごした日々だ。
lines.english: He remembered the days he had spent in an institution as a child.

lines.japanese:
苦痛を苦痛とも理解できない頃の、もやのような
不快感。
lines.english: The mistlike discomfort of a time when he could not understand pain even as pain.

lines.japanese: 灰色に染められた毎日が、淡々と過ぎていった。
lines.english: Gray day followed gray day, passing without distinction.

lines.japanese:
忍の人格など、あって無きに等しい無価値なもの
だった。
lines.english: Shinobu's personality had been worthless, as good as nonexistent.

lines.japanese: 「うわ……あ、あ……っ」

「あなたがこしらえた付け焼き刃の自意識は、その
　方法では何一つ満たされることはないんです」
lines.english: “That makeshift self-awareness you cobbled together can never find satisfaction that way.”

lines.japanese:
「大切なものを、いくつか積み重ね損ねているんで
　すから」
lines.english: “Because you failed to build up several of the things that matter most.”

lines.japanese: 侮るように頭を撫でた。
lines.english: She stroked his head condescendingly.
“............Things that matter...”

lines.japanese:
「ええ、そうです。普通の人が、半生をかけて獲得
　するのが情緒というものでしょう」
lines.english: “Yes. Ordinary people spend half a lifetime acquiring what we call emotional maturity.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたはもっとも学習能力の高い時期を、失って
　いる。幼い頃の空白期間は、致命的なものですよ、
　忍」
lines.english: “You lost the years when your capacity to learn was at its height. That blank span in your childhood was fatal, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「言語回路は発達し損ねた場合、後年にはほとんど
　発現することはないんです。心も、一緒です」
lines.english: “If the circuits of language fail to develop, they almost never emerge later in life. The heart is no different.”

lines.japanese:
「……なら……
　僕はどうしたら……良かったんです？」
lines.english: “...Then... what was I supposed... to do?”

lines.japanese: 「好きにすれば良かったんです」
lines.english: “You should simply have done as you pleased.”

lines.japanese: 「しました！」
lines.english: “I did!”

lines.japanese:
「あなたのソレは、自分で好きになると定めただけ
　でしょう？」
lines.english: “You merely decided for yourself that you would like them, did you not?”

lines.japanese: 「年月によって情が移るのとは異なります」
lines.english: “It is not the same as affection taking root over the years.”

lines.japanese:
「だったら……あなたは、それを知っていて……僕
　に何をさせたかったんです……今の生活だって、
　あなたが用意したものじゃないですか！」
lines.english: “Then... if you knew that... what did you want me to do? Even the life I have now was arranged by you!”

lines.japanese:
「普通に過ごせば良かったんです。学校に行って、
　本を読み、遊んで、空気を吸って」
lines.english: “All you had to do was live an ordinary life. Go to school, read books, play, breathe the air.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな普通もあったとは思いませんか？」
lines.english: “Do you not think that, too, could have been an ordinary life?”

lines.japanese: 「僕のためだって言うんですか」
lines.english: “You're saying you did it for me?”

lines.japanese: 「事実でしょう」
lines.english: “It is the truth.”

lines.japanese: 「それ以外は許されないと？」
lines.english: “And nothing else was permitted?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたの行動は予想外でしたから。
　手当たり次第手なずけてしまうだなんて」
lines.english: “Your behavior was unexpected. I never imagined you would tame everyone indiscriminately.”

lines.japanese: 「異常者の行いですよ？」
lines.english: “That is the behavior of an aberrant, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「自分で決めるしかなかったんですよ！」
lines.english: “I had no choice but to decide for myself!”

lines.japanese:
「あなたの言う通り、僕は小さい頃を親無しで育っ
　て……だけど自分で選んだわけじゃない！」
lines.english: “Just as you said, I grew up without parents... but I didn't choose that!”

lines.japanese:
「努力でどうにかなったものでもない！
　どうしようもない、終わってしまったことじゃない
　ですか！」
lines.english: “It wasn't something I could fix through effort! It's over and done with—there's nothing anyone can do about it!”

lines.japanese:
「千鳥さんが僕を引き取ったのだって……どうせ……
　実験みたいなものなんだ……」
lines.english: “Even taking me in was probably... nothing more than an experiment to you...”

lines.japanese: 「そうですよ」
lines.english: “That is correct.”

lines.japanese:
「なら、あなたに異常者呼ばわりされるのは、お門
　違いだ！」
lines.english: “Then you've got no business calling me an aberrant!”

lines.japanese:
「事実をそのまま口にしたまでです。誰かに何かを告
　げるための資格など、そもそもありはしませんよ」
lines.english: “I merely stated the facts as they are. One requires no special qualification to tell another person something.”

lines.japanese:
「普通に生きろと、指示をすればあなたはそうした
　んでしょうね」
lines.english: “Had I instructed you to live normally, I imagine you would have done so.”

lines.japanese:
「当時は、わざわざ当たり前のことを言わずとも、
　結果そうなるだろうと思っていました。それがミス
　であるというのなら、そうなのでしょう」
lines.english: “At the time, I believed there was no need to state the obvious, and that such a life would follow naturally. If that belief was mistaken, then I suppose it was.”

lines.japanese:
「ですが忍、あなたが取った選択が、誰にとっても
　マイナスにしかならないものであることは……よ
　く理解しているでしょう？」
lines.english: “But Shinobu, you understand perfectly well that the choice you made can only bring harm to everyone... do you not?”

lines.japanese: 「裏切りですよ」
lines.english: “It is a betrayal.”

lines.japanese: 「……僕が、裏切り？」
lines.english: “...Betrayal? Me?”

lines.japanese:
「お友達グループを作った。
　そこまではいいでしょう」
lines.english: “You formed a little circle of friends. There is nothing wrong with that much.”

lines.japanese: 「で、それからどうするつもりだったんです？」
lines.english: “And what did you intend to do after that?”

lines.japanese:
「……滞りなく、毎日を生きるだけでしょう。
　それが適わなくなる時まで」
lines.english: “...Simply live each day without incident. Until that was no longer possible.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘ですよね？」
lines.english: “That is a lie, is it not?”

lines.japanese: 「本当です」
lines.english: “It's the truth.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘ですよ」
lines.english: “It is a lie.”

lines.japanese: 「本当です！」
lines.english: “It's the truth!”

lines.japanese:
「可愛らしい嘘だとは思います。
　あなたのそういう浅知恵、好きですよ」
lines.english: “I admit, it is a charming lie. I like that little bit of shallow cunning in you.”

lines.japanese: 「…………好きとか」
声が震えた。
lines.english: His voice trembled.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「好きとか言うなよ！！」
lines.english: “Don't say you like me!!”

lines.japanese:
「それこそ、嘘じゃないか！　よく言う……
　よくそんな見え透いたことを言える……
　あんたにとって僕はただの素材だよ！」
lines.english: “That's the real lie! Listen to you... How can you say something so transparently false? I'm nothing but raw material to you!”

lines.japanese:
「好きだって？　よく言う。そりゃ野性のハイエナ
　だって腐肉が好きだろうさ」
lines.english: “You like me? Spare me. A wild hyena likes carrion too.”

lines.japanese:
「……好きだから飼い殺しするわけ？
　そりゃいいや。皮肉がきいてる」
lines.english: “...So you like me, and that’s why you keep me alive and useless? That’s just great. Nice irony.”

lines.japanese: 「何もできない自由なんて、いらなかった」
lines.english: “I never wanted to be free and unable to do anything.”

lines.japanese:
「苦しいなんて気づかないまま、最後まで塀の中に
　閉じこめてくれれば良かったんだ」
lines.english: “You should have kept me behind those walls until the end, never letting me realize I was suffering.”

lines.japanese:
「……引っ張り出されて、でも何もなくて……自由
　に振る舞ったら、その結果を咎められて……もう
　疲れたよ、千鳥さん」
lines.english: “...You dragged me out, but there was nothing there... Then when I acted freely, you condemned the result... I'm tired, Chidori.”

lines.japanese:
「どうせまともな人生なんて望めないんだ。
　だったら……まともな心なんていらなかった」
lines.english: “A normal life was never possible for me anyway. So... I wish I'd never had a normal heart.”

lines.japanese: 「それが中途半端な心となれば、最悪だ！」
lines.english: “A half-formed heart is the worst thing of all!”

lines.japanese:
呼吸を荒げた。
　全力疾走の直後のように、心臓が早鐘を打っていた。
lines.english: His breathing came ragged. His heart hammered as though he had just run at full speed.

lines.japanese:
運動によらない興奮が、どこか新鮮に思えた。
　叫んだ内容に、どこか矛盾はなかったろうか。
　忍は不安になった。
lines.english: The agitation, though born of no physical exertion, felt strangely new. Had there been some contradiction in what he had shouted? Shinobu grew uneasy.

lines.japanese:
そして矛盾を突かれる恐怖に、心を震わせた。
　いつも考えている。
　隙のない論法をどこかで考えている。
lines.english: His heart trembled at the fear that she would expose a contradiction. He was always thinking. Somewhere within himself, he was always constructing an airtight argument.

lines.japanese:
まとまってから発言する。
　矛盾があれば、原因を究明して正す。
　そこに忍の本音は絡まない。
lines.english: He spoke only after his thoughts were in order. If he found a contradiction, he identified its cause and corrected it. Shinobu's true feelings played no part.

lines.japanese:
目的と結果と整合性だけが全てだった。
　だからこその本音だということに、忍は気づかない。
lines.english: Purpose, result, and consistency were all that mattered. Shinobu never realized that this, precisely, was what he truly felt.

lines.japanese:
誰かに叱責されてはじめて、人は羞恥するものだ
と、理解できない。
lines.english: He could not grasp that people often felt shame only after someone else reproached them.

lines.japanese:
欠損が絶対である場合、後天的努力では補えない
ことがある。
lines.english: When something was wholly absent, there were times no later effort could make up for it.

lines.japanese:
世界は報われない可能性を、肯定している。
　そのことを忍はよく知っていたはずなのに、やは
り踏み込まれれば、時に惑うのである。
lines.english: The world allowed for the possibility that effort might never be rewarded. Shinobu should have known that well, yet when someone trespassed on that ground, he could still lose his bearings.

lines.japanese: 「言いたいことはそれで全てですか？」
lines.english: “Is that everything you wished to say?”

lines.japanese:
全力の言葉をぶつけても、千鳥は皆目動揺を示さ
ない。
lines.english: Even after he hurled every word he had, Chidori showed not the slightest sign of being shaken.

lines.japanese: 「……あなたは……姉でさえなかった」
lines.english: “...You... were never even my sister.”

lines.japanese: 「義理の関係でしたね」
lines.english: “We were never related by blood.”

lines.japanese:
「……姉を演じる気さえなかったと言ったん
　です……」
lines.english: “...I said you never even meant to act like a sister...”

lines.japanese: 弱々しい言葉が、しかし千鳥を打った。
lines.english: The feeble words nevertheless struck Chidori.

lines.japanese: 「どういう……意味です？」
lines.english: “What... do you mean?”

lines.japanese:
「この家で、あなたがしたことは……寝て起きて、
　シャワーを浴びて、着替えて……男と寝ることだ
　けだった」
lines.english: “In this house, all you ever did was... sleep and wake up, take showers and change clothes... and sleep with men.”

lines.japanese:
「ここは僕らにとって、かりそめの聖域にもなりは
　しないんですよ」
lines.english: “This place could never be even a temporary sanctuary for us.”

lines.japanese: 「ただの通路だ」
lines.english: “It's nothing but a passageway.”

lines.japanese: 「見たんですか？」
lines.english: “Did you see?”

lines.japanese:
「人の浅知恵を笑っておいて、自分のことには鈍感
　なんですか」
lines.english: “You laughed at my shallow cunning, yet you're blind when it comes to yourself?”

lines.japanese:
「……そう、形跡が残っていた……かも知れません
　ね」
lines.english: “...I see. Perhaps we did leave some trace behind.”

lines.japanese:
肌に刻まれた痕、匂い、体毛、空気の濁り、布の
乱れ。
lines.english: Marks left on skin, scents, body hair, murk in the air, rumpled cloth.

lines.japanese: 情報はありとあらゆる場所に刻まれる。
lines.english: Information leaves its imprint everywhere.

lines.japanese:
「僕が誰と寝たって、関係ないでしょう……
　何人とだって……」
lines.english: “Who I sleep with is none of your concern... no matter how many people I sleep with...”

lines.japanese: 「やはり私たちは、うまくないですね」
lines.english: “We truly are not very good at this, are we?”

lines.japanese:
「……噛み合うはずもないんですよ……
　最初から……」
lines.english: “...We were never going to fit together... not from the start...”

lines.japanese: 「それならそれで、やり方を変えるまでです」
lines.english: “Then I shall simply change my approach.”

lines.japanese: 忍の股間に膝を立てた。
lines.english: She planted a knee between Shinobu's legs.
“What are you...?”

lines.japanese: 「じっとしていなさい」
lines.english: “Hold still.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待っ―――」
lines.english: “Wait—”

lines.japanese: 容赦のない一撃が、忍をまたも打擲した。
lines.english: Another merciless blow struck Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 二度、三度、と、叩く。
lines.english: She struck him a second time. A third.

lines.japanese:
千鳥は無表情だ。
　憤りではない、もっと冷たい感情に突き動かされ
ている。
lines.english: Chidori's face was blank. It was not outrage that drove her, but something far colder.

lines.japanese:
顔を覆った忍の腕の上から、殴打に近い打撃を加
える。
lines.english: She rained blows on the arms Shinobu had thrown over his face, each one little short of a punch.

lines.japanese: 「……動かないように」
lines.english: “...Do not move.”

lines.japanese:
肉体の苦痛より、衝撃の方が大きい。
　千鳥は力づくでコトに及ぼうとしている。
lines.english: The shock was greater than the physical pain. Chidori intended to force him into the act.

lines.japanese: 信じがたく、そしてまた信じたくはない事実だった。
lines.english: He could hardly believe it—and did not want to.

lines.japanese:
一線を越えたら、本格的に貴宮家は空洞化するは
ずだ。
lines.english: Once they crossed that line, the Atemiya household would begin hollowing out in earnest.

lines.japanese:
最初からそうだったのだ、と思い直せば、全てが
虚しくなっていった。
lines.english: When he reminded himself that it had been hollow from the start, everything began to feel futile.

lines.japanese: 「いい子に」
lines.english: “Be good.”

lines.japanese:
逆らう気はもうなくなっていた。
　下半身だけ脱がされていく。
lines.english: He no longer had the will to resist. Only his lower half was undressed.

lines.japanese:
そして忍を前に、自分も事務的にスカートを落と
し、下着を下げた。
lines.english: Then, before Shinobu, she matter-of-factly let her skirt fall and lowered her underwear.

lines.japanese:
腕の隙間から、千鳥の局部が嘘のように湿ってい
るのがわかった。
lines.english: Through the gap between his arms, he saw that Chidori was wet beyond belief.

lines.japanese:
