lines.japanese: 笛子の顔には微笑が浮かぶ。
lines.english: A smile rested on Fueko's face.

lines.japanese:
決定的な状況に慢心する者の顔、であるかのよう
に見える。
lines.english: It looked like the face of someone grown complacent in the certainty of her position.

lines.japanese:
よくよく観察すれば、まったく異なる相を読み取
ることができた。
lines.english: But a closer look revealed something else entirely.

lines.japanese:
嘲笑の形ばかりを残した抜け殻。
　魂の欠け落ちた虚穴の如きかたち。
lines.english: An empty shell retaining only the shape of a sneer. A hollow form from which the soul had fallen away.

lines.japanese:
白露が消えるほどに儚く砕けた、力ない表情であ
った。
lines.english: A feeble expression, shattered and fleeting as vanishing dew.

lines.japanese:
背後に立つ伊勢崎宗多の、生命力と憎悪に溢れた
笑みと比べれば、歴然としている。
lines.english: The contrast with Souta Isezaki's smile behind her—brimming with vitality and hatred—was unmistakable.

lines.japanese:
誰も一言さえも漏らさぬ状況を、やがて笛子が崩
した。
lines.english: At last, Fueko broke the wordless silence.

lines.japanese: 「罠かも知れないって思わなかったの？」
lines.english: “Didn't you think it might be a trap?”

lines.japanese: 「相変わらず、忍ってバカ」
lines.english: “You're as stupid as ever, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「甘いから、つけ込まれる」
lines.english: “You're soft, so people take advantage of you.”

lines.japanese: 「甘いから、守れないのよ」
lines.english: “You're soft, so you can't protect anyone.”

lines.japanese:
両手におさまりきらぬ無骨な漆黒は、もちろん忍
に向けられている。
lines.english: The crude black object, too unwieldy to fit in both her hands, was of course trained on Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
射撃もままならない女性持ちだが、銃口だけは妙
に的確に照準されている。
lines.english: She could scarcely handle it well enough to shoot, yet the muzzle was trained on him with uncanny precision.

lines.japanese: 撃てば、反動で姿勢は崩れるが命中するだろう。
lines.english: The recoil would ruin her stance, but the shot would strike home.

lines.japanese:
宗多は何も言わない。
　黙って立っている。
　言葉に頼る必要のない、完全な勝利の証として。
lines.english: Souta said nothing. He merely stood there in silence—proof of a victory so complete it had no need of words.

lines.japanese: 迷って、迷って、そして口をついて出た平凡な疑問。
lines.english: He hesitated and hesitated, until at last an ordinary question slipped out.

lines.japanese: 「……どうして？」
「私ね、スパイだったの」
lines.english: “I was a spy.”

lines.japanese:
簡潔な言葉だ。
　なのに理解しにくい。
lines.english: The words were simple. Even so, he could not make sense of them.

lines.japanese: 「スパイって」
lines.english: “A spy...?”

lines.japanese:
「……ずっと昔から、あなたに会う前から……
　スパイだったの」
lines.english: “...For a long time. Since before I ever met you... I'd been a spy.”

lines.japanese: 「会う前からだって？」
lines.english: “Since before we met?”

lines.japanese: 「そうよ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたにお仲間に誘われたのは偶然だったけれど」
lines.english: “It was only chance that you invited me into your group.”

lines.japanese:
「……バカね。敵を誘い込むなんて。
　ずっと気づきもしないなんて」
lines.english: “...You idiot. Inviting the enemy right in. Never noticing all this time.”

lines.japanese: 「宗ちゃんとは」
lines.english: “Sou and I...”

lines.japanese: 言葉だけで宗多を示す。
lines.english: She indicated Souta with words alone.

lines.japanese: 「あなたより長いつきあいだから」
lines.english: “I've known him longer than I've known you.”

lines.japanese:
妙な緊張で喉がひりついた。
　唾を飲むと痛みが走る。
　体調が変化し、胃が不気味に蠕動した。
lines.english: A strange tension left his throat raw. Pain shot through it when he swallowed. His body reacted; his stomach churned ominously.

lines.japanese: 「忍のことは、忍たちのことは……嫌いじゃない」
lines.english: “I don't dislike you, Shinobu. I don't dislike any of you...”

lines.japanese: 「けど好きな人には逆らえない女だから、私」
lines.english: “But I'm the kind of woman who can't defy the man she loves.”

lines.japanese:
「言ったでしょ？　尽くすタイプだって。
　こういうことなの」
lines.english: “I told you, didn't I? I'm the devoted type. This is what I meant.”

lines.japanese: 「それで笛子に、見返りはあるの？」
lines.english: “And what do you get out of it?”

lines.japanese: 「いらないのよ」
lines.english: “I don't need anything.”

lines.japanese: 聡明なはずの少女は、鼻で笑う。
lines.english: The girl who was supposed to be so clever gave a derisive snort.

lines.japanese: 「打算じゃないから」
lines.english: “This isn't about what I get out of it.”

lines.japanese:
決定的だな、と告げていた。
　心の一部が告げていた。
　完全な意志に、忍の食い込む余地など一片もない。
lines.english: This is final, something told him. Some part of his heart told him so. Her will was absolute, without the slightest opening for Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
最初から笛子の心は、別の男を捉えていた。
　上書きができる可能性などなかったのだ。
lines.english: Fueko's heart had belonged to another man from the very beginning. There had never been any chance of overwriting that.

lines.japanese:
「……時間をかければ、振り向かせられるって、思
　ってたのにな」
lines.english: “...I thought if I gave it enough time, I could win you over.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなわけじゃない」
lines.english: “It doesn't work that way.”

lines.japanese:
ことさら冷たく突き放す。
　呆れた口調は失笑によるものか、抑揚をつけて鞭
のように忍を打つ。
lines.english: She rejected him with deliberate coldness. Perhaps her exasperated tone held a stifled laugh; either way, its every rise and fall lashed Shinobu like a whip.

lines.japanese:
そればかりか無力感にも打ちひしがれ、顔を地面
に向ける。
lines.english: Worse, helplessness crushed him, and he bowed his head toward the ground.

lines.japanese:
「いろいろと、良くしてもらったのにごめんね。け
　ど心をいためるなんて偽善的だとあなたも思うで
　しょう？」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, after everything you've done for me. But you'd call it hypocritical for me to agonize over this, wouldn't you?”

lines.japanese: 淀みなく笛子は告げる。
lines.english: Fueko spoke without a hitch.

lines.japanese: 「だから私、精一杯あなたの敵になるから」
lines.english: “So I'll be your enemy with everything I have.”

lines.japanese: 「ちゃんと敵になるから」
lines.english: “I'll be a proper enemy to you.”

lines.japanese:
「中途半端のない、ちゃんとした敵になるから。好
　きになったりしないから。だから」
lines.english: “A proper enemy, without any half measures. I won't fall in love with you. So...”

lines.japanese: 「……ちゃんと、恨みなさいよ？」
lines.english: “...Make sure you hate me, all right?”

lines.japanese:
「そうでないとあなたは、私にただ殺されるだけに
　なってしまうから」
lines.english: “Otherwise, you'll simply end up being killed by me.”

lines.japanese:
「丸腰で呼び出して悪いけど……彼が、あなたに生
　きていてもらいたくないって言うの」
lines.english: “I'm sorry I called you out here unarmed... but he says he doesn't want you to go on living.”

lines.japanese:
軍事の基本として、決して忍から目線をそらそう
としない。
lines.english: Mindful of the fundamentals of combat, she never once took her eyes off Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 宗多は変わらぬ喜悦に、目を輝かせている。
lines.english: Souta's eyes shone with the same unwavering delight.

lines.japanese:
この気の利いたドラマが、ご機嫌な結末に終わる
瞬間を、今か今かと待っている。
lines.english: He waited impatiently for this clever little drama to reach its delightful conclusion.

lines.japanese: 「……こんな時に、さ」
lines.english: “...At a time like this...”

lines.japanese: つい、恨みがましい言葉が漏れた。
lines.english: The resentful words escaped him.

lines.japanese: 「こんな時だからでしょう？」
lines.english: “Because it's a time like this, don't you think?”

lines.japanese:
「こんな、当たり前に人が死ぬ時代だから……
　だから乗じて、でしょう？」
lines.english: “Because we live in a time when people die as a matter of course... That's why we're taking advantage of it, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだろうけど」
lines.english: “I suppose that's true, but...”

lines.japanese: 「……笛子は僕のことを殺せるの？」
lines.english: “...Can you really kill me, Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 「殺せる」
lines.english: “I can.”

lines.japanese: 「殺せないと、役に立ってないと不安なのよ」
lines.english: “If I can't kill you, I'm afraid I'm no use.”

lines.japanese:
「一方的に相手を好きになるってことは、そういう
　ことでもある」
lines.english: “That’s part of what it means to love someone whether they love you back or not.”

lines.japanese:
「見てもらえなくていい。後ろを歩いているだけで
　いい」
lines.english: “I don't need him to look my way. It's enough just to walk behind him.”

lines.japanese:
「……いつ捨てられてもおかしくはないし文句も言
　えない。だから捨てられないように、私自身の有
　用性を示さないといけない」
lines.english: “...He could throw me away at any moment, and I couldn't complain. So I have to prove that I'm useful and keep him from discarding me.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな風にして人を好きになったこと、あなたに
　はないでしょう？」
lines.english: “You've never loved anyone that way, have you?”

lines.japanese:
「……確かに、僕はずるくて小さい人間だから……
　相手の気持ちが気になってしょうがないよ」
lines.english: “...True. I'm selfish and small-minded... I can't help worrying about how the other person feels.”

lines.japanese: 「でもそれは、殺されるほどのこと？」
lines.english: “But is that enough to get me killed?”

lines.japanese: 「勘違いしないで欲しいんだけど」
lines.english: “But there's one thing I don't want you to misunderstand.”

lines.japanese: 「私はあなたが嫌いで殺すわけじゃない」
lines.english: “I'm not killing you because I hate you.”

lines.japanese: 「けっこう、好きよ？　正直なところ……」
lines.english: “I actually like you quite a lot, you know? Honestly...”

lines.japanese:
「でも一番じゃないの。
　だから……こうしてあなたの前に立っているの」
lines.english: “But you aren't the one I love most. That's why... I'm standing here before you now.”

lines.japanese: 「……君を人殺しにするようなヤツに」
lines.english: “...For someone who would turn you into a murderer...”

lines.japanese: 「善悪も、どうでもいいのよ忍」
lines.english: “Good and evil mean nothing to me, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「そのくらい……好きなの。どうにもならない」
lines.english: “That's how much... I love him. I can't do anything about it.”

lines.japanese:
「両親から見捨てられた私にとって、たった一つの
　慰めだった」
lines.english: “When my parents abandoned me, he was the only comfort I had.”

lines.japanese: 「癒されたのよ！」
lines.english: “It was what healed me!”

lines.japanese: 吐き出す言葉が重い。
lines.english: The words she spat out were heavy.

lines.japanese:
「それは全てだった。私はそのために、自分だって
　捨てることができた」
lines.english: “That was everything to me. For its sake, I could even abandon myself.”

lines.japanese:
「バカでしょ？　典型的な愚かな女。だけど……
　仕方ないじゃない。そうなんだから」
lines.english: “Stupid, isn't it? A typical foolish woman. But... it can't be helped. That's simply what I am.”

lines.japanese:
「……バカだって自覚があるから、だから……
　私はもう翻意することなんてできないの」
lines.english: “...I know I'm an idiot. And precisely because I know it... I can't change my mind now.”

lines.japanese:
「そんなことをしたら……私はバカな女でさえもな
　くなって……何者でもなくなる……」
lines.english: “If I did that... I wouldn't even be a foolish woman anymore... I'd be nothing at all...”

lines.japanese: 「……笛子は何かになれたはずだ」
lines.english: “...You could have become someone, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「僕らと時間をかけて生きていけば、きっと」
lines.english: “If you'd stayed with us and given it time, I'm sure you could have.”

lines.japanese:
「……だったら、どうしてもっと早く私の前にあら
　われてくれなかったの？」
lines.english: “...Then why didn't you come into my life sooner?”

lines.japanese:
忍は心の底から慄然とする
　決して覆せない構造を見たがため。
lines.english: Shinobu shuddered to the core. He had glimpsed a structure that could never be overturned.

lines.japanese:
最初の時から、すでに結末は定まっていたと笛子
は言う。
lines.english: Fueko was telling him that the ending had been fixed from the very beginning.

lines.japanese:
もし忍に未来を見通す力があったとしても、不可
避の悲劇である。
lines.english: Even if Shinobu had possessed the power to see the future, this tragedy would have been unavoidable.

lines.japanese:
唯一の選択は、裏切られる日まで良い思い出を貪
り続けるか……あるいは、最初から笛子を仲間に引
き入れないかである。
lines.english: His only choice would have been to gorge himself on happy memories until the day of betrayal... or else never to have brought Fueko into the group at all.

lines.japanese:
しかし忍に予知能力などはない。
　笛子を拾わなければ良かった、などという後悔の
しようもない。
lines.english: But Shinobu possessed no precognition. He could not even regret having picked Fueko up in the first place.

lines.japanese: 歯噛み。
lines.english: His teeth ground together.

lines.japanese: 結局、忍は彼女を振り向かせることができなかった。
lines.english: In the end, Shinobu had failed to win her over.

lines.japanese: その一点に尽きた。
lines.english: Everything came down to that one fact.

lines.japanese: 「……悔しいよ、笛子……」
lines.english: “...I hate that it came to this, Fueko...”

lines.japanese:
宗多がけたたましく笑い出す。
　さぞかし愉快な場面であろう。
lines.english: Souta burst into shrill laughter. What a delightful little scene this must have been.

lines.japanese:
人生を台無しにされた少年にとって、忍の破滅ほ
ど甘美なものはないのだろう。
lines.english: For a boy whose life had been ruined, nothing could have tasted sweeter than Shinobu's destruction.

lines.japanese: 「……ごめんね」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese:
このときばかりは、優しい笑み。
　腕を伸ばす。
　正確な構えで旧友を狙う。
lines.english: Only then did her smile soften. She extended her arms. In a precise shooting stance, she aimed at her old friend.

lines.japanese: 「撃つんだね」
lines.english: “You're going to shoot me.”

lines.japanese: 「撃つわ」
lines.english: “I am.”

lines.japanese: 「殺すんだ」
lines.english: “You're going to kill me.”

lines.japanese: 「殺すの」
lines.english: “I am.”

lines.japanese: 諦念からまぶたを閉じた。
lines.english: Resigned, he closed his eyes.

lines.japanese:
「でも、そうね……あなたが頑張って反撃してもら
　うのは構わないわ」
lines.english: “Still... I don't mind if you do your best to fight back.”

lines.japanese: 宗多の顔に狼狽が浮かぶ。
lines.english: Alarm crossed Souta's face.

lines.japanese:
「いっそ、私のことも殺してくれれば……楽ではあ
　るわね。一番ではないけれど、友達だった人間を
　殺さずに済むのなら」
lines.english: “It might be easier if you killed me too... if it meant I didn't have to kill someone who was once my friend, even if he was never the one I loved most.”

lines.japanese:
「……そんなことはできないよ。
　今殺すくらいなら……僕は……」
lines.english: “...I can't do that. If I were going to kill you now... I...”

lines.japanese:
「そうね、それこそ……あなたにとっては苦しみで
　しょうね」
lines.english: “Yes... for you, of all people, I suppose that would be its own kind of torment.”

lines.japanese:
「本当にバカ……私と同じくらいバカよ。
　優しすぎて……何も奪えないんだから」
lines.english: “You really are an idiot... every bit as stupid as I am. You're too kind... You can't take anything.”

lines.japanese: 「奪ったら、違うものだからね、それは」
lines.english: “Once you take it, it becomes something else.”

lines.japanese:
諦念の兆しを滲ませる声には芯が通り、低いが聞
き取りにくいということもない。
lines.english: Though resignation had begun to seep into his voice, it remained steady. It was low, but perfectly clear.

lines.japanese:
「他人ではなくなる。
　自分の一部になってしまうだろうから」
lines.english: “They stop being someone separate from you. They become part of you.”

lines.japanese: 「それは自己愛だ」
lines.english: “That's self-love.”

lines.japanese: 「……だから誰にも手を出さなかったの？」
lines.english: “...Is that why you never made a move on anyone?”

lines.japanese:
「みんなあなたのことが好きだったのよ。七人をま
　とめたのはあなたで、維持したのもあなたで」
lines.english: “They all liked you. You were the one who brought all seven together, and the one who kept them together.”

lines.japanese: 「頼りないけど、全員のお兄さんみたいだった」
lines.english: “You weren't very dependable, but you were like an older brother to us all.”

lines.japanese:
「そのままが良かった。
　いつかは壊れるとしても……できる限りは」
lines.english: “I wanted it to stay that way. Even if it had to break someday... for as long as possible.”

lines.japanese: 「聖域……章二の言葉だったわね」
lines.english: “A sanctuary... That was Shouji's word, wasn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「聖域を出る時が、私たちの死なのかも知れないわ
　ね」
lines.english: “Perhaps the moment we leave the sanctuary is the moment we die.”

lines.japanese: 「……後悔のはじまりだよ、それは」
lines.english: “...That's when regret begins.”

lines.japanese: 「それがイヤで、僕も君を利用していた気がする」
lines.english: “I couldn't bear that, and I think I used you too.”

lines.japanese: 「利用？」
lines.english: “Using me?”

lines.japanese: 「君という存在には、ずいぶんと助けられたから」
lines.english: “Because having you there helped me so much.”

lines.japanese:
「君のようなタイプが……あの不揃いな連中には必
　要だったから」
lines.english: “Because that motley bunch needed someone like you.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、ごめん。そして、」
lines.english: “So I'm sorry. And...”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうと言うよ」
lines.english: “I want to thank you.”

lines.japanese: 真摯な瞳が笛子を見た。
lines.english: His earnest gaze rested on Fueko.

lines.japanese:
今度は笛子が視線を落とした。
　前髪に隠れる。
lines.english: This time, it was Fueko who dropped her gaze. Her eyes disappeared behind her bangs.

lines.japanese:
「……おい、もういいだろう。客は飽き飽きしてる
　ぜ。早く次の場面を見せろ」
lines.english: “...Hey, that's enough. The audience is bored to tears. Get on with the next scene.”
“...Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、やるといい」
lines.english: “Yeah. Go ahead.”

lines.japanese:
「……また覚悟しなければいけない時が来たんだ、
　きっと」
lines.english: “...I suppose the time has come again for me to steel myself.”

lines.japanese:
トリガーに指がかかる。
　安全装置は外れている。
　弾丸は込められている。
lines.english: Her finger settled on the trigger. The safety was off. The gun was loaded.

lines.japanese:
姿勢がまたいっそう、凛と伸ばされる。
　互いに言葉はない。
lines.english: Her posture grew straighter and more resolute. Neither of them spoke.

lines.japanese: 「バイバイ貴宮」
lines.english: “Bye-bye, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese:
視聴者の言葉は、役者には届かない。
　このときもそうだった。
lines.english: The spectator's words never reached the actors. They did not reach them now.

lines.japanese: 殺意のこもらない銃弾が、忍に二発、打ち込まれた。
lines.english: Two bullets devoid of murderous intent struck Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 一分後、忍の生命活動は停止した。
lines.english: One minute later, Shinobu's vital functions ceased.

lines.japanese:
そしてまた何日かが過ぎた。
　何事もなく通り去った。
　時間は情を解さない。
lines.english: And several more days passed. They went by without anything happening. Time knew no sympathy.

lines.japanese: ただ忘却させるだけである。
lines.english: All it did was make people forget.

lines.japanese: 「……ねえ、誰も口にしないけどさ」
lines.english: “...Hey. Nobody's saying it, but...”

lines.japanese: もっとも素直な少女は、欺瞞を知らない。
lines.english: The most guileless girl of all knew nothing of pretense.

lines.japanese: 「笛子ちゃん……どうしてるんだろうね？」
lines.english: “I wonder... how Fueko's doing.”

lines.japanese: 忍は返答に窮した。
lines.english: Shinobu was at a loss for an answer.

lines.japanese: 「……風邪かな」
lines.english: “...Maybe she has a cold.”

lines.japanese: 「でも連絡くらいあるよねぇ？」
lines.english: “But she'd at least get in touch, wouldn't she?”

lines.japanese: 「うん……心配だね」
lines.english: “Yeah... I'm worried too.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえねえ、お見舞いに行こうよ？」
lines.english: “Hey, hey—let's go visit her.”

lines.japanese: 「行ってるんだけどね」
lines.english: “I’ve been going.”

lines.japanese:
嘘ではない。
　足を運んだ回数だけなら、友人としての義理はと
うに果たされている。
lines.english: That was no lie. If visits alone counted, he had long since discharged every obligation friendship placed on him.

lines.japanese: それだけでは納得できないだけである。
lines.english: It simply was not enough for him.

lines.japanese: 「どうだった？」
lines.english: “How did it go?”

lines.japanese: 「……会えなかった。閉じこもっているみたいで」
lines.english: “...I couldn't see her. She seems to have shut herself away.”

lines.japanese:
「閉じこもるってさ……
　病気か何かじゃないのかな？」
lines.english: “Shut herself away...? Do you think she might be sick or something?”

lines.japanese:
「ん……病気、ではないと思うよ。いやでも病気か
　な。いや……んなこと言ったら失礼か」
lines.english: “Mm... I don't think she's ill. Though maybe she is. No... that would be a rude way to put it.”

lines.japanese: 「行っても会えない？」
lines.english: “Even if we go, she won't see us?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、たぶん」
lines.english: “Probably not.”

lines.japanese: 「うううー」
lines.english: “Nnngh...”

lines.japanese: 「嫌な予感がするんだ」
lines.english: “I've got a bad feeling about this.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「このまま、みんなと会えなくなるような……」
lines.english: “Like... maybe we're going to stop seeing everyone.”

lines.japanese:
あずさも忍と同様の予感を、抱いているのかも知
れない。
lines.english: Perhaps Azusa shared Shinobu's premonition.

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと、ないよね？」
lines.english: “That's not going to happen, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ないよ」
lines.english: “It won't.”

lines.japanese: 「時間が経てば、戻って来るよね？」
lines.english: “Given time, she'll come back, won't she?”

lines.japanese: 「来るよ」
lines.english: “She will.”

lines.japanese: 「……元通りに」
lines.english: “...Back to normal.”

lines.japanese: 「なるよ」
lines.english: “It'll all go back to normal.”

lines.japanese:
言い切るしかなかった。
　安易な言葉は信頼の証だろうか？
lines.english: He had no choice but to sound certain. Were easy assurances proof of trust?

lines.japanese: 違う―――
lines.english: That’s not right—

lines.japanese: 忍はひとりごちる。
lines.english: Shinobu muttered to himself.

lines.japanese: 「う、何が違う？」
lines.english: “Huh? What’s not right?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、違わないよ」
lines.english: “No, it’s all right.”

lines.japanese: 「信じることは素晴らしい」
lines.english: “Believing is a wonderful thing.”

lines.japanese: 「……のかなって思って」
lines.english: “...Or at least, I was wondering if it is.”

lines.japanese: 「……どうなの？」
lines.english: “...Well, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「……信頼と、信仰の差、ということなのかも」
lines.english: “...Maybe that's the difference between trust and faith.”

lines.japanese:
「信仰には理屈がない。相手がどうあっても依存し
　てしまおうという……そういうずるさが見える」
lines.english: “Faith has no logic behind it. It means choosing to depend on someone, no matter what they're like... There's something self-serving about that.”

lines.japanese:
「信頼には覚悟がない。相手が裏切ったら信頼とい
　うものは壊れてしまうから」
lines.english: “There’s no resolve in trust. If the other person betrays you, your trust in them simply breaks.”

lines.japanese: 「でも信じちゃいけないということはない」
lines.english: “But that doesn't mean believing is wrong.”

lines.japanese: 忍はあずさの顔を見た。
lines.english: Shinobu looked at Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「でしょ？」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだね。だいたいは」
lines.english: “...Yes. More or less.”

lines.japanese: 少し驚かされた。
lines.english: That surprised him a little.

lines.japanese: 「覚悟だよ、覚悟」
lines.english: “Resolve. It's all about resolve.”

lines.japanese:
「どんな結果になっても、自分ではじめたことなん
　だからさ」
lines.english: “Whatever the outcome, you're the one who began it.”

lines.japanese: 「でもこれが、難しい……」
lines.english: “But that's the hard part...”

lines.japanese: 「……うん……そう思う……」
lines.english: “...Yeah... I think so too...”

lines.japanese:
きゅ、と指を握られる。
　幼女のような触れ方に、忍は少しばかり酔った。
lines.english: She gave his finger a little squeeze. Shinobu grew a little drunk on that childlike touch.

lines.japanese:
信頼よりも純粋な、それは好意による行動だった
からだ。
lines.english: It was because the gesture sprang from affection—something purer than trust.

lines.japanese: 「他者はいい……」
lines.english: “Other people are wonderful...”

lines.japanese:
呟きが潤みを含む。
　あずさは意味を理解せず、小首をかしげた。
lines.english: His murmur held a trace of tears. Azusa tilted her head, not understanding what he meant.

lines.japanese: 「キレイだな、夕焼け」
lines.english: “The sunset's beautiful.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 火を塗りつけたような空だった。
lines.english: The sky looked as though it had been smeared with fire.

lines.japanese: 「……終わりが近いから、キレイなのかな―――」
lines.english: “...I wonder if it's beautiful because the end is near—”

lines.japanese: その日の夜、伊月笛子からのメールが飛んできた。
lines.english: That night, an email arrived from Fueko Izuki.

lines.japanese:
TITLE:忍
　
　
　会いに行きたい
　あなたはまだあの草原にいるの？
lines.english: TITLE: Shinobu   I want to come see you. Are you still in that meadow?

lines.japanese:
夕日を呑みつつある地平に、低くまとわりつく施
設の壁は黒い。
lines.english: The compound's walls lay low and black against a horizon swallowing the sunset.

lines.japanese:
よそよそしい塀によって覆われているご大層な建
物群も、こうして遠方から見ると平坦さばかりが浮
き立つ。
lines.english: The imposing complex, enclosed by its forbidding walls, showed nothing from this distance but an unbroken flatness.

lines.japanese:
手前側に伸びる影だけが長大で、しかしそれさえ
も忍の足下に絡まる前に、低く鈍い光源の角度にす
り潰されてしまっている。
lines.english: Only the shadows reaching toward him had any great length, and even they were crushed flat by the low, dull angle of the light before they could coil around Shinobu's feet.

lines.japanese:
忍が世界をちっぽけに感じるのはこんな時だ。
　刻限は定められていなかった。
　ただ夕方と、笛子は指定した。
lines.english: At times like this, the world seemed small to Shinobu. No precise hour had been set. Fueko had said only: evening.

lines.japanese:
忍は律儀に一時間、夜気のまじりはじめた草原に
佇んでいた。
lines.english: Dutifully, Shinobu waited an hour in the meadow as the chill of night began to mingle with the air.

lines.japanese:
目が痛い。
　閉じると、鋭い痺れが眼球に走る。
　涙が出た。
lines.english: His eyes hurt. When he closed them, a sharp, numbing jolt ran through his eyeballs. Tears came.

lines.japanese:
肉体的な都合による涙。
　心の動きを伴わない。
lines.english: Purely physical tears. No movement of the heart accompanied them.

lines.japanese:
忍の体液は、眼球表面に付着した埃だけを排出し、
涙痕を残す。
lines.english: The fluid from Shinobu's body flushed the dust from the surfaces of his eyeballs, leaving tear tracks behind.

lines.japanese:
草を踏む音。
　振り返る。
lines.english: The sound of grass underfoot. He turned.

lines.japanese: そこに笛子が立っていた。
lines.english: Fueko stood there.

lines.japanese: 「笛子」
lines.english: “Fueko.”

lines.japanese:
忍の瞳は、鮮やかな茜色を照り返し、赤々と輝く。
　その赤光が笛子を咎めるように貫いた。
lines.english: Vivid crimson shone back from Shinobu's eyes. That red light pierced Fueko like an accusation.

lines.japanese: 「無事だったね。良かった」
lines.english: “You're safe. I'm glad.”

lines.japanese: 信じられないものを見る視線を、笛子は忍に向けた。
lines.english: Fueko stared at Shinobu as though she could not believe what she was seeing.

lines.japanese: 「心配したんだ」
lines.english: “I was worried about you.”

lines.japanese: 歩み寄ると笛子は半歩退いて、怯えをあらわにした。
lines.english: When he stepped toward her, Fueko shrank back half a pace, plainly afraid.

lines.japanese:
察して立ち止まる。３メートル手前。
　忍は無害を装い、ポケットに手を入れた。
　何事もなかったかのように空を見る。
lines.english: Reading her reaction, he stopped three meters away. Feigning harmlessness, Shinobu put his hands in his pockets. He looked up at the sky as though nothing had happened.

lines.japanese: そうやって相手の対応を待った。
lines.english: Then he waited to see what she would do.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry...”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “What for?”

lines.japanese:
無垢な面差しを向けられて、笛子は苦しげに顔を
歪ませた。
lines.english: At the sight of his innocent expression, Fueko's face twisted in pain.

lines.japanese: 「私、忍に謝らないといけないことが……」
lines.english: “There's something I need to apologize to you for...”

lines.japanese: 「謝らないといけないこと？」
lines.english: “Something you have to apologize for?”

lines.japanese: 「でも私……もう忍のお友達じゃない……」
lines.english: “But I'm... not your friend anymore...”

lines.japanese:
「こんな私の言うことなんて……
　あなたが聞いてくれるわけない……」
lines.english: “You'd never listen... to anything someone like me had to say...”

lines.japanese: 問いかけはどこまでも優しい。
lines.english: There was boundless gentleness in the question.

lines.japanese:
「なぜって……汚れてるの。
　もうどこも、清くない……」
lines.english: “Why...? Because I'm filthy. There's nothing clean left anywhere in me...”

lines.japanese:
「汚い人間なの。忍の王国に住むには、ふさわしく
　ないの」
lines.english: “I'm a filthy person. I'm not fit to live in your kingdom.”

lines.japanese: 顔を覆う。
lines.english: She covered her face.

lines.japanese:
「……疲れたの。もう……何がなんだか、わからな
　い……私……どこで間違えたのか……」
lines.english: “...I'm tired. I don't... I can't make sense of anything anymore. I don't know... where I went wrong...”

lines.japanese: 「王国か。表現は人それぞれだね」
lines.english: “A kingdom. I suppose everyone has their own way of putting it.”

lines.japanese: 「僕らの廃れた工場が王国であるとして」
lines.english: “Suppose our run-down factory is a kingdom...”

lines.japanese: 「だけどあそこは輝かしい場所なんかじゃない」
lines.english: “It isn't some shining place.”

lines.japanese: 「錆の浮いた廃墟に過ぎない」
lines.english: “It's nothing but a rusting ruin.”

lines.japanese:
「価値なんかありはしない。
　ましてや、住む資格なんてものもない」
lines.english: “It has no value at all. And no one needs to qualify to live there.”

lines.japanese: 「……だって、裏切ったの。私は……」
lines.english: “...But I betrayed you. I...”

lines.japanese: 「笛子が今思っていることは、裏切りじゃない」
lines.english: “What you're thinking now isn't betrayal.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてそんなことを断言できるの！？」
lines.english: “How can you be so sure?!”

lines.japanese: 突如として笛子が叫ぶ。
lines.english: Fueko suddenly cried out.

lines.japanese:
「どうして……
　どうしてっ、私は……もう私は……っ！」
lines.english: “Why... Why? I... I'm already...!”

lines.japanese: 自分の肩を押し潰すように抱え込む。
lines.english: She clutched herself as though to crush her own shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「実はね笛子、僕らの間に裏切りは成立しないんだ」
lines.english: “The truth is, Fueko, betrayal can't exist between us.”

lines.japanese:
「僕らはね、互いに決して裏切れないようになって
　るんだ」
lines.english: “You see, we're made so that none of us can ever betray another.”

lines.japanese:
「君の取ったどんな行動も、僕を悲しませないんだ。
　本当はね」
lines.english: “Nothing you’ve done makes me sad. Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘よッ！　だって私はもう……」
lines.english: “That's a lie! I've already...”

lines.japanese: 「もう？」
lines.english: “Already?”

lines.japanese: 「もう……私は忍を…………」
lines.english: “I already... I already... you...”

lines.japanese: 沈黙が満ちた。
lines.english: Silence filled the space between them.

lines.japanese:
「工場の外で起きたどんな出来事も、僕には些細な
　ことに思える」
lines.english: “Anything that happens outside the factory feels trivial to me.”

lines.japanese:
「いや、あずさが見つけて章二が名付け沙也加が認め
　たあの工場、そして今また笛子が王国と呼んだあの
　場所こそが……半分だ」
lines.english: “No—the factory Azusa found, Shouji named, and Sayaka accepted, the place you've just called a kingdom... That place is half.”
“...Half?”

lines.japanese: 「世界の半分。僕にとっての」
lines.english: “Half the world. To me.”

lines.japanese: 「父親にとって家庭が世界の半分であるように、さ」
lines.english: “Just as a home is half the world to a father.”

lines.japanese: 「……父親はいないの」
lines.english: “...I don't have a father.”

lines.japanese: 「うちもだ」
lines.english: “Same here.”

lines.japanese: と笑う。
lines.english: He said it with a smile.

lines.japanese: 「母親もいない。いるけれど……遠い」
lines.english: “I don't have a mother either. I do, but... she's far away.”

lines.japanese: 「もう何年も会っていないもの……」
lines.english: “I haven't seen her in years...”

lines.japanese: 「…………そうだろうね」
lines.english: “...I thought as much.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ」
lines.english: “Ha.”

lines.japanese:
よじれた悪意からもたらされた感情を、口元を吊
り上げながら忍になげうつ。
lines.english: A warped malice curled her lips as she flung the feeling at Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
「そんなお人好しだから、つらい思いをするのよ、
　忍は」
lines.english: “You're so softhearted, Shinobu. That's why you suffer.”

lines.japanese: しかし少年は口元をほころばせた。
lines.english: But the boy's lips softened into a smile.

lines.japanese: 「笛子に叱られるの、僕は好きだよ」
lines.english: “I like it when you scold me.”

lines.japanese:
「だから外でどんな仕打ちを受けても肯定できるん
　だ。またいつも通りに戻れるとも思ってる。これ
　っぽっちも疑ってはいない」
lines.english: “That's why I can accept whatever's done to me outside. I know we'll go back to the way we always were. I don't doubt it for a second.”

lines.japanese: 「……それは、バカよ……」
lines.english: “...That's idiotic...”

lines.japanese: 「違いない」
lines.english: “No doubt.”

lines.japanese:
「汚れてしまったって？
　つらかったね。でももう大丈夫」
lines.english: “You say you're dirty now? That must have hurt. But it's all right now.”

lines.japanese: 「カンを取り戻したから、もう大丈夫だよ」
lines.english: “I've got my instincts back, so everything's all right now.”

lines.japanese:
寄ってくる忍が、その赤眼の少年が、人ではない
ように笛子には感じられた。
lines.english: As Shinobu drew closer, Fueko felt that the red-eyed boy was not human.

lines.japanese:
だとしても……そう、恐怖はない。
　恐ろしくはないのだ。
lines.english: Even so... yes, she felt no fear. He did not frighten her.

lines.japanese:
たとえ殺されるとしても……いや、むしろ殺して
欲しいとさえ思っていた。
lines.english: Even if he killed her... No, she found herself almost wishing that he would.

lines.japanese: 「あなた、誰なの？」
lines.english: “Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「僕だよ」
lines.english: “It's me.”

lines.japanese:
言葉はしっくりと、心におさまる。
　忍以外のなにものでもない。それで十分だとわかる。
lines.english: The answer settled naturally into her heart. He was nothing other than Shinobu. She knew that was enough.

lines.japanese:
先ほど忍が笛子に告げたのも、同様の意味なのだ。
　裏切っても良い。
　でも好きでいる。
lines.english: What Shinobu had told Fueko before carried the same meaning. You may betray me. I will still love you.

lines.japanese:
自分勝手な、押しつけない好意だ。
　ただ思うだけの状態を是正することさえ必要とし
ない好意である。
lines.english: A selfish affection that imposed nothing. An affection content merely to be felt, with no need to become anything more.

lines.japanese:
実に今風にアレンジされた絆の感性ではないか、
と笛子は嘲弄した。
lines.english: What a thoroughly modern reworking of the very idea of human bonds, Fueko thought with scorn.

lines.japanese:
彼女もまた、そうした感情を胸に秘めていたのだ
った。
lines.english: And yet she too had harbored just such a feeling within her heart.

lines.japanese:
かつて国と人の繋がりが重い時代があった。
　家族が大切だった時代があった。
lines.english: There had once been an age when the bonds between nations and their peoples carried great weight. An age when family mattered.

lines.japanese:
互いに報い合う結束が、何よりも素晴らしいと断
定できた時代があった。
lines.english: There had been an age when one could declare that a bond of mutual obligation was the finest thing of all.

lines.japanese:
そして今、ひとりひとりが自らの領土を手に入れ
るようになると……それらの繋がり方は次第に外縁
に遠ざけられるようになった。
lines.english: And now, as every person came to possess a territory of their own... those old modes of connection were gradually driven out toward the margins.

lines.japanese:
行きすぎた友情は侵略と変わりない。
　そう叫ばれるようになったからだ。
lines.english: Friendship taken too far was no different from invasion. Or so people had begun to proclaim.

lines.japanese:
どこからが侵害で、どこからが絆なのか、判断基
準は明らかにはされない。
lines.english: No clear standard was ever given for where violation ended and human connection began.

lines.japanese:
自分以外の誰にもわからない。
　人が育てた最初の虚無の花は核だが、次に栽培す
ることになったのは自殺の権利である。
lines.english: Only the person concerned could know. The first flower of nihilism humanity cultivated was the Bomb; the next was the right to suicide.

lines.japanese:
その萌芽は豊かに狂える世代を土壌として確かに
生まれ始めていた。
lines.english: Those first shoots had surely begun to appear in the fertile soil of a generation prosperous enough to go mad.

lines.japanese:
朽ちた日輪を軽々と背負い、目前に立った忍を見
上げた。
lines.english: She looked up at Shinobu where he stood before her, effortlessly carrying the decaying sun on his back.

lines.japanese: 知らず笛子は膝をついていたのだ。
lines.english: Without realizing it, Fueko had fallen to her knees.

lines.japanese: 「……私は、もうあなたの知ってる人間じゃない」
lines.english: “...I'm not the person you knew anymore.”

lines.japanese:
「薄汚れた……どうしようもない……
　ただの……ただの……」
lines.english: “I'm filthy... beyond saving... Nothing but... nothing but...”

lines.japanese: 「それでもいいんだよ」
lines.english: “That's all right too.”

lines.japanese: 「……いいわけないっ！」
lines.english: “That isn't all right!”

lines.japanese:
「忍は何も知らない！　状況をちっとも把握してな
　い！　理解してないくせに、好きだなんて言わな
　いでよ！」
lines.english: “You don't know anything! You haven't grasped the situation at all! Don't tell me you love me when you don't even understand!”

lines.japanese: 「笛子」
lines.english: “Fueko.”

lines.japanese:
「そんなの好意じゃない！　ただ自分が好きって決
　めただけよ！　自己欺瞞じゃない！」
lines.english: “That isn't affection! You just decided for yourself that you love me! Isn't that just self-deception?”

lines.japanese:
「相手のことなんてどうでも良くて、たとえ入れ替
　わったってどうでも良くて……ちっとも噛み合っ
　てないわよ！」
lines.english: “The other person doesn't matter. It wouldn't matter if someone else took their place... You and I aren't connecting at all!”

lines.japanese:
「あなたは……誰だっていいのよ、誰だって好きに
　なれるのよ！　だったら、それが私である理由な
　んてどこにもない！」
lines.english: “It could be anyone... You could love anyone! Then there isn't a single reason it has to be me!”

lines.japanese: 「落ち着こうよ」
lines.english: “Let's just calm down.”

lines.japanese:
「落ち着いてるわよ！　何よ、自分だけ冷静で、い
　つだって冷静で！」
lines.english: “I am calm! You're the one staying calm, always so calm!”

lines.japanese:
「知ったような顔をして、まったく知らないくせに
　……人のこと振り回して……気を持たせてっ……」
lines.english: “You act like you know it all when you don't know a thing... You jerk people around... You lead them on...”

lines.japanese:
「どうせ沙也加のことが好きなんでしょう？　なの
　にみんなにゴマすって、それがあなたの言う肯定
　なわけ！？」
lines.english: “You love Sayaka anyway, don't you? And yet you butter everyone up, and you call that acceptance?”

lines.japanese:
「そんなの先延ばしじゃない！　いつか壊れるもの
　を、強引に延命しているだけ」
lines.english: “All you're doing is putting it off! You're forcibly keeping something doomed to break alive a little longer.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうかも知れないね」
lines.english: “...Maybe that's true.”

lines.japanese:
「そうよ！　それでも永遠に続くのならいいわよ……
　だけど、いつかは終わってしまうじゃない……永遠
　じゃないじゃない……」
lines.english: “You are! If it could last forever, then fine... But someday it will end... It isn't forever...”

lines.japanese:
「何年維持できるのよ、あなた言ったわよね？
　ずっと続けるって？
　６０才になっても続けるって！」
lines.english: “How many years can you keep it alive? You said it, didn't you? That you'd keep it going forever? That you'd still be doing it at sixty!”

lines.japanese:
「続けられるわけない……誰か死んでたら？
　誰か結婚したら？　家族を持ったら？
　引っ越したら？」
lines.english: “You can't... What if someone dies? What if someone marries? Starts a family? Moves away?”

lines.japanese:
「忍の言葉は、現実に立ち向かう力をまったく持っ
　てない！　ただキレイなだけ……整っているだけ」
lines.english: “Your words have no power to stand against reality! They're just pretty words... neat and polished.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな言葉、私は信じない。認めない。私が聞き
　たいのは、あの気持ちの悪い集まりが何年続くかっ
　ていう見積もりだけよ！」
lines.english: “I don't believe words like that. I won't accept them. All I want to hear is your estimate for how many years that revolting little gathering will last!”

lines.japanese: 「……気持ち悪い？」
lines.english: “...Revolting?”

lines.japanese: 聞きとがめる口調で、口舌を断ち切る。
lines.english: He seized on the word, cutting her tirade short.

lines.japanese:
「……中にいれば心地よい空間なのかも知れない。
　でも、はたから見たらあんなのは異常だわ」
lines.english: “...Perhaps it's comfortable when you're inside it. But from the outside, it isn't normal.”

lines.japanese:
「足りないものを求めて、歪んだまま集まって、何
　も生み出さない」
lines.english: “You come together warped, each craving what you lack, and produce nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「停滞してるだけ」
lines.english: “All you do is stagnate.”

lines.japanese: 「……それしか許されないんだよ、僕らには」
lines.english: “...That's all we're allowed to do.”

lines.japanese: 「先に進もうとしてないからでしょ」
lines.english: “Because you aren't even trying to move forward.”

lines.japanese: 「先はないんだ」
lines.english: “There is no way forward.”

lines.japanese: そう、先はない。
lines.english: That's right. There was no way forward.

lines.japanese:
「僕らに先なんてありはしない。今だけが全てだ。
　人のことなんてどうだっていいだろう？」
lines.english: “There is no future for us. Now is everything. Who cares about anyone else?”

lines.japanese: 「良くない！」
lines.english: “It does matter!”

lines.japanese: 「気持ちよければ、そのときは幸せだ。違う？」
lines.english: “If it feels good, then you're happy in that moment. Am I wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「おかしいわよそんなの！」
lines.english: “That's absurd!”

lines.japanese: 「……僕の力及ばないってのは、確かにそうさ」
lines.english: “...You're right that this is beyond my power.”

lines.japanese:
「終わってしまうかも知れない。欠けてしまうこと
　だってある。だけど……悪い終わりが見えたこと
　を、ずっと続けるのはつらいことだ」
lines.english: “It may end. Something may be lost. But... it's painful to keep something going once you can see it ending badly.”

lines.japanese: 「つらいから逃げてる」
lines.english: “So you're running away because it hurts.”

lines.japanese: 「逃げられないよ。そういう性質のことじゃない」
lines.english: “I can't run from it. That isn't the kind of thing it is.”

lines.japanese:
「自力で世界が動かせるものかよ。いつだってなる
　ようになってきた。若い力が世の中を変えるなん
　て文言に躍らされて、こき使われてさ」
lines.english: “How could I move the world under my own power? Things have always gone however they were going to go. They wave slogans about youthful power changing the world, then work us to the bone.”

lines.japanese:
「だから世の中のために、健全に生きてなんかやる
　もんかって思うよ」
lines.english: “So I refuse to live some wholesome life for the good of society.”

lines.japanese:
「……そういう風にずれるとね……
　イジメられるのよ」
lines.english: “...When you fall out of step like that... people bully you.”

lines.japanese:
「構わないさ。ベストの今があるなら、そこをゴール
　にすればいいんだ。悲劇の未来さえ途中過程だ」
lines.english: “Let them. If you have the best possible now, make that your destination. Even a tragic future is only another step along the way.”

lines.japanese:
「その上で僕は、６０歳になってもあのままを維持
　しようと考えているけどね」
lines.english: “That said, I still mean to keep things just as they are even when I'm sixty.”

lines.japanese: 「……できっこない」
lines.english: “...You could never do it.”

lines.japanese:
「計画はもう立ててある。あの工場だって、その一
　環だよ」
lines.english: “I've already made plans. That factory is part of them.”

lines.japanese:
「……あの場所に引きこもろうとでも言うわけ？
　泣けてくるわ……」
lines.english: “...What, are you going to shut yourselves away in there? That makes me want to cry...”

lines.japanese:
鼻をすする。
　笛子は感情を吐露して、一気に萎んでしまったよ
うに感じられた。
lines.english: She sniffed. Having poured out her feelings, Fueko seemed to deflate all at once.

lines.japanese: 「いい場所だからね、あそこは」
lines.english: “It's a good place, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ教えてよその素晴らしい今を維持する方法」
lines.english: “Then tell me how you intend to preserve that wonderful now.”

lines.japanese: 「それはできない。内緒だから」
lines.english: “I can't. It's a secret.”

lines.japanese: 「ないくせに」
lines.english: “You don't even have a plan.”

lines.japanese: せせら笑う。
lines.english: She sneered.

lines.japanese: 「そういうのをね、甘いっていうのよ、忍」
lines.english: “That's what I mean when I say you're soft, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「教えられないのは、君たちに絶対協力してもらい
　たくないからだ」
lines.english: “I can't tell you because I absolutely refuse to let any of you help me.”

lines.japanese: 「……どういうこと？」
lines.english: “...What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「僕がひとりでやる」
lines.english: “I'll do it alone.”

lines.japanese:
「とても汚らわしい行いだからね。
　みんなは加わらない方がいい」
lines.english: “Because it's a profoundly filthy thing to do. None of you should be part of it.”

lines.japanese:
「汚れてる？　忍が言ってること、全然わからない
　……煙に巻くつもりなの？」
lines.english: “Filthy? I don't understand a word you're saying, Shinobu. Are you trying to talk circles around me?”

lines.japanese:
「違う。本当だよ。僕は計画を立てて、それに沿っ
　て行動してる」
lines.english: “No. It's true. I have a plan, and I'm acting according to it.”

lines.japanese:
「……怖かった。恐ろしかったよ。
　僕は誰からも道徳を教わらなかったからね。
　逆らうことを決めるのは、とても恐ろしかった」
lines.english: “...I was afraid. Terrified. No one ever taught me right from wrong. Deciding to rebel was terrifying.”

lines.japanese: 「逆らうって……誰に？」
lines.english: “Defy... who?”

lines.japanese:
目線に突き押されたように、笛子は腰を背後に逃
がす。
lines.english: As though shoved by his gaze, Fueko drew her body back.

lines.japanese:
そのとき、やっと相手が人間ではないものだと思
い出した。
lines.english: Only then did she remember that the person before her was not human.

lines.japanese: 先ほどから身を貫くこの恐怖。
lines.english: The fear that had pierced her through all this time.

lines.japanese: その正体は―――
lines.english: Its true identity was—

lines.japanese: 「忍は……いったい何をしようと……？」
lines.english: “Shinobu... what are you trying to do...?”

lines.japanese:
「正直、ずっと迷ってたんだ。
　けど……今はもう決心してる」
lines.english: “Honestly, I've been wavering all this time. But... I've made up my mind now.”

lines.japanese: 「だから笛子、逃げないで」
lines.english: “So don't run away, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「戻っておいで」
lines.english: “Come back.”

lines.japanese: 手を差し伸べる。
lines.english: He held out his hand.
“Shinobu...”

lines.japanese:
寄り添うために進みかけた上体が、傾いたまま停
止した。
lines.english: Her upper body tilted toward him, ready to draw close, then stopped.

lines.japanese: 「笛子？」
lines.english: “Fueko?”

lines.japanese: 「……興奮しちゃって、ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry. I got worked up.”

lines.japanese:
「いいよ。気にしてない。前も言ったけど、笛子の
　潔癖さ、好きだよ」
lines.english: “It's fine. I don't mind. Like I said before, I like that uncompromising purity of yours.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
傾斜から戻された顔は、晴れやかで。
　違和感がぬぐえない。
lines.english: When she lifted her face again, it was serene. He could not shake the sense that something was wrong.

lines.japanese: 「目を閉じてくれる？」
lines.english: “Will you close your eyes?”
“...My eyes?”

lines.japanese: 「その間に、忍のことを攻撃します」
lines.english: “While they're closed, I'm going to attack you.”

lines.japanese:
悪戯めかせて言われると、笑わないわけにはいか
なくなった。
lines.english: She said it with such playful mischief that he had no choice but to smile.

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、こう？」
lines.english: “All right. Like this?”

lines.japanese: しかし五感を通じて、笛子が寄ってくるのがわかる。
lines.english: Yet his other senses told him that Fueko was drawing near.

lines.japanese:
眼前。
　唇に乾いた感触が、押し当てられた。
　目を開く。
lines.english: Right before him. A dry touch pressed against his lips. He opened his eyes.

lines.japanese:
すでに接触は解かれていた。
　開いた唇の隙間から滲み出る微熱を、吸い取る暇
もなく離れたのだ。
lines.english: The contact had already ended. She pulled away before he could draw in the faint warmth seeping between her parted lips.

lines.japanese: 「汚れたの私」
lines.english: “I'm the one who's dirty.”

lines.japanese: ふと、病に冒された顔をした。
lines.english: For an instant, her face looked ravaged by illness.

lines.japanese: 「疲れたの……」
lines.english: “I'm tired...”

lines.japanese: 「時間が解決する」
lines.english: “Time will take care of it.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに待っていられないわ」
lines.english: “I can't wait that long.”

lines.japanese:
「ほんの少しだよ。
　そうしたら、元通りだ。頑張ろうよ」
lines.english: “Just a little while. Then everything will be back to normal. Hang in there.”

lines.japanese:
「引き返してそれで全部元に戻ったら、苦労しない
　わよ。馬鹿ねぇ」
lines.english: “If going back made everything right again, life would be easy, you idiot.”

lines.japanese: 甘えるような悪態。
lines.english: The insult sounded almost like a plea for affection.

lines.japanese:
「汚れてる……ううん……ほつれてるの、私。
　もう持ちこたえられそうにないのよ」
lines.english: “I'm filthy... No... I'm coming apart at the seams. I don't think I can hold together much longer.”

lines.japanese: 「でしょ？」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese:
「このままじゃ、狂う、でしょ？
　正しくないでしょ？
　だってわからない……今、ホラ！」
lines.english: “If this goes on, I'll go insane, won't I? That isn't right, is it? Because I don't know anymore... Look, right now!”

lines.japanese:
「わからなくなりつつある……ほら、脳がぷちぷち
　言ってる。これって、溶けてるんでしょ？」
lines.english: “I'm starting to lose track of things... Listen, my brain is popping inside my head. That means it's melting, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: 片手を耳に当て、無邪気に笑い泣く。
lines.english: With one hand pressed to her ear, she laughed and wept with childlike innocence.

lines.japanese:
「ほら、ほら！　ぷちって、ぷちって言ったわ！
　聞こえるでしょ……ああ……時間がないのよ」
lines.english: “There! There! It went pop! It went pop again! You can hear it, can't you...? Oh... I'm running out of time.”

lines.japanese:
「もう駄目なの。バラバラになっちゃう……ネジが
　取れちゃう！」
lines.english: “I can't take it anymore. I'm going to fall apart... My screws are falling out!”

lines.japanese:
「きゃあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁ
　ぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa—aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!”

lines.japanese: 悲鳴を発した。
lines.english: She screamed.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あ、あ……ネジが……ネジがぁぁ……っ！！」
lines.english: “Ah, ah, ah... My screws... the screws...!”
“Fueko...”

lines.japanese:
地面にうずくまる。
　芋虫を思わせる動きで、四肢を乱した。
lines.english: She curled up on the ground. Her limbs flailed as she writhed like a caterpillar.

lines.japanese:
「……殺してぇぇぇぇ……
　殺してよぉぉぉぉぉぉ…………」
lines.english: “...Kill meeee... Please, kill meeeeeeee...”

lines.japanese:
「意識をしっかり。ソレは、自分で進行させてしま
　っては駄目だ！」
lines.english: “Keep your wits about you. Don’t let yourself push it any further!”

lines.japanese: 「ああああぁぁぁ…………」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaah...”

lines.japanese: 「笛子……もう駄目なのか……」
lines.english: “Fueko... Is it already too late...?”

lines.japanese:
「忍……たす、けて…………殺、して…………
　気が狂いそう……」
lines.english: “Shinobu... help... kill me... I feel like I'm going insane...”

lines.japanese: 「楽に……なりたいぃぃぃ……」
lines.english: “I just want... some relief...”

lines.japanese:
眉を寄せただけの忍の顔は、無限の情をたたえて
いた。
lines.english: Shinobu's face, marked only by a furrow in his brow, held an infinity of feeling.

lines.japanese:
悲痛を越えたありとあらゆるものを詰め、自らは
狂い散ることもできずに理性に寄り添っていなけれ
ばならない者の……それは凄絶な断念。
lines.english: It contained everything beyond anguish—the terrible resignation of one denied even the release of flying apart into madness, forced instead to cling to reason.

lines.japanese:
憂色を塗り込められて仮面と化した顔は、つくね
んとした印象を忍に与えた。
lines.english: Her face, painted over with sorrow until it became a mask, struck Shinobu as strangely vacant.

lines.japanese:
時間が過ぎた。
　続く笛子の呻吟に、しかしもうせかされるような
様子はない。
lines.english: Time passed. Fueko's moans went on, but no longer seemed to hurry him.

lines.japanese: ゆっくりと、静かな声で、
lines.english: Slowly, in a quiet voice—

lines.japanese: 「笛子、その考え方は良くない」
lines.english: “Fueko, that isn't a good way to think.”

lines.japanese: 「私、匂わない？」
lines.english: “Do I smell?”

lines.japanese: けろりとした顔を、持ち上げた。
lines.english: She lifted her head, looking suddenly nonchalant.
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、私ね……私……さっき……」
lines.english: “Um, I... I... a little while ago...”
“...A little while ago...”

lines.japanese: 忍は鋭く察した。
lines.english: Shinobu understood at once.

lines.japanese: 「言わなくていい」
lines.english: “You don't have to tell me.”

lines.japanese: 「でも仲間なんでしょ？　隠し事はできないわ」
lines.english: “But we're friends, aren't we? I can't keep secrets from you.”

lines.japanese:
「してくれて構わない。つらいことを思い出すこと
　もない」
lines.english: “You can. There's no need to remember anything painful.”

lines.japanese: 「全部流そう。そして今まで通りに行こう」
lines.english: “Let's let it all wash away, then go on as we always have.”

lines.japanese: 「それは優しさ？」
lines.english: “Is that kindness?”

lines.japanese:
「違うんだろうね。僕はまだそこまで育ってないだ
　ろうし。たぶん……」
lines.english: “I doubt it. I don't think I've grown that much yet. Probably...”

lines.japanese: 「忍自身がそれを望んでる」
lines.english: “You want that for yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「だと思う」
lines.english: “I think so.”

lines.japanese:
「優しくもない。強くもない。だけど……私は忍の
　ことが好き」
lines.english: “You aren’t kind. You aren’t strong. But... I love you, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっといたい」
lines.english: “I want to stay forever.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese:
「……いられるわけないでしょうっ！？
　バカじゃないの！？」
lines.english: “...There's no way I can stay forever! Are you stupid?!”

lines.japanese: とどめられていた涙がどっと溢れている。
lines.english: The tears she had held back burst free.

lines.japanese:
「この気持ちのまま、みんなと一緒にいられないわ
　よ！　ネジ取れてんのよ！？　常識で考えなさい
　よ！！　ああああああああああああああああ！！」
lines.english: “I can't stay with everyone while I feel this way! One of my screws is missing! Use some common sense! Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!”

lines.japanese:
「……あああ…………
　あぁぁぁぁぁぁ…………」
lines.english: “...Aah... Aaaaaaaaaah...”

lines.japanese: 再びうずくまる笛子を抱えた。
lines.english: He gathered Fueko into his arms as she collapsed again.

lines.japanese:
「……壊れそう……頭がおかしくなりそう……助け
　て……忍。もう助けて……もうごめんなさいだか
　ら……許して、助けて……」
lines.english: “...I'm breaking apart... I'm losing my mind... Help me... Shinobu, please help me... I'm sorry, all right? Forgive me. Help me...”

lines.japanese: 「もう痛いことしないで！」
lines.english: “Don't hurt me anymore!”

lines.japanese: びく、と忍は震えた。
lines.english: Shinobu flinched.

lines.japanese:
「……やめてよ……それ嫌いなの……やめてよ……
　痛いだけなの、気持ちよくなんかないの……やめ
　てよぉ…………」
lines.english: “...Stop... I hate that... Stop... It only hurts. It doesn't feel good at all... Please, stop...”
“Fueko...”

lines.japanese: 「だって……私は、だって……だって…………」
lines.english: “Because... I... because... because...”

lines.japanese: 様子が変わった。
lines.english: Something changed.

lines.japanese:
表情の向こう、笛子が完全に変質しかけているの
を忍は感じ取る。
lines.english: Shinobu sensed something beyond her expression: Fueko was on the verge of changing completely.

lines.japanese: 彼女はもう伊月笛子ではいられない。
lines.english: She could no longer remain Fueko Izuki.

lines.japanese: 崩壊の時が来ていた。
lines.english: The time for her collapse had come.

lines.japanese: 「……ねえ、笛子」
lines.english: “...Hey, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「……だって、だってだってだってだって……」
lines.english: “...Because, because because because because...”

lines.japanese: 「笛子！」
lines.english: “Fueko!”

lines.japanese: 揺さぶる。
lines.english: He shook her.
“...Ah... Shinobu?”

lines.japanese:
その瞳を見て知った。
　もうこの少女は、彼女の定義する“汚れ”に耐え
られない。
lines.english: One look into her eyes told him. This girl could no longer endure what she called ‘filth.’

lines.japanese:
だからこその決意が、忍の胸中には一つだけ残さ
れている。
lines.english: Only one resolution remained in Shinobu's heart.

lines.japanese: 最後の選択肢が―――
lines.english: The final choice—

lines.japanese: 「……自分ってのは、どこまでが自分なんだろうね」
lines.english: “...I wonder where the self begins and ends.”

lines.japanese:
「いろいろな経験によって笛子が作られた。つらい
　こともあれば、楽しいこともあった」
lines.english: “All kinds of experiences made you who you are, Fueko. Some were painful. Others were happy.”

lines.japanese:
「君はいろいろなものを見て来ただろう？　いろん
　なものを好きになってきたはずだ」
lines.english: “You've seen so many things, haven't you? You must have come to like all kinds of things.”

lines.japanese:
「つらい記憶だけをとりのぞくことはできない。楽
　しいことも一緒くたに奪い去ってしまう」
lines.english: “You can't remove only the painful memories. The happy ones would be swept away with them.”

lines.japanese:
「きっと、楽になるというのはそういうことだと
　思う」
lines.english: “I think that's what it means to find relief.”

lines.japanese:
「全て取り去ったら……君はどのくらい残るの
　かな？」
lines.english: “If everything were taken away... how much of you would be left?”

lines.japanese: 頬を両手で挟む。抵抗はない。怯えも。
lines.english: He cupped her cheeks in both hands. There was no resistance. No fear.

lines.japanese: 「僕が好きな笛子は、どれくらい残るのかな？」
lines.english: “How much of the Fueko I love would be left?”

lines.japanese: 「それだけが、未だによくわからない」
lines.english: “That's the one thing I still don't understand.”

lines.japanese: 抱きしめる。
lines.english: He embraced her.

lines.japanese: 「だけど……忘れたかったら、忘れてもいいよ」
lines.english: “But... if you want to forget, you may.”

lines.japanese:
「つらいことから逃げていいよ。そっとしておいて
　あげるよ」
lines.english: “You can run from what hurts. I'll leave you in peace.”

lines.japanese:
「それで休んで……いつかまた、みんな一緒に集ま
　れるなら」
lines.english: “Rest... and if someday all of us can gather together again...”

lines.japanese: 「……戻ってきてくれる？」
lines.english: “...Will you come back?”

lines.japanese: 一時、理性を取り戻した笛子が応じる。
lines.english: Fueko's reason returned for a moment, and she answered.

lines.japanese: 「わからない」
lines.english: “I don't know.”

lines.japanese: 「でも」

lines.english: “I’ll look—”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたら今度こそ、ちゃんと友達になろう」
lines.english: “Then, this time, let's really be friends.”

lines.japanese:
「……ごめんなさい……忍、ごめんなさい……
　許して……」
lines.english: “...I'm sorry... Shinobu, I'm sorry... Forgive me...”

lines.japanese: 強く抱きかかえる。
lines.english: He held her tightly.

lines.japanese: 「君は汚れてなんかいない」
lines.english: “You aren't dirty.”

lines.japanese: 「ただほんの少し、傷ついただけだよ」
lines.english: “You were only hurt a little.”

lines.japanese:
「ここにいる。この腕の中にいる。無意味じゃない
　笛子だ」
lines.english: “You're here. Here in my arms. You're Fueko, and you matter.”

lines.japanese:
夕日が草原に淡いほむらを投げかけている。
　夜の気配が、漂いはじめた。
lines.english: The sunset cast a pale flame across the meadow. The first hint of night began to drift in.

lines.japanese:
いろいろなことがあった一日。
　忍の生には、毎日、様々なことが起こった。
lines.english: A day on which all manner of things had happened. Every day of Shinobu's life was like that.

lines.japanese:
もっとも価値を見いだした日々、仲間との触れあ
いにおいては、どんな些細なことでさえ大事だった
のだ。
lines.english: In the days he valued most—the days he spent among his companions—even the smallest thing had mattered to him.

lines.japanese:
比べれば、今日という日の出来事も、そんな延長
線上にある、充分に消化してしまえることなのかも
知れない。
lines.english: By comparison, perhaps the events of this day were merely an extension of all the others—something he could fully digest.

lines.japanese:
長い夜が来る。
　笛子が心を休める日に入る。
　ならば良い、と忍は思った。
lines.english: A long night was coming. For Fueko, a time of rest was beginning. Then that was enough, Shinobu thought.

lines.japanese:
つらい時期なのだ。
　下手に怯えながら生きることもない。
　戻ると笛子は言った。
lines.english: This was a painful season. There was no need for her to go on living in fear. Fueko had said she would return.

lines.japanese: 信じようと決めた。
lines.english: He decided to believe her.

lines.japanese: 抱き寄せる。
lines.english: He drew her close.

lines.japanese:
もうこれ以上１ミリだってくっつけない。
　だというのに、力いっぱい抱きしめた。
lines.english: There was not another millimeter between them. Still he held her with all his strength.

lines.japanese: お別れであった。
lines.english: It was farewell.

lines.japanese:
値段コムは、マイコン・家電三種の神器・イントラネットなど、微妙なものか
ら一般的なものまでの幅広い製品やサービスの値段を比べる、亜細亜最大級の値
段比較携帯サイト。
lines.english: PriceCom is one of Asia's largest mobile price-comparison sites, covering a wide range of products and services, from the faintly dubious—microcomputers, the Three Sacred Treasures of home appliances, intranets—to the perfectly ordinary.

lines.japanese: なにやら気持ちよさそうな響きである（おそらくは男性限定）。
lines.english: The term has a strangely pleasurable ring to it (for men, presumably).

lines.japanese:
精神論。
　三分で作れるお手軽な料理、というわけではなく、気合いを入れて調理するこ
とで無理矢理に三分で作ってしまえ、という考え。
　結果的に簡素な料理が多いのも事実。
lines.english: A philosophy of sheer willpower. This does not mean an easy dish that can be made in three minutes. It means putting so much fighting spirit into your cooking that you force it to be done in three minutes. Admittedly, most of the resulting dishes are simple.

lines.japanese:
ライス・みそ汁、おかわり自由。
　苦学生と無職の味方。
　食いだめすべし。
lines.english: Unlimited rice and miso-soup refills. A friend to impoverished students and the unemployed. Eat enough to tide you over.

lines.japanese:
千鳥姉さんのとぼけた日々を、戦慄の事実を交え
ながらシリーズでお送りします。
lines.english: Presenting a continuing series on Sis Chidori’s peculiar daily life, complete with horrifying facts.
“…choo.”

lines.japanese: 「何だ？」
lines.english: “What was that?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、くしゃみです」
lines.english: “Nothing. It was a sneeze.”

lines.japanese: 「今のがか？」
lines.english: “That was a sneeze?”
“…choo.”

lines.japanese: 「そうです」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 準備開始から今に至るまでの時間。
lines.english: The time elapsed since preparations began.

lines.japanese:
中興新聞。
　中興新聞社発行。
　１２頁。
　有志によって発行されている、いわゆるローカル新聞。
　刊行は不定期。
　価格は時価。
lines.english: The Chuukou News. Published by the Chuukou News Company. Twelve pages. A local paper put out by volunteers. Published irregularly. Market price.

lines.japanese:
確か名を……邑西と言った。
　今はどこで何をしているのだろうか？
lines.english: The name, if memory served… was Yuuzai. Where could he be now, and what might he be doing?
